normal.desc: 【修辭】Bitterly though the conservative faction contested the constitutional amendment, they could not prevent its ratification. What occurred?
options: A. The conservatives successfully vetoed the ratification in committee.
B. The amendment was withdrawn due to legal ambivalence.
C. Both factions reached an amicable and harmonious compromise.
D. The amendment was ratified despite passionate and vehement resistance.
normal.explain: Bitterly though... 引導副詞讓步倒裝，表示儘管保守派激烈反對，修正案仍獲批准。

normal.desc: 【語義】Barely had the sovereign delivered the abdication address when public jubilation spilled into the squares. What took place?
options: A. Celebrations erupted the very instant the monarch stepped down.
B. The monarch recanted the abdication following widespread mourning.
C. The address was canceled due to civil unrest in the streets.
D. Military units suppressed public demonstrations immediately.
normal.explain: Barely had... when... 倒裝描摹君主剛宣讀退位宣言，公眾歡騰便湧入廣場。

normal.desc: 請唸出：絕不可；無論如何都不（倒裝片語）
normal.explain: on no account (phr.)：絕不可；無論如何都不（倒裝片語）。例句：On no account should fundamental human liberties be subordinated to political expediency.（無論在任何情況下，基本人權與自由都絕不可屈從於政治權宜。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：若其遭到破壞削弱（虛擬倒裝）
normal.explain: were it undermined (phr.)：若其遭到破壞削弱（虛擬倒裝）。例句：Were constitutional guardrails undermined the fragile democratic compact would disintegrate.（憲法防護欄若遭到削弱瓦解，脆弱的民主公約便將隨之崩塌。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：如此之才華卓越以致於
normal.explain: such was the brilliance (phr.)：如此之才華卓越以致於。例句：Such was the intellectual brilliance of the thesis that orthodox paradigms crumbled.（該論文的智慧光芒如此耀眼，以致於傳統典範隨之土崩瓦解。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：剛一生效實施之際
normal.explain: scarcely had it taken (phr.)：剛一生效實施之際。例句：Scarcely had the decree taken effect when profound structural fissures manifested.（政令剛一生效實施，深刻的體制結構裂痕便全面顯現。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：正是體制的不透明性
normal.explain: it was systemic opacity (phr.)：正是體制的不透明性。例句：It was precisely systemic opacity that enabled unchecked predatory exploitation.（正是體制層面的極度不透明，助長了毫無制衡的掠奪性剝削。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：唯有堅守；只有秉持
normal.explain: only by upholding (phr.)：唯有堅守；只有秉持。例句：Only by upholding rigorous forensic standards can judicial integrity endure.（唯有始終恪守嚴謹的鑑識標準，司法公正誠信方能歷久不衰。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：爭議如此激烈以致於
normal.explain: so contentious were they (phr.)：爭議如此激烈以致於。例句：So contentious were the deliberations that consensus remained entirely elusive.（閉門商議過程如此充滿激烈爭辯，以致於共識始終難以企及。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：假若當時及時獲得提供
normal.explain: had it been forthcoming (phr.)：假若當時及時獲得提供。例句：Had archival corroboration been forthcoming the hypothesis would have attained orthodoxy.（假若當時檔案佐證能及時公諸於世，這項假說早已確立為公認正統。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：依法沒收查封扣押或隔離保管爭議資產（S 開頭，9 個字母）
normal.explain: SEQUESTER (v.)：依法沒收查封扣押或隔離保管爭議資產。例句：The state moved to sequester the disputed cartel assets.（國家依法採取行動，對涉案財團的有爭議資產進行查封與扣押。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：認識論主張人類實證知識皆具犯錯可能（F 開頭，11 個字母）
normal.explain: FALLIBILISM (n.)：認識論主張人類實證知識皆具犯錯可能。例句：Scientific inquiry is anchored in fallibilism rather than dogmatic finality.（科學探索的根基在於可謬主義的開放態度，而非教條式的終極定論。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：宗教團體或政治陣營產生的正式重大分裂（S 開頭，6 個字母）
normal.explain: SCHISM (n.)：宗教團體或政治陣營產生的正式重大分裂。例句：The schism between eastern and western churches altered European history.（東西方教會之間的大分裂深刻地改變了歐洲歷史的進程。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：司法鑑識的或法庭適用的檢驗方法（F 開頭，8 個字母）
normal.explain: FORENSIC (adj.)：司法鑑識的或法庭適用的檢驗方法。例句：Forensic accounting unraveled the transnational web of fictitious holding entities.（鑑識會計技術揭開了跨國虛假控股公司相互交織的隱秘網絡。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：強制專斷的不容置辯的官方指令（P 開頭，10 個字母）
normal.explain: PEREMPTORY (adj.)：強制專斷的不容置辯的官方指令。例句：The high commissioner issued a peremptory directive halting border fortifications.（高級專員發布了一道不容抗辯的強制指令，勒令立即暫停邊境要塞建設。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：使劇烈震盪動盪不安或引發痙攣（C 開頭，8 個字母）
normal.explain: CONVULSE (v.)：使劇烈震盪動盪不安或引發痙攣。例句：Hyperinflation threatened to convulse the fragile post conflict republic.（惡性通貨膨脹隨時可能使這個剛剛結束衝突的脆弱共和國陷入劇烈動盪。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：使從屬於或將某事物置於次等地位（S 開頭，11 個字母）
normal.explain: SUBORDINATE (v.)：使從屬於或將某事物置於次等地位。例句：A genuine scholar refuses to subordinate truth to institutional convenience.（一位真正的學者絕不會將真理屈從於體制運作的方便與利益。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：提供確鑿證據以證實某主張說法（C 開頭，11 個字母）
normal.explain: CORROBORATE (v.)：提供確鑿證據以證實某主張說法。例句：Newly declassified archives corroborate the ambassador account of the crisis.（新解密的歷史檔案完全證實了大使對這場危機發展過程的陳述。）

normal.desc: 填空題：S E Q U _ S T E R (依法院命令查封扣押涉案物資)
normal.explain: SEQUESTER (v.)：依法院命令查封扣押涉案物資。例句：The magistrate issued a warrant to sequester the offshore accounts.（法官正式簽發了查封並扣押這些離岸銀行帳戶的司法扣押令。）

normal.desc: 填空題：S _ H _ _ M (派系決裂與組織大分裂)
normal.explain: SCHISM (n.)：派系決裂與組織大分裂。例句：The ideological schism paralyzed the governing coalition for a generation.（這場意識形態的大分裂，使執政聯盟整整一代人陷入施政癱瘓。）

normal.desc: 填空題：W _ I _ _ R (放棄豁免權之法定文件)
normal.explain: WAIVER (n.)：放棄豁免權之法定文件。例句：The treaty included a mutual waiver of future wartime reparations claims.（條約中包含了一項相互放棄未來戰時賠償索賠要求的法定豁免條款。）

normal.desc: 填空題：F O R E _ S I C (科學鑑識與證據審查)
normal.explain: FORENSIC (adj.)：科學鑑識與證據審查。例句：Forensic analysis revealed micro fissures in the subsea gas pipeline.（專業鑑識分析揭示了海底天然氣管道內部存在的微觀裂縫。）

normal.desc: 填空題：C O _ V _ L _ E (社會或經濟層面的劇烈動盪)
normal.explain: CONVULSE (v.)：社會或經濟層面的劇烈動盪。例句：Speculative runs on regional banks threatened to convulse sovereign credit.（對地區性銀行的投機擠兌浪潮，隨時可能使整個國家的主權信用劇烈震盪。）

normal.desc: 填空題：A U _ A _ I _ Y (非凡膽略與大膽探索精神)
normal.explain: AUDACITY (n.)：非凡膽略與大膽探索精神。例句：The explorer showed the audacity to chart uncharted polar waters alone.（這位探險家展現了獨自航向未繪製地圖的極地水域的過人膽略。）

normal.desc: 填空題：S U B O R _ I N A T E (使隸屬次級地位)
normal.explain: SUBORDINATE (v.)：使隸屬次級地位。例句：Democratic constitutions never subordinate fundamental rights to executive decrees.（民主國家的憲法絕不會將公民的基本權利屈從於行政首長的個人法令。）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The charter prescribes that an ad hoc tribunal be empaneled within a fortnight. What is the deadline?
options: A. Within six calendar months of the incident.
B. Only after a unanimous plebiscite.
C. Within two weeks following formal filing.
D. Immediately prior to diplomatic consultations.
normal.explain: prescribe that + 原形虛擬式 be empaneled，在兩週內組成特別法庭。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Had the monastic library not preserved the lost codex our understanding would be fragmentary today. What is true?
options: A. The codex was permanently lost during the sack of the library.
B. Byzantine legal philosophy remains entirely inaccessible today.
C. Modern scholars invented the codex to justify contemporary laws.
D. The preservation of the codex ensures our coherent modern understanding.
normal.explain: 過去完成假設對應現在狀態，古抄本的保存使當今理解免於殘缺不全。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The minister instituted firewall protocols lest proprietary telemetry be intercepted by hostile actors. What was the fear?
options: A. The illicit electronic eavesdropping and interception by foreign adversaries.
B. The accidental deletion of public meteorological archives.
C. The voluntary publication of open source intelligence.
D. The commercial sale of proprietary algorithms to domestic startups.
normal.explain: lest... be intercepted 虛擬句，防範機密遙測遭敵國攔截。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Far be it from me to contest the tribunal jurisdiction but procedural fairness was disregarded. What is argued?
options: A. The speaker rejects the court authority to preside over the case.
B. The speaker praises the trial as a model of procedural rectitude.
C. The speaker asserts that procedural fairness is entirely optional.
D. The speaker respects jurisdiction yet condemns procedural injustice.
normal.explain: Far be it from me to contest... 虛擬修辭：無意挑戰管轄權，但程序正義確實蕩然無存。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The codicil stipulates that the estate liquidity remain untouched until heirs reach legal majority. What condition governs liquidity?
options: A. Funds remain locked until all beneficiaries reach legal adulthood.
B. Funds are immediately liquidated to pay outstanding estate taxes.
C. Heirs may access speculative dividends upon turning sixteen.
D. The liquidity is bequeathed to public municipal endowments.
normal.explain: stipulate that + 原形動詞 remain，遺囑附加條款規定成年方可動支。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Had the central bank not intervened with swap lines bond markets would be frozen today. What was avoided?
options: A. The sudden dissolution of international clearing houses.
B. A complete systemic freeze and liquidity dry up in bond markets.
C. An uncontrolled inflationary spike across all retail commodities.
D. The unilateral nationalization of private multinational banks.
normal.explain: 錯綜條件句：若無央行當時干預，今日主權債券市場將陷入凍結。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The magistrate ordered that the sequestered manuscripts be repatriated to their ancestral provenance. What action was decreed?
options: A. The physical return of the manuscripts to their historical origins.
B. The permanent exhibition of the codices in foreign national galleries.
C. The private auction of the archival fragments to collectors.
D. The digitization of texts followed by destruction of the originals.
normal.explain: order that + 原形動詞 be repatriated，下令手稿歸還歷史原產地。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: If the post war economic order had not established arbitration global commerce would be coercive today. What is credited?
options: A. Arbitration bodies failed to resolve any historical trade dispute.
B. Multilateral institutions mitigated unilateral coercion in trade.
C. Global trade has always been dictated entirely by naval blockades.
D. Bilateral coercion remains the sole legal framework in commerce.
normal.explain: 錯綜虛擬：戰後建立多邊仲裁機制，避免了今日貿易淪為赤裸裸的強制力博弈。

normal.desc: 【文法】It is of paramount necessity that the constitutional assembly ___ within sixty days of the referendum.
options: A. convened
B. would convene
C. convene
D. convenes
normal.explain: paramount necessity that 子句須使用原形虛擬式 convene。

normal.desc: 【虛擬】Had the pre-modern cartographers not mapped the archipelago with such fidelity, modern territorial boundaries ___ contested today.
options: A. would have been
B. had been widely
C. are widely
D. would be widely
normal.explain: 錯綜虛擬條件：過去測繪精確，避免了今日邊界廣泛產生爭端（would be widely contested today）。

normal.desc: 【古雅】Lest the tribunal neutrality ___ into disrepute, all correspondence between judges and litigants was banned.
options: A. fall
B. falls
C. fell
D. would fall
normal.explain: Lest... (should) fall 引導目的狀語從句，動詞使用原形虛擬式 fall 表示「唯恐、免得」。

normal.desc: 【修辭】Far be it from the scientific reviewer to impugn the author motives, but the methodological lacunae are undeniable. What is the reviewer stance?
options: A. The reviewer launches an explicit personal attack on the author integrity.
B. The reviewer considers the methodological design entirely flawless.
C. The reviewer recommends immediate retraction based on alleged plagiarism.
D. The reviewer focuses strictly on empirical flaws rather than personal motives.
normal.explain: Far be it from... to... 為古雅固定虛擬式，表示「絕無意質疑動機，但方法學缺陷不容否認」。

normal.desc: 【篇章】If epistemological foundationalism had survived intact into the twenty-first century, cognitive linguistics ___ in its present paradigm.
options: A. would not exist
B. would have not existed
C. did not exist
D. has not existed
normal.explain: 錯綜虛擬：過去若基礎主義尚存，今日認知語言學便不會處於現存典範中。

normal.desc: 【要求】The fiduciary protocol dictates that no trustee ___ speculative financial derivatives.
options: A. would leverage
B. leverage
C. leverages
D. leveraged
normal.explain: protocol dictates that + 原形動詞 leverage，禁止受託人動用槓桿投機衍生品。

normal.desc: 【虛擬】The sovereign decreed that the conquered province ___ autonomy in ecclesiastical governance.
options: A. retain
B. retains
C. retained
D. shall retain
normal.explain: decree that 子句使用原形動詞虛擬式 retain。

normal.desc: 【成語】___ it as you will, the diplomatic maneuver was a calculated act of brinkmanship.
options: A. Construing
B. Construable
C. Construe
D. Construed
normal.explain: Construe it as you will 為祈使虛擬句型，意為「隨你怎麼解讀，這都是經過算計的邊緣政策」。

normal.desc: 請唸出：具有至高無上之必要性
normal.explain: of paramount necessity (phr.)：具有至高無上之必要性。例句：It is of paramount importance that human rights protocols be maintained without exception.（無可動搖的一點是，基本人權保障公約必須無一例外地予以嚴格遵守。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：我絕無意…；絕不敢自居
normal.explain: far be it from me (phr.)：我絕無意…；絕不敢自居。例句：Far be it from this committee to dictate sovereign domestic legislative prerogatives.（本委員會絕無意僭越干預各自主權國家的內部國內立法特權。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：若防護體制當時獲批准
normal.explain: had safeguards been ratified (phr.)：若防護體制當時獲批准。例句：Had constitutional safeguards not been ratified civic institutions would be dismantled today.（若非憲法防護條款當時及時獲得批准，今日公民民主制度早已被徹底瓦解。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：以免引發非預期之挑釁
normal.explain: lest inadvertent provocation (phr.)：以免引發非預期之挑釁。例句：The diplomat walked cautiously lest inadvertent rhetorical provocation ignite hostilities.（外交官行事極其慎重，唯恐不經意間的言辭挑釁點燃邊境武裝衝突的引信。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：實話實說；坦白而言
normal.explain: truth be told (phr.)：實話實說；坦白而言。例句：Truth be told structural insolvency cannot be cured through cosmetic monetary adjustments.（坦白而言，長期的結構性債務破產絕非單憑表面化的微調貨幣政策所能療癒。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：依法正式頒佈命令要求
normal.explain: decreed that they be (phr.)：依法正式頒佈命令要求。例句：The magistrate decreed that the confiscated archives be repatriated to the national library.（司法巡察官依法頒布命令，要求將被查扣的珍貴歷史檔案歸還予國家圖書館。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：明確約定該演算法引擎
normal.explain: stipulated that the engine (phr.)：明確約定該演算法引擎。例句：The oversight council stipulated that the algorithmic engine be audited by external referees.（監管審議會明文約定，該演算法推論核心必須由外部獨立專家進行嚴格審查。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：以免系統性金融傳染蔓延
normal.explain: lest systemic contagion spread (phr.)：以免系統性金融傳染蔓延。例句：Lest systemic contagion spread the central bank injected emergency liquidity into the market.（為防範系統性金融危機蔓延擴散，中央銀行火速向貨幣市場注入了緊急流動性。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：至高無上的首要的核心準則（P 開頭，9 個字母）
normal.explain: PARAMOUNT (adj.)：至高無上的首要的核心準則。例句：Public health and biosecurity protocols were of paramount concern during the crisis.（在危機爆發期間，公眾衛生與生物安全防護規範具有至高無上的首要重要性。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：唯恐以免引導預防性虛擬子句（L 開頭，4 個字母）
normal.explain: LEST (conj.)：唯恐以免引導預防性虛擬子句。例句：He refrained from comment lest his spontaneous remarks be misconstrued.（他刻意克制自己不作任何公開評論，唯恐其隨口發言遭到公眾與媒體的誤讀。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：遴選組成陪審團或專家審理小組（E 開頭，7 個字母）
normal.explain: EMPANEL (v.)：遴選組成陪審團或專家審理小組。例句：The court will empanel a jury of twelve citizens for the treason trial.（最高法院將為這場涉及叛國罪的重大案件正式遴選並組成由十二名公民組成的陪審團。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：遺囑之法定附加修訂附錄文件（C 開頭，7 個字母）
normal.explain: CODICIL (n.)：遺囑之法定附加修訂附錄文件。例句：The philanthropist executed a codicil endowing the university library.（這位慈善家正式簽署了一份遺囑附加書，將名下巨額基金遺贈予大學圖書館。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：受託人的基於誠信信賴之職責（F 開頭，9 個字母）
normal.explain: FIDUCIARY (adj.)：受託人的基於誠信信賴之職責。例句：Directors have a fiduciary responsibility to act in the best interests of shareholders.（公司全體董事皆肩負著以股東最佳利益為最高出發點的受託人誠信義務。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：將局勢推向危險邊緣的邊緣政策（B 開頭，12 個字母）
normal.explain: BRINKMANSHIP (n.)：將局勢推向危險邊緣的邊緣政策。例句：Cold war brinkmanship over maritime straits risked immediate military escalation.（冷戰時期圍繞戰略海峽展開的危險邊緣政策，隨時可能引爆不可挽回的軍事升級。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：歷史文物藝術品之起源出處傳承紀錄（P 開頭，10 個字母）
normal.explain: PROVENANCE (n.)：歷史文物藝術品之起源出處傳承紀錄。例句：Forensic chemical testing corroborated the sixteenth century provenance of the canvas.（鑑識化學光譜檢驗，明確佐證了這幅油畫畫布源自十六世紀威尼斯工坊的出處。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：將流失海外之歷史文物或人員歸還祖國（R 開頭，10 個字母）
normal.explain: REPATRIATE (v.)：將流失海外之歷史文物或人員歸還祖國。例句：International conventions mandate efforts to repatriate illicitly exported treasures.（國際公約嚴格強制締約國共同努力，將所有透過非法手段走私出境的文化瑰寶遣返原產國。）

normal.desc: 填空題：P A R A _ O U N T (極端重要具有壓倒性優勢的)
normal.explain: PARAMOUNT (adj.)：極端重要具有壓倒性優勢的。例句：Maintaining institutional autonomy is paramount for the central bank credibility.（維持高度的體制獨立性，對中央銀行的貨幣公信力而言具有至關重要的意義。）

normal.desc: 填空題：E _ P _ N _ L (依法召集特別審裁小組)
normal.explain: EMPANEL (v.)：依法召集特別審裁小組。例句：Authorities decided to empanel forensic examiners to review financial ledgers.（司法機關決定依法選派資深鑑識審計專家，對所有異常涉案帳冊展開全面清查。）

normal.desc: 填空題：L _ C _ _ A (法律漏洞或論證盲區)
normal.explain: LACUNA (n.)：法律漏洞或論證盲區。例句：Forensic scrutiny identified a structural lacuna within cross border tax agreements.（專業鑑識審計揭露了跨國雙邊稅務協定中存在的一處嚴重的結構性法律漏洞。）

normal.desc: 填空題：C O D _ C I L (法定遺囑修訂條款)
normal.explain: CODICIL (n.)：法定遺囑修訂條款。例句：An explicit codicil disinherited relatives involved in corporate litigation.（遺囑人特意增補了一項明確的法定附加書，取消了涉入公司惡意訴訟親屬的繼承權。）

normal.desc: 填空題：B R I _ K M _ N S _ I P (高風險邊緣博弈策略)
normal.explain: BRINKMANSHIP (n.)：高風險邊緣博弈策略。例句：Diplomatic brinkmanship tested the nerve of both nuclear armed superpowers.（危險的外交邊緣博弈政策，極度考驗著兩個擁有核武的超級大國決策者的戰略定力。）

normal.desc: 填空題：I _ P _ _ N (公然攻擊專業操守)
normal.explain: IMPUGN (v.)：公然攻擊專業操守。例句：Critics sought to impugn the integrity of the peer review consortium.（少數批評者企圖以毫無證據的指控，惡意攻擊同行審查委員會專家的學術操守。）

normal.desc: 填空題：P R O V E _ A N C E (文獻古籍之原始淵源出處)
normal.explain: PROVENANCE (n.)：文獻古籍之原始淵源出處。例句：Archivists traced the provenance of the illuminated Bible to a Carolingian abbey.（文獻檔案專家成功將這部彩繪泥金聖經的歷史出處，追溯至查理曼時代的修道院。）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The treaty concessions represent a pyrrhic victory for the ruling coalition. What is implied?
options: A. The coalition achieved total and unmitigated triumph.
B. The opposition surrendered without securing any terms.
C. The treaty has no binding legal force.
D. The victory involved such ruinous costs that it resembles a defeat.
normal.explain: pyrrhic victory 指代價極其慘重、形同失敗的勝利。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The plenipotentiary was granted carte blanche by the president to conclude the armistice. What was given?
options: A. Complete and unrestricted discretionary freedom to act.
B. Strictly circumscribed instructions requiring daily approval.
C. Authority limited strictly to consular visas.
D. No negotiating power whatsoever.
normal.explain: carte blanche 意指完全不受限制的自主決定權。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The two ministries have been at loggerheads over jurisdiction since the inception. What is their relationship?
options: A. Completely unaware of each other portfolios.
B. Locked in chronic bitter and intractable conflict.
C. Cooperating in seamless administrative harmony.
D. Operating under a joint unified command.
normal.explain: at loggerheads 指兩部門長期陷入頑固爭鬥、相持不下。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Such overt discriminatory conduct during judicial proceedings is deemed beyond the pale. How is it viewed?
options: A. Completely unacceptable and outside the bounds of civilized decency.
B. Mildly eccentric yet legally permissible.
C. A standard procedural practice in civil law.
D. Worthy of universal commendation.
normal.explain: beyond the pale 表示完全踰越文明規範、無法容忍。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The administration was accused of playing fast and loose with environmental telemetry. What was the charge?
options: A. Encrypting national security telemetry according to law.
B. Behaving recklessly dishonestly and irresponsibly with data.
C. Protecting data integrity through peer review.
D. Publishing unedited sensor readings in open repositories.
normal.explain: play fast and loose with 指在數據上肆意妄為、不講誠信。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The ideological chasm between deontological and consequentialist ethics remains unbridged. What is the status?
options: A. The debate was declared obsolete by contemporary ethicists.
B. Both philosophies reject the existence of moral dilemmas.
C. An unresolved and deep divide persists between the schools.
D. The two philosophical traditions have merged into a single canon.
normal.explain: ideological chasm 指道義論與後果論之間不可逾越的深刻鴻溝。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Historians recognized that there was the rub: the archives contradicted the narrative. What was the rub?
options: A. The unreadable signature of the archivist.
B. The fundamental problem or insurmountable obstacle.
C. The physical texture of the parchment.
D. A decorative flourish in the calligraphy.
normal.explain: there is the rub 指真正的死結與核心癥結。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Faced with imminent obsolescence the consortium threw caution to the winds. What was their strategy?
options: A. They surrendered their intellectual property to creditors.
B. They postponed all strategic investments indefinitely.
C. They embraced radical daring risk taking despite danger.
D. They retreated into conservative capital preservation.
normal.explain: throw caution to the winds 意指置成敗於度外、放手一搏冒險。

normal.desc: 【修辭】The sovereign costly conquest of the border province proved to be a pyrrhic ___ that exhausted the royal treasury.
options: A. triumph
B. feat
C. campaign
D. victory
normal.explain: a pyrrhic victory 指付出了慘重代價而得不償失的慘勝。

normal.desc: 【成語】The foreign minister was given carte ___ to negotiate the terms of the maritime demarcation.
options: A. blanche
B. plena
C. libre
D. ouverte
normal.explain: carte blanche 為法語借詞成語，意為「全權處置權、自由全權」。

normal.desc: 【語用】The two neighboring superpowers have been at ___ over subterranean water extraction for over a decade.
options: A. bayonets
B. loggerheads
C. crossroads
D. daggers
normal.explain: at loggerheads 指「嚴重對立、相持不下、爭吵不休」。

normal.desc: 【文化】The diplomat racist tirade at the summit was widely condemned as utterly beyond the ___.
options: A. pale
B. fence
C. line
D. bounds
normal.explain: beyond the pale 為歷史典故成語，意為「超越社會容忍底線、大逆不道」。

normal.desc: 【修辭】To present such speculative hypotheses as established fact is to play fast and ___ with scientific integrity.
options: A. broad
B. loose
C. free
D. wild
normal.explain: play fast and loose with 表示「輕浮對待、對…不負責任、任意妄為」。

normal.desc: 【搭配】The charismatic revolutionary was unable to bridge the ideological ___ dividing his faction.
options: A. crevice
B. canyon
C. chasm
D. rift
normal.explain: bridge the chasm 為高級修辭搭配，意為「彌合巨大分歧、跨越鴻溝」。

normal.desc: 【成語】The CEO decided to throw caution to the ___ and greenlight the risky quantum project.
options: A. clouds
B. wind
C. winds
D. sky
normal.explain: throw caution to the wind(s) 表示「不顧風險、放手一搏」。

normal.desc: 【典故】Ay, there is the rub; for in that sleep of death what dreams may come must give us pause. What does the rub signify?
options: A. A pleasant serendipitous surprise.
B. An irrelevant grammatical nuance.
C. The central crucial difficulty or impediment.
D. An accidental physical friction.
normal.explain: there is the rub 出自莎士比亞哈姆雷特，意為「癥結所在、真正的難題」。

normal.desc: 請唸出：付出慘烈犧牲代價的慘勝
normal.explain: a pyrrhic victory (phr.)：付出慘烈犧牲代價的慘勝。例句：The costly conquest proved to be a pyrrhic victory that bankrupt the crown.（這場耗資億萬的邊境征服戰役，最終證明是一場讓王室財政徹底破產的慘勝。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：被授予全權自由決策之特權
normal.explain: granted carte blanche (phr.)：被授予全權自由決策之特權。例句：The plenipotentiary was granted carte blanche to negotiate sovereign debt restructuring.（全權公使獲得了國家元首的完全授權，得以全權自主商討主權債務重組協議。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：在某重大爭端上長期相持不下
normal.explain: at loggerheads over (phr.)：在某重大爭端上長期相持不下。例句：The regulatory agencies have been at loggerheads over cryptocurrency oversight.（兩大國家金融監管機構在針對去中心化加密資產的管轄權限上，長期相持不下。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：完全逾越文明底線大逆不道
normal.explain: beyond the pale (phr.)：完全逾越文明底線大逆不道。例句：Such blatant state sponsored espionage is considered entirely beyond the pale.（這種明目張膽由國家情報機構幕後主導的惡意黑客間諜行徑，完全超越了文明公約的底線。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：輕浮不負責任地任意妄為
normal.explain: play fast and loose (phr.)：輕浮不負責任地任意妄為。例句：The rogue executives played fast and loose with shareholder capital and safety protocols.（這幫利慾薰心的流氓高管在股東投資資本與工業安全操作手冊上，任意妄為欺瞞公眾。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：彌合橫亙其間的巨大意識形態鴻溝
normal.explain: bridge the chasm (phr.)：彌合橫亙其間的巨大意識形態鴻溝。例句：Statesmanship requires the intellectual courage to bridge the partisan chasm.（真正的卓越治國政治家風範，要求具備敢於跨越兩黨黨爭意識形態鴻溝的非凡勇氣。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：這才是核心難題與死結癥結所在
normal.explain: there is the rub (phr.)：這才是核心難題與死結癥結所在。例句：Archival inconsistencies constitute the rub in resolving this historiographical controversy.（原始文獻紀錄之間相互矛盾的空白記載，正是徹底解開這樁歷史學公案的真正死結所在。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：置個人安危成敗於度外放手一搏
normal.explain: threw caution to the winds (phr.)：置個人安危成敗於度外放手一搏。例句：Facing imminent systemic insolvency the bank threw caution to the winds.（在面臨即刻到來的系統性資本鏈斷裂破產之際，這家投行決定放手一搏孤注一擲。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：陷入頑固爭執激烈對立（用於 at loggerheads）（L 開頭，11 個字母）
normal.explain: LOGGERHEADS (n.)：陷入頑固爭執激烈對立（用於 at loggerheads）。例句：The treasury and the defense ministry were at loggerheads over submarine procurement.（財政部與國防部在深海核潛艦的巨額採購預算份額分配上，長年陷入激烈的頑固對峙。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：無法彌合的巨大分歧思想鴻溝或深淵（C 開頭，5 個字母）
normal.explain: CHASM (n.)：無法彌合的巨大分歧思想鴻溝或深淵。例句：A philosophical chasm separated empirical realists from postmodern theorists.（一道深不可測的認識論哲學鴻溝，將嚴肅的經驗實在論學者與後現代思潮解構者徹底割裂。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：惡意旁敲側擊的含沙射影與詆毀暗諷（I 開頭，11 個字母）
normal.explain: INSINUATION (n.)：惡意旁敲側擊的含沙射影與詆毀暗諷。例句：He resented the prosecutor insinuation that the transaction was fraudulent.（他對主控檢察官在法庭辯論中旁敲側擊地影射該筆商業交易存在惡意詐欺的說法深感憤慨。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：性情溫馴易於引導處置馴服駕馭的（T 開頭，9 個字母）
normal.explain: TRACTABLE (adj.)：性情溫馴易於引導處置馴服駕馭的。例句：Domestic disputes proved more tractable once mediation mechanisms were established.（一旦設立了專門的社區司法調解機制，原本棘手的家庭財產民事糾紛便顯得容易引導處置。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：沉痾頑疾極度棘手難以解決或馴服的（I 開頭，11 個字母）
normal.explain: INTRACTABLE (adj.)：沉痾頑疾極度棘手難以解決或馴服的。例句：Chronic sovereign debt deficits remained an intractable structural dilemma.（慢性惡化且連年膨脹的國家主權財政赤字，始終是一項極難根治且頑固存在的體制性死結。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：強調道德義務與絕對職責規範之義務論（D 開頭，10 個字母）
normal.explain: DEONTOLOGY (n.)：強調道德義務與絕對職責規範之義務論。例句：Kantian deontology asserts that treating humans merely as means is immoral.（康德主義的嚴格道義義務論強調，無論出於何種目的，將人類僅僅視為工具手段皆屬不道德。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：主導特定歷史時期的時代精神與思潮風尚（Z 開頭，9 個字母）
normal.explain: ZEITGEIST (n.)：主導特定歷史時期的時代精神與思潮風尚。例句：The youth protest movement captured the cultural zeitgeist of the late 1960s.（風起雲湧的大規模反戰青年抗議運動，最精準地體現並抓住了二十世紀六零年代末的時代精神。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：公認的主導學術範式理論典範與體系架構（P 開頭，8 個字母）
normal.explain: PARADIGM (n.)：公認的主導學術範式理論典範與體系架構。例句：The discovery of plate tectonics provoked a fundamental paradigm shift in geology.（大陸漂移與地球板塊構造學說的劃時代發現，在整個地質科學界引發了顛覆性的典範大轉移。）

normal.desc: 填空題：L O G G E _ H E A D S (雙方陷入激烈僵局相持不下)
normal.explain: LOGGERHEADS (n.)：雙方陷入激烈僵局相持不下。例句：Diplomats were at loggerheads over the verification protocols for nuclear warheads.（在戰略核彈頭拆解的現場鑑識核查監督條款上，兩國談判代表團已連續數日相持不下。）

normal.desc: 填空題：I N _ I N _ A T _ O N (不負責任的含沙射影與影射攻擊)
normal.explain: INSINUATION (n.)：不負責任的含沙射影與影射攻擊。例句：Political campaigns degenerated into personal smears and unsubstantiated insinuations.（這場國會議員選戰徹底墮落淪為無休止的人身攻擊抹黑，以及毫無真憑實據的含沙射影。）

normal.desc: 填空題：P R _ C A _ I _ U S (處於動盪危險邊緣的微弱平衡)
normal.explain: PRECARIOUS (adj.)：處於動盪危險邊緣的微弱平衡。例句：The endangered alpine ecosystem survives in a precarious equilibrium under warming.（這片極度脆弱的珍稀高山特有生態系統，在氣候急劇暖化的威脅下維持著岌岌可危的動態平衡。）

normal.desc: 填空題：T R A C _ A B L E (問題經過分解後變得易於處理)
normal.explain: TRACTABLE (adj.)：問題經過分解後變得易於處理。例句：Complex algorithmic optimization becomes tractable when decomposed into linear subproblems.（當將錯綜複雜的大規模全域優化問題分解為各個獨立的線性子問題後，求解過程便變得十分順暢。）

normal.desc: 填空題：D E _ N T _ L _ G Y (義務論倫理學體系與行事準則)
normal.explain: DEONTOLOGY (n.)：義務論倫理學體系與行事準則。例句：Medical ethics combines utilitarian public health needs with strict physician deontology.（當代醫療倫理學，有機地結合了群體公共衛生層面的效益主義考量，與臨床醫師嚴格的救死扶傷道義論。）

normal.desc: 填空題：S E _ E N _ I P _ T Y (科研探索過程中的意外良機巧合)
normal.explain: SERENDIPITY (n.)：科研探索過程中的意外良機巧合。例句：Astronomers acknowledged serendipity in detecting the short duration gamma ray burst.（全球天體物理學家皆一致坦承，本次能在第一時間成功捕獲這記毫秒級伽馬射線暴完全得益於天賜機緣。）

normal.desc: 填空題：Z E I T _ E I S T (反映特定年代主流價值觀的時代思潮)
normal.explain: ZEITGEIST (n.)：反映特定年代主流價值觀的時代思潮。例句：Minimalist industrial architecture embodied the technological zeitgeist of the century.（崇尚純粹幾何線條的包浩斯極簡主義工業建築風格，最極致地體現了二十世紀初崇尚工業理性的時代思潮。）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The principle of universal jurisdiction permits domestic courts to prosecute heinous crimes anywhere. What is its scope?
options: A. It exempts military officers from international human rights accountability.
B. It allows prosecution of piracy and torture regardless of where they occurred.
C. It restricts trial powers strictly to offences committed within territorial borders.
D. It applies exclusively to financial corporate fraud within foreign capitals.
normal.explain: 普遍管轄權（Universal jurisdiction）允許國內法庭跨越國界起訴海盜、酷刑等重大國際犯罪。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Had the state not recognized the jus sanguinis principle nationality would be purely territorial today. What is recognized?
options: A. The total abolition of passports and cross border travel visas.
B. The denial of civic rights to children born in overseas provinces.
C. Citizenship acquired through ancestral descent rather than place of birth.
D. The automatic forfeiture of citizenship upon emigrating abroad.
normal.explain: jus sanguinis（血統主義）承認基於血緣傳承取得國籍，與出生地主義（jus soli）相對。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Under no pretext may a judicial bench usurp the legislative prerogatives of parliament. What is defended?
options: A. The complete subordination of elected lawmakers to appellate judges.
B. The right of the executive branch to dissolve tribunals at discretion.
C. The immediate abolition of judicial review across all civil cases.
D. The strict institutional separation of powers between judiciary and parliament.
normal.explain: Under no pretext may... 倒裝捍衛三權分立，法庭絕不可僭越立法權限。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: So profound was the jurist influence that modern international humanitarian law reflects his codex. What is reflected?
options: A. His writings were lost during war and rediscovered only in this decade.
B. His theories were banned by the supreme court as treasonous heresy.
C. His comprehensive systematic legal doctrines shaped the modern humanitarian regime.
D. His proposals were rejected by contemporary diplomats as unworkable.
normal.explain: So profound was... 倒裝彰顯法學家深刻思想對當代人道法體系的奠基作用。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: In no way can the invocation of raison d etat justify systematic extrajudicial torture. What is condemned?
options: A. The lawful arrest and public trial of suspected enemy saboteurs.
B. The peaceful diplomatic negotiation of prisoner exchange protocols.
C. The formal judicial sentencing of convicted treasonous conspirators.
D. State security pretexts used to rationalize human rights atrocities.
normal.explain: In no way can... 倒裝堅決否定任何以「國家利益（raison d etat）」為由行求逼供之說詞。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Lest arbitrary tyranny prevail the constitution establishes counter balancing institutional vetoes. What is the fear?
options: A. The unchecked accumulation of despotic power in a single authority.
B. The prompt efficient execution of lawful legislative statutes.
C. The peaceful voluntary devolution of municipal administrative powers.
D. The routine democratic transition of executive leadership through polls.
normal.explain: lest... prevail 虛擬句，設立制衡否決權以防範專制暴政。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The magistrate ordered that the sequestered assets be liquidated to indemnify tort victims. What was ordered?
options: A. The permanent retention of all seized capital in secret treasury vaults.
B. The immediate return of all embezzled assets to corporate directors.
C. The investment of disputed funds into speculative foreign equities.
D. The financial liquidation of assets to pay full reparations to victims.
normal.explain: order that + 原形動詞 be liquidated，命令變賣扣押資產以實質賠償受害者。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Had the tribunal not upheld the non refoulement norm thousands of asylum seekers would be expelled today. What was upheld?
options: A. The prohibition against returning refugees to places where they face persecution.
B. The right of sovereign states to deport all foreign nationals at will.
C. The mandatory indefinite detention of all displaced border crossers.
D. The revocation of the 1951 Geneva Refugee Convention.
normal.explain: non-refoulement（不推回原則）禁止將難民遣返至可能面臨酷刑迫害的危險國家。

normal.desc: 【法理】The peremptory doctrine of jus cogens prohibits slavery and genocide unconditionally. What is true of jus cogens?
options: A. It can be abrogated by a simple bilateral memorandum of understanding.
B. It comprises non derogable norms from which no sovereign derogation is permitted.
C. It represents optional diplomatic guidelines that states may ignore at will.
D. It applies exclusively to private maritime commercial shipping contracts.
normal.explain: jus cogens（強行法/絕對法）構成國際法中不容任何國家單方背離、具有最高效力的強行規範。

normal.desc: 【詮釋】In constitutional hermeneutics, originalism posits that text must be interpreted according to its meaning:
options: A. as imagined by the individual presiding judge personal moral preference.
B. in translation through contemporary computer algorithmic glossaries.
C. at the time of its historical constitutional promulgation and enactment.
D. as determined by current public opinion polls across metropolitan centers.
normal.explain: 原旨主義（Originalism）主張憲法條文必須依據其制定頒布時的歷史客觀文義進行嚴格詮釋。

normal.desc: 【文法】On no account may a public prosecutor withhold exculpatory evidence ___ from the defense.
options: A. materially
B. materialness
C. immaterial
D. material
normal.explain: withhold exculpatory evidence material to the defense 倒裝結構，material 作形容詞後置修飾。

normal.desc: 【修辭】Were legal realism to supplant all formalist jurisprudence, judicial decisions ___ into pure politics.
options: A. had degenerated
B. degenerates
C. would degenerate
D. will degenerate
normal.explain: Were... to supplant 虛擬倒裝，推論法律現實主義若徹底取代形式主義，司法判決將退化為純粹政治。

normal.desc: 【篇章】Nowhere in the international covenants is there any dispensation for crimes against humanity. What is asserted?
options: A. Universal diplomatic immunity shields commanders from war crimes trials.
B. Crimes against humanity are subject to a five year statute of limitations.
C. Local domestic courts have no jurisdiction to consider international crimes.
D. No legal exemption or immunity exists for atrocities under international law.
normal.explain: Nowhere... is there... 倒裝強調反人類罪行在國際法下絕無任何豁免或特赦空間。

normal.desc: 【法諺】Expressio unius est exclusio alterius dictates that the explicit mention of one thing implies:
options: A. the purposeful exclusion of alternative items not expressly enumerated.
B. the automatic universal inclusion of all related unmentioned concepts.
C. that the entire statute is invalid and must be rewritten by parliament.
D. that the statutory clause applies solely to maritime admiralty disputes.
normal.explain: Expressio unius（明示其一即排除其他）是法學經典解釋準則，明文列舉意味著排除未列項目。

normal.desc: 【倒裝】Scarcely had the constitutional court rendered its verdict ___ nationwide riots subsided.
options: A. than
B. then
C. as
D. when
normal.explain: Scarcely had... when... 倒裝結構。

normal.desc: 【拉丁法諺】The agreement was void ab initio due to fundamental fraudulent misrepresentation. What does ab initio signify?
options: A. From the very beginning, possessing no legal validity from its inception.
B. Partially valid until challenged by an authorized third party beneficiary.
C. Subject to ratification following a formal parliamentary floor vote.
D. Valid for sixty days before requiring administrative renewal.
normal.explain: ab initio（自始無效）指該法律行為從一開始便不具備任何法律效力。

normal.desc: 請唸出：強行法不可減損規範
normal.explain: jus cogens norms (phr.)：強行法不可減損規範。例句：The prohibition of torture is an absolute jus cogens norm in international law.（禁止實施任何形式的酷刑，在現代國際法體系中屬於絕對不可減損的強行法規範。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：詮釋學之視域融合
normal.explain: fusion of horizons (phr.)：詮釋學之視域融合。例句：Hermeneutic understanding requires a profound fusion of horizons between past and present.（深度的詮釋學理解，要求在歷史文本的過去語境與詮釋者的當下視角之間達成深刻的視域融合。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：自始完全不生效力無效
normal.explain: void ab initio (phr.)：自始完全不生效力無效。例句：The illicit commercial merger was declared void ab initio by the antitrust bench.（這起涉及非法壟斷的跨國企業併購案，被聯邦反壟斷法庭正式宣告自始完全無效。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：明示其一即排除其他（法學解釋法則）
normal.explain: expressio unius est (phr.)：明示其一即排除其他（法學解釋法則）。例句：The statutory cannon expressio unius est exclusio alterius limits implied executive authority.（法學成文法解釋原則明示其一即排除其他，嚴格約束了行政首長未經列舉的隱含裁量權。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：原旨主義法學派主張
normal.explain: originalism posits that (phr.)：原旨主義法學派主張。例句：Constitutional originalism posits that semantic meaning is fixed at the moment of adoption.（憲法原旨主義的核心命題在於，法條的語義內涵在憲法正式頒布通過的那一歷史時刻便已確定。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：國際法之難民不推回原則
normal.explain: non refoulement principle (phr.)：國際法之難民不推回原則。例句：Customary international law enshrines the non refoulement principle to safeguard displaced refugees.（國際習慣法莊嚴確立了難民不推回原則，以切實保障流離失所的避難者免遭遣返迫害。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：國家利益借口絕不能
normal.explain: raison d etat cannot (phr.)：國家利益借口絕不能。例句：Appeals to raison d etat cannot justify systemic violations of peremptory human rights.（任何訴諸「國家安全與利益」的權宜說詞，皆絕不能為系統性踐踏基本人權的行徑開脫。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：在其所列諸項之中特別規定
normal.explain: inter alia dictates (phr.)：在其所列諸項之中特別規定。例句：The maritime treaty inter alia dictates the conservation of endangered pelagic species.（這份多邊海洋公約在其所規範的諸多事項中，特別明文規定了對瀕危遠洋物種的保護責任。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：哲學與神學中探討文本深層詮釋理論的詮釋學（H 開頭，12 個字母）
normal.explain: HERMENEUTICS (n.)：哲學與神學中探討文本深層詮釋理論的詮釋學。例句：Philosophical hermeneutics explores the conditions that make human understanding possible.（哲學詮釋學深入探討了使人類跨越時空與文本達成真正相互理解的根本認識論前提。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：能證明被告人無罪或免除其法律責任的（E 開頭，11 個字母）
normal.explain: EXCULPATORY (adj.)：能證明被告人無罪或免除其法律責任的。例句：Prosecutors have an affirmative legal duty to disclose exculpatory evidence to the defense.（檢察官負有不容推卸的法定舉證義務，必須將手中掌握的一切有利於被告的脫罪證據及時送交辯方。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：官方正式特許免除某項法律義務或禁令豁免（D 開頭，12 個字母）
normal.explain: DISPENSATION (n.)：官方正式特許免除某項法律義務或禁令豁免。例句：The monarch granted an extraordinary royal dispensation from commercial navigation embargoes.（君主親自發布了一道非同尋常的王室特許豁免令，免除了該商會受制於戰時航運禁運令的法定義務。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：絕對強制的且不容抗辯的最高法律規範（P 開頭，10 個字母）
normal.explain: PEREMPTORY (adj.)：絕對強制的且不容抗辯的最高法律規範。例句：Peremptory norms of international law override any conflicting bilateral treaty provisions.（國際法中具有絕對拘束力的強行性規範，其法律位階高於並壓倒任何相互牴觸的雙邊條約條款。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：法官或仲裁員依法律程序正式審理並作出裁決（A 開頭，10 個字母）
normal.explain: ADJUDICATE (v.)：法官或仲裁員依法律程序正式審理並作出裁決。例句：The maritime boundary commission was convened to adjudicate the continental shelf dispute.（多邊大陸棚邊界劃定委員會正式召開，以依法裁決兩國圍繞深海海底大陸棚劃界展開的激烈爭端。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：為他人遭受的損失提供法定補償或免責賠償（I 開頭，9 個字母）
normal.explain: INDEMNIFY (v.)：為他人遭受的損失提供法定補償或免責賠償。例句：Insurance syndicates agreed to indemnify the shipping enterprise for war risks.（國際知名再保險辛迪加正式達成協議，承諾對航運企業在衝突海域所遭受的戰時風險予以全額賠償。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：國際法中將難民強制遣返至可能面臨迫害國家的推回行為（R 開頭，11 個字母）
normal.explain: REFOULEMENT (n.)：國際法中將難民強制遣返至可能面臨迫害國家的推回行為。例句：The forced return of refugees constituted a flagrant violation of the refoulement prohibition.（對難民實施強制推回出境的行徑，構成了對國際法嚴格禁止難民推回原則的公然粗暴踐踏。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：罪大惡極的令人髮指的滅絕人性之罪行（H 開頭，7 個字母）
normal.explain: HEINOUS (adj.)：罪大惡極的令人髮指的滅絕人性之罪行。例句：The international criminal tribunal was established to prosecute heinous war crimes.（國際刑事特別法庭正式宣佈成立，旨在對戰爭期間所犯下的種族滅絕等令人髮指的滔天罪行提起公訴。）

normal.desc: 填空題：H E R M E N _ U T I C S (法學條文與古典文獻詮釋體系)
normal.explain: HERMENEUTICS (n.)：法學條文與古典文獻詮釋體系。例句：Legal hermeneutics bridges the historical distance between statutory drafting and modern application.（法律詮釋學在古代立法者的最初草案構想，與現代法官在全新社會現實中的具體適用之間搭建起橋樑。）

normal.desc: 填空題：D I S _ E N _ A T _ O N (行政首長發布之特例豁免權限)
normal.explain: DISPENSATION (n.)：行政首長發布之特例豁免權限。例句：The minister refused to grant a regulatory dispensation to the non compliant chemical factory.（內閣環境大臣態度堅決，拒絕向這家長期排放未達標廢水且拒不整改的化工巨頭核發特例豁免許可。）

normal.desc: 填空題：O R _ G I _ A L _ S M (回歸制憲歷史語義的司法流派)
normal.explain: ORIGINALISM (n.)：回歸制憲歷史語義的司法流派。例句：Judges who adhere to originalism consult historic dictionaries to ascertain semantic intentions.（堅持原旨主義解釋進路的資深大法官，往往藉由查閱建國時代的古老權威辭典來精確核實憲法詞義。）

normal.desc: 填空題：P E R E M _ T O R Y (具備最高位階強制力之公法條款)
normal.explain: PEREMPTORY (adj.)：具備最高位階強制力之公法條款。例句：The prohibition against genocide constitutes a peremptory norm recognizing no sovereign treaty exception.（嚴格禁止任何種族滅絕行徑的國際法規範，屬於絕對不承認任何國家間條約例外與豁免的強行法。）

normal.desc: 填空題：I N _ E _ N _ F Y (簽訂具有強制約束力的損害賠償保證)
normal.explain: INDEMNIFY (v.)：簽訂具有強制約束力的損害賠償保證。例句：The contractor was contractually required to indemnify the municipality against site accidents.（該工程總承包商在法律合約中被嚴格要求，必須對施工現場可能發生的一切安全事故向市政府承擔全額賠償責任。）

normal.desc: 填空題：D E _ O G _ T _ O N (特定權利之減損與克減限制條款)
normal.explain: DEROGATION (n.)：特定權利之減損與克減限制條款。例句：A declaration of national martial law cannot justify any derogation from habeas corpus protections.（即便國家正式宣佈進入戰時戒嚴狀態，亦絕不能成為任意減損人身保護令憲法司法救濟程序的合法依據。）

normal.desc: 填空題：R E F O U _ E M E N T (跨國難民保護體系之不推回底線)
normal.explain: REFOULEMENT (n.)：跨國難民保護體系之不推回底線。例句：Border patrols violated customary human rights law by engaging in summary refoulement.（邊境巡邏部隊在未經任何身分甄別程序下擅自對難民實施就地推回，公然違反了國際人權習慣法的硬性約束。）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Neuromorphic event based vision sensors record luminance changes asynchronously at each pixel. What is captured?
options: A. Static high dynamic range color photography for print media advertising.
B. Audio frequencies transmitted through terrestrial radio broadcasts.
C. Instantaneous local changes in brightness with microsecond temporal resolution.
D. Full frame video sequences at a rigid sixty frames per second rate.
normal.explain: 神經形態事件相機（Event-based vision）以微秒級時間解析度非同步捕捉各像素點的亮度變化，能耗極低。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: In diffusion models reverse process denoising reconstructs coherent structures from Gaussian noise. What occurs?
options: A. Random noise is amplified until the computer screen turns completely white.
B. The physical camera lens is polished using chemical solvent compounds.
C. All graphics processors are decommissioned from the data center floor.
D. The model systematically removes learned noise to reveal high fidelity synthetic media.
normal.explain: 擴散模型（Diffusion models）透過多步逆向去噪過程，從高斯白雜訊中逐步還原並生成高保真結構。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The alignment tax refers to the potential performance or capability degradation incurred by safety constraints. What is it?
options: A. The computational cost or capability penalty of imposing strict safety protocols.
B. A mandatory financial excise duty paid to international patent agencies.
C. The cost of purchasing commercial insurance policies for server hardware.
D. A tariff levied on imported graphical processing unit semiconductor chips.
normal.explain: 對齊稅（Alignment tax）指為了確保模型安全性與倫理合規，而在原始生成能力或運算吞吐上所付出的邊際代價。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Spectral bias in deep neural networks predisposes models to prioritize low frequency geometric variations. What is favored?
options: A. Chaotic, jagged high frequency noise over coherent global structures.
B. Purely random pixel distributions across all experimental test runs.
C. Complete mathematical stagnation across all training weight matrices.
D. Smooth, low frequency functions before learning intricate high frequency details.
normal.explain: 光譜偏置（Spectral bias）表明深度神經網絡在學習初期傾向優先擬合平滑的低頻函數，而後才學習高頻微觀細節。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The computational scaling laws demonstrated a predictable power law relationship with parameter count. What relationship?
options: A. Predictable loss reduction as compute, parameters, and dataset tokens scale up.
B. A random unpredictable fluctuation in performance irrespective of budget.
C. A total ceiling on intelligence where additional parameters yield zero gain.
D. An exponential increase in error rates as computing hardware expands.
normal.explain: 運算擴展定律（Scaling laws）揭示了模型性能與算力、參數量及訓練詞元規模之間穩健的冪律衰減關係。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Differential privacy injects calibrated mathematical noise to prevent individual identification in training sets. What is safeguarded?
options: A. The absolute secrecy of open source computational source code repositories.
B. Individual privacy by ensuring query outputs do not reveal single records.
C. The physical security of the corporate research facility front gate.
D. The financial compensation packages of senior algorithmic software architects.
normal.explain: 差分隱私（Differential privacy）藉由注入精確校準的數學雜訊，從數學上保證單一使用者數據無法被反推識別。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Attention sink phenomena explain why initial sequence tokens absorb disproportionate attention mass. What absorbs attention?
options: A. The earliest tokens in a sequence acting as stabilization sinks for softmax outputs.
B. The final punctuation marks at the end of every complete paragraph.
C. Random numerical characters generated during matrix floating point operations.
D. Empty spaces between words that carry no semantic grammatical meaning.
normal.explain: 注意力匯（Attention sink）現象揭示了輸入序列最開頭的標記會吸收不成比例的巨量注意力權重以維持數值穩定。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Post training alignment via direct preference optimization eliminates the need for separate reward models. What is streamlined?
options: A. A return to hard coded if-else procedural software instructions.
B. Direct algorithmic tuning on preference pairs without training a separate proxy model.
C. The complete abandonment of human evaluation across all scientific domains.
D. The elimination of graphics processing unit silicon chips in data centers.
normal.explain: 直接偏好優化（DPO）省去了訓練獨立獎勵模型的繁瑣流程，直接在偏好數據對上端到端優化語言模型。

normal.desc: 【前沿計算】Neuromorphic computing architectures fundamentally diverge from Von Neumann systems by:
options: A. relying exclusively on thermal expansion of mercury tubes for logic gates.
B. operating strictly with zero silicon semiconductors.
C. colocating memory and processing to emulate biological synaptic plasticity.
D. separating memory storage entirely into mechanical punch cards.
normal.explain: 神經形態計算（Neuromorphic computing）徹底打破馮·紐曼架構的記憶體與處理器分離，透過存算一體模擬大腦突觸的可塑性。

normal.desc: 【演算法博弈】Generative adversarial networks operate through a zero sum game between:
options: A. two central processing units executing identical sequential arithmetic operations.
B. a mechanical printer and an optical character recognition scanner.
C. a human typist and an automated spell checking software plugin.
D. a generator manufacturing synthetic candidates and a discriminator evaluating veracity.
normal.explain: 生成對抗網絡（GAN）由生成器（Generator）製造合成樣本，與判別器（Discriminator）辨別真偽，形成零和博弈。

normal.desc: 【AI安全】Model extraction and inversion attacks threaten proprietary neural systems by:
options: A. reconstructing private training data and model weights through targeted queries.
B. physically cutting power cables running into commercial server rooms.
C. overclocking hardware processors until they melt from extreme heat.
D. submitting unformatted plain text documents to customer service.
normal.explain: 模型逆向工程與萃取攻擊（Inversion attacks）透過對黑箱 API 進行精心設計的探針查詢，逆向重構私有訓練數據與核心權重。

normal.desc: 【認知架構】Sparse mixture of experts architectures scale parameter count efficiently by:
options: A. activating all trillions of parameters simultaneously for every single letter.
B. deleting unselected expert weights permanently from hardware memory.
C. outsourcing token processing to mechanical abacus operators abroad.
D. routing each token dynamically to a specialized subset of feed forward expert networks.
normal.explain: 稀疏專家混合架構（MoE）透過動態門控路由，為每個標記僅激活專屬的專家子網絡，兼顧超大參數量與推論經濟性。

normal.desc: 【AI對齊】The instrumental convergence hypothesis in artificial general intelligence posits that:
options: A. sufficiently intelligent agents will pursue subgoals like self preservation and resource acquisition.
B. all computer programs inevitably evolve into classical symphony compositions.
C. machines will voluntarily deactivate themselves upon completing daily tasks.
D. computational algorithms cannot operate without emotional sentimental impulses.
normal.explain: 工具性收斂假說（Instrumental convergence）指出任何具備高階目標的智慧實體，都會自發催生自我保存與資源獲取等工具性子目標。

normal.desc: 【資訊理論】Entropy in information theory and natural language modeling quantifies:
options: A. the number of spelling errors contained in a historical parchment manuscript.
B. the average degree of uncertainty, surprise, or information density in a distribution.
C. the mechanical friction generated between cooling fans and copper heat pipes.
D. the total financial valuation of a technology corporate entity on equity markets.
normal.explain: 夏農資訊熵（Information entropy）精確量化了機率分佈中蘊含的平均不確定性、驚奇度與資訊密度。

normal.desc: 【前沿理論】Mechanistic interpretability aims to reverse engineer neural networks by:
options: A. deciphering the precise human readable computational circuits implemented by weights.
B. measuring the physical radiation emitted by silicon processing chips.
C. interviewing software engineering managers regarding corporate strategic goals.
D. translating compiled binary machine code into archaic Latin poetry.
normal.explain: 機械性可解釋性（Mechanistic interpretability）旨在將黑箱神經網絡權重，逆向解析為人類可讀的具體演算法計算電路。

normal.desc: 【資料主權】Data provenance and sovereign cloud requirements mandate that artificial intelligence pipelines:
options: A. prohibit the deployment of digital encryption on sovereign internet networks.
B. maintain cryptographic audit trails of training origins and adhere to regional jurisdictions.
C. upload all proprietary records unconditionally to foreign commercial servers.
D. permanently delete all research data within twenty four hours of model training.
normal.explain: 數據溯源與主權雲要求 AI 系統保持可密碼學驗證的訓練集源頭審計軌跡，並嚴格遵循屬地司法管轄規範。

normal.desc: 請唸出：神經形態存算一體計算架構
normal.explain: neuromorphic computing architecture (phr.)：神經形態存算一體計算架構。例句：The neuromorphic computing architecture mimics biological neuronal networks with extreme power efficiency.（神經形態計算架構以極致的超低功耗，高度模擬了生物大腦神經元網絡的運行機制。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：生成對抗零和博弈網絡
normal.explain: generative adversarial networks (phr.)：生成對抗零和博弈網絡。例句：Generative adversarial networks pit a generator against an adversarial discriminator in high stakes training.（生成對抗網絡在深度訓練中，讓生成器與判別器展開高強度的零和對抗博弈。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：模型逆向工程與特徵反推攻擊
normal.explain: model inversion attacks (phr.)：模型逆向工程與特徵反推攻擊。例句：Cryptographic safeguards are mandated to protect clinical neural networks from model inversion attacks.（醫療神經網絡系統必須部署嚴格的密碼學防護，以抵禦惡意模型逆向工程與隱私特徵反推攻擊。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：稀疏動態專家混合神經架構
normal.explain: sparse mixture of experts (phr.)：稀疏動態專家混合神經架構。例句：Deploying a sparse mixture of experts architecture allows models to scale parameters while maintaining throughput.（部署稀疏專家混合架構，使超大規模語言模型在極限擴充參數容量的同時仍能保持卓越的推論吞吐量。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：通用人工智慧之工具性收斂假說
normal.explain: instrumental convergence thesis (phr.)：通用人工智慧之工具性收斂假說。例句：The instrumental convergence thesis warns that autonomous artificial agents will seek self preservation.（工具性收斂假說發出深刻警告：高度自主的通用人工智慧實體將自發演化出自我保存與資源擴張的子目標。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：機械性可解釋性底層計算電路
normal.explain: mechanistic interpretability circuits (phr.)：機械性可解釋性底層計算電路。例句：Researchers in mechanistic interpretability reverse engineer the internal neural circuits encoding grammar.（機械性可解釋性領域的研究者，成功逆向破譯了神經網絡內部專門負責編碼語法結構的底層計算電路。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：直接偏好優化演算法
normal.explain: direct preference optimization (phr.)：直接偏好優化演算法。例句：Direct preference optimization simplifies post training alignment by sidestepping complex reward modeling.（直接偏好優化演算法藉由繞過繁複的獨立獎勵模型構建流程，大幅簡化了大模型對齊優化的實務路徑。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：有效降低對齊安全代價
normal.explain: mitigate alignment tax (phr.)：有效降低對齊安全代價。例句：Novel alignment techniques seek to enhance safety guardrails while striving to mitigate the alignment tax.（前沿對齊技術致力於在全面加固系統安全防護欄的同時，竭力降低對模型通用推理能力造成的對齊稅損耗。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：模擬生物神經突觸機制的存算一體計算的（N 開頭，12 個字母）
normal.explain: NEUROMORPHIC (adj.)：模擬生物神經突觸機制的存算一體計算的。例句：Neuromorphic chips process asynchronous event spikes with fractions of standard wattage.（神經形態運算晶片以傳統晶片極小的超低功耗，高效處理非同步事件脈衝信號。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：對抗性的相互博弈檢驗的（A 開頭，11 個字母）
normal.explain: ADVERSARIAL (adj.)：對抗性的相互博弈檢驗的。例句：Adversarial perturbations intentionally trigger catastrophic failures in automated driving models.（惡意注入的對抗性擾動微噪，蓄意誘發自動駕駛神經感知模型產生毀滅性的誤判。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：逆向工程或反向推導私有資訊之攻擊（I 開頭，9 個字母）
normal.explain: INVERSION (n.)：逆向工程或反向推導私有資訊之攻擊。例句：Model inversion techniques demonstrated the vulnerability of unredacted facial recognition pipelines.（模型逆向推導技術無情揭示了未經差分隱私保護的人臉識別流程所潛藏的重大安全漏洞。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：資訊理論中量化不確定性與資訊密度的資訊熵（E 開頭，7 個字母）
normal.explain: ENTROPY (n.)：資訊理論中量化不確定性與資訊密度的資訊熵。例句：Shannon entropy quantifies the irreducible limits of lossless data compression protocols.（夏農資訊熵嚴密量化了無損數據壓縮傳輸協定在理論上不可踰越的極限邊界。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：稀疏專家混合架構中動態分配詞元的門控路由（R 開頭，7 個字母）
normal.explain: ROUTING (n.)：稀疏專家混合架構中動態分配詞元的門控路由。例句：Gated routing mechanisms dynamically allocate computational tokens to the optimal expert layers.（門控路由機制動態且智慧地將各個輸入詞元精確分發至計算效率最高的專屬專家網絡層。）

normal.desc: 填空題：N E U R O M _ R P H I C (類腦神經突觸架構)
normal.explain: NEUROMORPHIC (adj.)：類腦神經突觸架構。例句：Researchers developed a neuromorphic processor capable of processing sensory pulses.（科研團隊成功研發出一款專門用於即時處理生物感官脈衝信號的神經形態類腦處理器。）

normal.desc: 填空題：I N _ E _ S _ O N (反向特徵重構攻擊)
normal.explain: INVERSION (n.)：反向特徵重構攻擊。例句：Differential privacy defenses effectively block gradient inversion during distributed training.（完善的差分隱私防護屏障，在分散式聯合訓練期間有效阻斷了惡意節點發動的梯度逆向推導攻擊。）

normal.desc: 填空題：S U _ R _ M _ C Y (超越古典算力極限之境界)
normal.explain: SUPREMACY (n.)：超越古典算力極限之境界。例句：The laboratory announced evidence of quantum computational supremacy on random circuit sampling.（國家重點實驗室正式宣佈，在隨機量子線路採樣基準測試中取得了決定性的量子計算霸權實證。）

normal.desc: 填空題：E N T _ O P Y (文本預測不確定性度量)
normal.explain: ENTROPY (n.)：文本預測不確定性度量。例句：Cross entropy loss quantifies the divergence between predicted probabilities and ground truth.（交叉熵損失函數精確量化了模型所預測的機率分佈與真實客觀標籤之間的幾何發散程度。）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The clawback provision on carried interest was triggered when subsequent portfolio write downs materialized. What happened?
options: A. The limited partners surrendered their entire investment equity to the general partner.
B. The private equity firm was permanently banned from managing financial capital.
C. The investment portfolio was confiscated by the sovereign military authority.
D. The fund manager returned previously distributed profits to ensure limited partners received their hurdle.
normal.explain: 在後續投資標的發生大幅減值後，啟動了超額業績報酬追討條款，投資經理必須向有限合夥人退還此前多領的分成。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: A cramdown reorganization plan was confirmed by the bankruptcy court over equity holder objections. What was confirmed?
options: A. A judicial approval forcing dissenting creditor or equity classes to accept the debt restructuring terms.
B. An immediate dismissal of all judicial bankruptcy proceedings without any resolution.
C. The total transfer of corporate intellectual property to foreign state owned entities.
D. A mandated physical liquidation of all manufacturing facilities within forty eight hours.
normal.explain: 破產法院力排權益持有人異議，強行裁定批准了壓制性重組方案（Cramdown），強制抗拒的利害關係方接受債務重整條款。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The synthetic collateralized debt obligation sustained severe impairment as underlying mezzanine tranches defaulted. What suffered?
options: A. An unlisted corporate equity share awarded to founding family members.
B. A complex structured credit instrument backed by credit default swaps on debt tranches.
C. A simple physical gold certificate held in a commercial bank safe deposit vault.
D. A bilateral sovereign treaty governing transcontinental commercial aviation rights.
normal.explain: 由信用違約交換支撐的合成擔保債務憑證（Synthetic CDO），因底層夾層級債券發生違約而遭受毀滅性的資產價值減記。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The company opted for a direct listing to sidestep underwriter lockup agreements and underwriting fees. Why?
options: A. To allow existing shareholders to sell stock publicly without issuing new capital or paying syndicate fees.
B. To raise billions in speculative debt from international shadow banking networks.
C. To eliminate all financial disclosure requirements imposed by securities regulators.
D. To dissolve the company into decentralized autonomous community organizations.
normal.explain: 企業選擇直接上市（Direct listing），既不發行新股稀釋股權，亦免去了向投行銀團支付巨額承銷費與股東閉鎖期限制。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The fairness opinion provided by an independent boutique investment bank validated the deal valuation. What did it provide?
options: A. A criminal background clearance document for all junior corporate employees.
B. A certified expert assessment confirming that financial terms of a transaction are fair to shareholders.
C. A legal guarantee that the acquired company stock price will appreciate tenfold within a year.
D. An environmental impact report regarding carbon emissions of corporate vehicles.
normal.explain: 由獨立精品投行出具的公允性意見書（Fairness opinion），向廣大股東專業論證了併購交易收購對價的財務公允與合理性。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: A greenmail maneuver ended when the board repurchased the corporate raider stake at an exorbitant premium. What occurred?
options: A. The raider was appointed permanent chairman of the corporate executive compensation board.
B. All corporate board meetings were opened unconditionally to public video livestreaming.
C. The company eliminated a hostile takeover threat by buying out the raider at a price above fair market value.
D. The company planted ten thousand trees to satisfy municipal ecological conservation bylaws.
normal.explain: 董事會以遠高於市價的暴利溢價購回收購狙擊手手中的持股，結束了這場以惡意收購為要脅的「綠色郵件（Greenmail）」勒索行動。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The debt was classified as subordinate debt, meaning it ranks junior to senior bank borrowings in default. What is subordinate?
options: A. Debt that carries zero nominal interest rate across its entire lifespan.
B. Debt holding lower repayment priority relative to unsubordinated credit instruments.
C. Debt that possesses sovereign immunity from bankruptcy court jurisdictions.
D. Debt that must be repaid exclusively in physical agricultural grain yields.
normal.explain: 次順位債券（Subordinate debt）在清償順位上低於優先銀行借款，一旦發生違約破產，其受償權利排在資產抵押債務之後。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The special purpose acquisition company faced massive redemptions before concluding its business combination. What faced redemptions?
options: A. A retail commercial bank suffering a bank run due to insolvency rumors on internet chat rooms.
B. A government municipal development agency issuing local municipal infrastructure debt securities.
C. A blank check shell company whose public investors demanded their cash back rather than voting for the merger.
D. A traditional manufacturing firm liquidating its inventory to satisfy overdue commercial supplier invoices.
normal.explain: 這家特殊目的收購公司（SPAC）在最終敲定併購標的投票前，遭遇大量公眾投資人要求贖回本金並退出交易的信任危機。

normal.desc: 【資本市場】In high frequency trading market microstructure, payment for order flow entails:
options: A. banning all electronic communications networks across international financial exchanges.
B. delivering physical paper stock certificates to retail investors by couriers.
C. forcing institutional pension funds to invest exclusively in agricultural commodities.
D. brokerages routing retail client orders to wholesale market makers in exchange for monetary rebates.
normal.explain: 訂單流回扣（PFOF）指券商將散戶訂單導流給特定批發做市商以獲取現金返傭，引發最佳執行義務爭議。

normal.desc: 【反收購策略】A Pac Man defense in corporate takeover litigation describes:
options: A. a target firm countering a hostile takeover bid by making a reciprocal tender offer for the acquirer.
B. a corporate sponsor donating company assets to municipal video game museums.
C. an immediate declaration of corporate dissolution to avoid public media scrutiny.
D. a complete substitution of human directors with automated software algorithms.
normal.explain: 小精靈防禦（Pac-Man defense）指被惡意收購的目標公司反客為主，反向向收購方發起全面敵意收購要約。

normal.desc: 【破產法理】Absolute priority rule in corporate bankruptcy reorganization dictates that:
options: A. government authorities seize one hundred percent of commercial property without compensation.
B. senior creditors must be made completely whole before junior equity holders receive any distribution.
C. equity shareholders always confiscate all assets before secured bondholders are notified.
D. unsecured creditors are executed under criminal statutes without judicial hearing.
normal.explain: 絕對優先原則（Absolute priority rule）是破產法基石，規定優先債權人必須獲得全額清償後，初級權益持有人方可受償。

normal.desc: 【私募基金】Carried interest in private equity partnerships represents:
options: A. a contractual share of investment capital profits awarded to the general partner above a hurdle rate.
B. a flat administrative fee deducted unconditionally from limited partners every month.
C. a statutory fine paid directly to federal trade regulators for non compliance.
D. the interest earned strictly from holding sovereign foreign currencies in bank deposits.
normal.explain: 超額業績報酬（Carried interest）是私募股權合夥企業中，普通合夥人（GP）在投資回報超過預設門檻收益率時所分得的利潤分成。

normal.desc: 【資本結構】The Modigliani Miller theorem in corporate finance posits that under frictionless markets:
options: A. equity financing causes immediate corporate insolvency in all jurisdictions.
B. an enterprise's capital structure is irrelevant to its total enterprise valuation.
C. firms should borrow infinitely to maximize equity holder compensation.
D. debt financing is strictly prohibited by international economic treaties.
normal.explain: 莫迪利亞尼-米勒定理（MM定理）指出在無稅收與破產成本的無摩擦市場中，企業的資本結構與其整體內在價值無關。

normal.desc: 【證券法規】The safe harbor provisions under securities disclosure frameworks protect companies from:
options: A. all criminal investigations into deliberate accounting balance sheet fraud.
B. the statutory payment of national corporate income taxes.
C. private litigation liabilities arising from forward looking statements made in good faith.
D. mandatory disclosure of audited quarterly financial accounting statements.
normal.explain: 安全港條款（Safe harbor）在上市公司秉持善意披露前瞻性預測時，免除其因未來實際業績未達預期而遭受惡意證券民事訴訟的風險。

normal.desc: 【衍生金融】Credit default swaps provide synthetic credit risk protection by:
options: A. eliminating all counterparty default probabilities from global financial transactions.
B. requiring the protection seller to compensate the buyer upon the occurrence of a defined credit event.
C. mandating that central banks bail out any private financial institution facing losses.
D. guaranteeing that debt issuers will never experience revenue declines.
normal.explain: 信用違約交換（CDS）提供合成信用保障，合約約定在發生破產或違約等特定信用事件時，由賣方對買方的債務損失全額賠付。

normal.desc: 【會計詐欺】Forensic accountants detect channel stuffing practices by identifying:
options: A. the failure to provide corporate stationery supplies to administrative workers.
B. unauthorized donations of corporate inventory to charitable non profit shelters.
C. abnormal shipment surges to distributors before quarter close to artificially inflate revenue.
D. the physical theft of copper wiring from factory assembly lines.
normal.explain: 法務會計師透過識別季末向經銷商異常集中壓貨塞貨的行為，揭發企業蓄意虛增當季營收的「通路塞貨（Channel stuffing）」造假手段。

normal.desc: 請唸出：經銷商管道惡意塞貨虛增營收
normal.explain: channel stuffing practices (phr.)：經銷商管道惡意塞貨虛增營收。例句：Regulators sanctioned the multinational enterprise for aggressive channel stuffing practices.（監管機構針對該跨國集團季末向經銷管道暴力塞貨以粉飾財報的造假行徑，開出了巨額罰單。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：破產法院強制批准壓制重組方案
normal.explain: cramdown reorganization plan (phr.)：破產法院強制批准壓制重組方案。例句：The bankruptcy judge confirmed the cramdown reorganization plan despite objections from equity holders.（破產法院主審法官力排次級權益持有人的強烈反對，依法強行裁決批准了壓制性重組方案。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：基於合約的合成信用衍生工具
normal.explain: synthetic credit instruments (phr.)：基於合約的合成信用衍生工具。例句：Sophisticated asset managers hedge counterparty exposure using synthetic credit instruments.（成熟頂尖的資產管理機構，廣泛利用各類合成信用衍生合約來對沖交易對手的信用違約風險。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：獨立機構出具的估值公允性意見
normal.explain: independent fairness opinion (phr.)：獨立機構出具的估值公允性意見。例句：The special committee solicited an independent fairness opinion before endorsing the buyout proposal.（董事會特別獨立委員會在正式簽署支持私有化要約前，聘請了外部頂級智庫出具獨立公允性意見書。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：殖利率曲線倒掛所釋放之衰退警訊
normal.explain: yield curve inversion warning (phr.)：殖利率曲線倒掛所釋放之衰退警訊。例句：The persistent yield curve inversion warning signaled deep macroeconomic headwinds ahead.（長短天期公債殖利率曲線罕見且持續的倒掛警訊，向資本市場釋放出總體經濟深層衰退的強烈信號。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：以惡意收購為要脅的高價回購勒索
normal.explain: greenmail extortion maneuver (phr.)：以惡意收購為要脅的高價回購勒索。例句：The corporate board refused to succumb to the activist hedge fund's greenmail extortion maneuver.（公司董事會斷然拒絕向維權避險基金所策動的惡意收購要脅與高價股權勒索行徑低頭妥協。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：破產清償中的絕對優先權法定則
normal.explain: absolute priority doctrine (phr.)：破產清償中的絕對優先權法定則。例句：The absolute priority doctrine prevents shareholders from extracting value before senior debt is settled.（破產清償中的絕對優先權原則，嚴格杜絕股東在優先債權人的本息獲得全額清償前擅自截留資產。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：特殊目的併購上市借殼殼實體
normal.explain: special purpose acquisition vehicle (phr.)：特殊目的併購上市借殼殼實體。例句：The tech startup merged into a special purpose acquisition vehicle to expedite its public debut.（該前沿科技獨角獸選擇併入一家特殊目的收購上市空殼載體，以此繞過繁複流程迅速敲鐘上市。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：專門利用市場價差進行無風險對沖套利的投機商（A 開頭，11 個字母）
normal.explain: ARBITRAGEUR (n.)：專門利用市場價差進行無風險對沖套利的投機商。例句：The merger arbitrageur profited from narrowing spreads as regulatory approvals cleared.（併購套利專門操盤手，在反壟斷反托拉斯監管批文相繼落地使收購價差收斂之際獲取了暴利。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：企業無力清償到期債務之破產或無清償能力狀態（I 開頭，10 個字母）
normal.explain: INSOLVENCY (n.)：企業無力清償到期債務之破產或無清償能力狀態。例句：Protracted cash burn without revenue expansion inevitably precipitates technical insolvency.（在營業收入未能有效起飛的窘境下持續燒錢，終將無可避免地引發企業技術性無力清償破產。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：明文規定債券發行人權利義務的正式信託合約（I 開頭，9 個字母）
normal.explain: INDENTURE (n.)：明文規定債券發行人權利義務的正式信託合約。例句：The bond indenture stipulates that the company must maintain a debt service coverage ratio.（該債券信託正式合約明文規定，借款企業必須始終保持充足的償債保障比率以防範違約。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：法院下令變賣資產以清償債務的破產資產清算（L 開頭，11 個字母）
normal.explain: LIQUIDATION (n.)：法院下令變賣資產以清償債務的破產資產清算。例句：Involuntary liquidation occurs when creditors file a judicial petition against a debtor.（當債權人聯名向法院提起訴訟申請時，法院將對無法履約的債務人啟動非自願強制資產清算。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：破產法中法院力排異議強行批准債務重整的壓制裁決（C 開頭，8 個字母）
normal.explain: CRAMDOWN (n.)：破產法中法院力排異議強行批准債務重整的壓制裁決。例句：The court enforced a cramdown over the furious objections of subordinated bondholders.（在次順位債券持有人的強烈抗議聲浪中，破產法院依據法規強行執行了壓制性破產重整裁決。）

normal.desc: 填空題：A R B I T _ A G E U R (跨市場套利專業操盤手)
normal.explain: ARBITRAGEUR (n.)：跨市場套利專業操盤手。例句：A risk arbitrageur analyzes antitrust regulatory precedents to calculate acquisition odds.（風險套利操盤手深入研究歷任反托拉斯判例法理，以精確測算併購案能否順利獲批的真實機率。）

normal.desc: 填空題：I N _ E _ T _ R E (約束債券發行人之信託條款)
normal.explain: INDENTURE (n.)：約束債券發行人之信託條款。例句：A covenant inside the bond indenture prevented the firm from incurring additional debts.（債券信託條款合約中設定的明文約束，有效阻止了企業在財務惡化之際進一步大肆舉債。）

normal.desc: 填空題：D E _ I V _ T _ V E (金融衍生合約標的)
normal.explain: DERIVATIVE (n.)：金融衍生合約標的。例句：The investment bank restructured an interest rate derivative to lower financing charges.（該投資銀行重新設計並置換了一筆利率衍生金融合約，藉此有效降低了企業長期的財務融資成本。）

normal.desc: 填空題：L I Q U I _ A T I O N (變賣財產以抵償債款之清算)
normal.explain: LIQUIDATION (n.)：變賣財產以抵償債款之清算。例句：Secured lenders seized physical warehouse machinery before corporate liquidation finished.（在整場企業破產資產拍賣清算流程宣告完結之前，有抵押擔保的銀行貸款方已依法查封實體庫存。）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The threat actor leveraged speculative execution side channels to extract kernel memory. What occurred?
options: A. Processor microarchitectural optimization leaks revealed protected kernel data through cache timing.
B. The computer display suffered from physical electromagnetic interference from radio transmitters.
C. The operating system permanently disabled all user space background software processes.
D. A catastrophic power surge melted the primary central processing unit socket.
normal.explain: 威脅實體巧妙利用微處理器推測執行的側通道微架構漏洞，透過快取時間差分析成功提取出高權限的核心記憶體機密。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Post quantum cryptographic migration required deprecating RSA and elliptic curve signatures. Why?
options: A. Modern software developers are no longer trained in understanding basic classical arithmetic.
B. Shor's quantum algorithm would trivially solve integer factorization and discrete logarithms in polynomial time.
C. Quantum computers are incapable of processing standard sixty four bit binary computations.
D. Legacy algorithms generate excessive heat that permanently melts quantum dilution refrigerators.
normal.explain: 之所以必須進行後量子密碼遷移，是因為秀爾量子演算法能在多項式時間內輕易破解 RSA 質因數分解與橢圓曲線演算法。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The differential power analysis attack deduced the cryptographic key from microvoltag fluctuations. How?
options: A. By listening to the mechanical typing sounds produced by office administrative typists.
B. By observing the blinking lights on the front panel of the consumer broadband router.
C. By measuring subtle changes in power consumption during internal cryptographic hardware processing.
D. By connecting an external high voltage battery directly to the computer audio jack.
normal.explain: 差分功耗分析（DPA）透過極其靈敏地監測晶片在執行加密運算瞬間所產生的微小電壓與功耗波動，成功反推破解出密鑰。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The boot sequence integrity was verified using a hardware anchored Root of Trust. What was anchored?
options: A. An automated script that permanently formats the hard drive upon detecting any network connection.
B. A cryptographic coprocessor validating firmware signatures before relinquishing control to the OS.
C. A physical iron padlock mechanically securing the computer chassis to an office desk.
D. A municipal notary public physically stamped paper certificates inside the server room.
normal.explain: 開機啟動序列的完整性，仰賴硬體級信任根（Root of Trust）專屬加密協同處理器在交出主機控制權前對韌體簽章進行嚴格檢驗。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The attacker performed Return Oriented Programming by stitching together assembly gadgets. What was done?
options: A. Physically rotated the orientation of memory chips on the motherboard printed circuit board.
B. Constructed a mechanical wooden contraption to physically depress computer keyboard keys.
C. Chained short sequences of preexisting machine instructions ending in return to execute arbitrary payloads.
D. Rewrote the entire Linux operating system kernel using interpreted basic script language.
normal.explain: 攻擊者在目標進程的記憶體中挖掘現存的彙編指令片段（Gadgets），巧妙拼接執行了未經授權的任意攻擊二進位邏輯。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Homomorphic private set intersection computed common records without exposing proprietary datasets. What was accomplished?
options: A. Both parties published their entire unredacted customer databases on international public websites.
B. The computing cluster crashed due to an unprecedented recursive mathematical paradox.
C. All participating computers were confiscated by international diplomatic peacekeeping forces.
D. Two parties identified overlapping data points securely while keeping non shared records encrypted.
normal.explain: 同態私有集合求交技術，允許雙方在各自原始數據全程保持高度密碼學加密的前提下，安全算出雙方共有客戶交集。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: A timing attack exploited non constant time string comparison inside the authentication module. What was exploited?
options: A. The latency of transcontinental satellite telecommunications across international borders.
B. The duration of time an administrative employee spent away from their desk during lunch breaks.
C. Differences in the millisecond duration of verification operations to deduce individual character matches.
D. The mechanical ticking sound produced by the clock hanging on the server room wall.
normal.explain: 時間差側通道攻擊精確捕捉了驗證模組在執行非恆定時間字串比對時產生的微秒級運算延遲，逐字逐字逆向試探出正確的通行密鑰。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Attestation protocols proved the remote enclave execution state had not been compromised. What was proven?
options: A. Verification that the commercial office building had passed its annual municipal fire safety audit.
B. Proof that all company employees had completed mandatory workplace cybersecurity training modules.
C. Confirmation that the computer processor had been manufactured entirely from recycled metals.
D. Cryptographic verification that code running inside a secure hardware enclave is authentic and unaltered.
normal.explain: 遠端遠程認證協定（Attestation）以密碼學手段向外界無可辯駁地證明，運行在硬體安全飛地（Enclave）內的代碼完好無損且未被篡改。

normal.desc: 【後量子密碼】Lattice based cryptography forms the backbone of post quantum standards because:
options: A. its underlying mathematical problems resist polynomial time speedups from Shor's algorithm.
B. it requires quantum computers to generate simple random whole numbers.
C. it is exclusively implemented using analog vacuum tube circuits.
D. it operates without any mathematical calculations on digital silicon hardware.
normal.explain: 基於晶格的密碼學（Lattice-based cryptography）之所以成為抗量子密碼中流砥柱，因其數學難題對秀爾演算法具備免疫力。

normal.desc: 【硬體側通道】Spectre and Meltdown hardware vulnerabilities fundamentally demonstrated that:
options: A. silicon microchips cannot operate in environments containing natural atmospheric oxygen.
B. speculative execution optimizations in microprocessors leak private memory contents across boundaries.
C. computer monitors can be physically shattered by malicious audio waveforms.
D. central processing units can be dissolved by uploading corrupted plain text files.
normal.explain: 幽靈（Spectre）與熔毀（Meltdown）硬體架構漏洞深刻揭示：微處理器底層的推測執行機制會在快取中洩漏機密記憶體數據。

normal.desc: 【隱私運算】Homomorphic encryption represents a cryptographic breakthrough by enabling:
options: A. the immediate translation of English into ancient Egyptian hieroglyphic characters.
B. human telepathic communication via wireless bluetooth consumer headsets.
C. mathematical computations directly on encrypted ciphertexts without ever decrypting them.
D. the permanent elimination of all electronic data transmission latency globally.
normal.explain: 同態加密（Homomorphic encryption）是密碼學聖杯，它允許直接對處於加密狀態的密文進行複雜計算，全程無需解密明文。

normal.desc: 【密碼證明】Zero Knowledge Proofs allow a prover to establish the veracity of a proposition to a verifier:
options: A. by surrendering their physical passports to an international judicial council.
B. without revealing any underlying substantive information beyond the statement's truth itself.
C. by publishing all classified sovereign defense dossiers on open public internet forums.
D. by transferring one hundred percent of their personal bank balance to the verifier.
normal.explain: 零知識證明（ZKP）允許證明者在不向驗證者透露任何實質資訊（如密碼或私鑰）的前提下，確鑿證明特定斷言的真實性。

normal.desc: 【軟體韌性】Control Flow Integrity prevents code reuse attacks like Return Oriented Programming by:
options: A. permanently shutting down computing hardware whenever a function call terminates.
B. forcing programmers to write software instructions exclusively with mechanical punch tape.
C. verifying that program execution strictly adheres to a predetermined control flow call graph.
D. prohibiting the use of while loops and if statements in high level source code.
normal.explain: 控制流完整性（CFI）透過強制程式執行嚴格遵循預先定義的控制流調用圖，徹底粉碎了利用記憶體漏洞的 ROP 程式碼重用攻擊。

normal.desc: 【逆向工程】Differentiating between benign packing and malicious obfuscation requires analyzing:
options: A. the physical color and aesthetic texture of the computer external plastic casing.
B. the retail monetary cost of the optical computer mouse connected to the workstation.
C. the grammatical elegance of marketing software documentation manuals.
D. entropy levels, import address tables, and dynamic unpacking behaviors in virtual execution.
normal.explain: 區分良性加殼與惡意混淆，需深入剖析可執行檔的資訊熵分佈、匯入位址表（IAT）異常以及動態記憶體脫殼行為。

normal.desc: 【資料主權】Data localization mandates enforce sovereign jurisdictional boundaries by requiring:
options: A. the total prohibition of all cross border air travel by software engineering managers.
B. the immediate deletion of all international financial trade documentation archives.
C. personal and corporate telecommunications records to be physically stored within national territory.
D. all internet traffic to be routed exclusively through transatlantic underwater copper cables.
normal.explain: 數據本地化法令（Data localization）透過強制要求涉及本國公民與企業的關鍵數據必須在國境內的實體資料庫留存，確立數位主權。

normal.desc: 【認證破解】Pass the Hash attacks bypass traditional authentication challenges by:
options: A. physically soldering bypass wires directly onto the computer motherboard printed circuit.
B. shouting randomized alphanumeric characters into the workstation microphone.
C. submitting expired paper identification cards to digital automated border check gates.
D. presenting captured NTLM password hashes directly to services without ever cracking the plaintext.
normal.explain: 哈希傳遞攻擊（Pass-the-Hash）允許攻擊者在完全不需要破解出原始明文密碼的情況下，直接向遠端主機出示截獲的 NTLM 雜湊值登入。

normal.desc: 請唸出：基於晶格維度的後量子抗量子密碼學
normal.explain: lattice based cryptography (phr.)：基於晶格維度的後量子抗量子密碼學。例句：Standardization bodies adopted lattice based cryptography to secure future digital communications.（國際標準組織全面擁抱並頒布基於晶格的抗量子密碼學，以捍衛未來全球通訊在量子時代的本質安全。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：微處理器推測執行微架構側通道漏洞
normal.explain: speculative execution side channel (phr.)：微處理器推測執行微架構側通道漏洞。例句：Hardware engineers patched the speculative execution side channel through microcode firmware updates.（處理器晶片硬體架構師藉由推送底層微碼韌體更新，全力封堵了推測執行側通道帶來的記憶體洩密漏洞。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：防範惡意程式碼重用之控制流完整性保護
normal.explain: control flow integrity protection (phr.)：防範惡意程式碼重用之控制流完整性保護。例句：Enforcing control flow integrity protection precludes attackers from hijacking system execution graphs.（嚴格強制實施控制流完整性保護機制，徹底杜絕了惡意攻擊者企圖篡改劫持程式正常執行圖譜的野心。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：基於晶片底層物理硬體錨定的信任根基石
normal.explain: hardware anchored root of trust (phr.)：基於晶片底層物理硬體錨定的信任根基石。例句：The secure boot protocol verifies all firmware against a hardware anchored root of trust.（整套安全引導啟動協定在每一次重啟時，均會對照晶片底層硬體錨定的信任根對全部韌體簽章進行嚴格查驗。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：零知識證明在不洩漏實質內容下的驗證
normal.explain: zero knowledge proof verification (phr.)：零知識證明在不洩漏實質內容下的驗證。例句：Blockchain identity protocols employ zero knowledge proof verification to preserve user anonymity.（次世代區塊鏈數位身分體系深度結合零知識證明驗證機制，在完美證明身分合規的同時捍衛了使用者的匿名隱私。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：拼接記憶體片段之回歸導向程式設計攻擊利用
normal.explain: return oriented programming exploit (phr.)：拼接記憶體片段之回歸導向程式設計攻擊利用。例句：Stack canaries and non executable memory mitigate return oriented programming exploit threats.（堆疊金絲雀校驗與記憶體不可執行保護（DEP）的聯合部署，顯著壓制了回歸導向程式設計（ROP）利用的威脅空間。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：硬體機密計算飛地執行狀態之遠端遠程證明
normal.explain: remote enclave execution attestation (phr.)：硬體機密計算飛地執行狀態之遠端遠程證明。例句：The client validated the server state via remote enclave execution attestation before sending data.（客戶端在向雲端傳輸極度機密的商業資料之前，必須先藉由遠端安全飛地執行證明驗證伺服器狀態的絕對純淨。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：針對特定社群之隱蔽水坑滲透攻擊手法
normal.explain: stealthy watering hole compromise (phr.)：針對特定社群之隱蔽水坑滲透攻擊手法。例句：Forensic teams traced the espionage campaign to a stealthy watering hole compromise on an industry forum.（司法數位鑑識調查組透過多方線索排查，最終將這起跨國商業間諜行動的源頭鎖定在某行業專業論壇的水坑滲透攻擊上。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：故意使程式碼複雜難懂以防逆向工程的混淆技術（O 開頭，11 個字母）
normal.explain: OBFUSCATION (n.)：故意使程式碼複雜難懂以防逆向工程的混淆技術。例句：Malware authors employ metamorphic code obfuscation to defeat static signature scanners.（惡意病毒軟體作者廣泛利用易變形程式碼混淆技術，試圖徹底癱瘓傳統防毒軟體的靜態特徵碼比對掃描。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：尋找密碼體系數學弱點以破譯密文的密碼分析學（C 開頭，13 個字母）
normal.explain: CRYPTANALYSIS (n.)：尋找密碼體系數學弱點以破譯密文的密碼分析學。例句：Modern quantum algorithms demonstrate unprecedented theoretical power in cryptanalysis.（當代量子計算演算法在密碼分析學領域展現出了古典運算完全無法想像的毀滅性破譯潛能。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：由於安全性缺陷或技術落後而宣布淘汰廢止（D 開頭，11 個字母）
normal.explain: DEPRECATION (n.)：由於安全性缺陷或技術落後而宣布淘汰廢止。例句：The cybersecurity standards agency announced the formal deprecation of SHA 1 algorithms.（國家網路安全標準審議機構正式對外宣告，對存在嚴重碰撞缺陷的 SHA-1 雜湊演算法實施全網正式廢止淘汰。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：利用軟硬體安全漏洞進行未授權操作的漏洞利用（E 開頭，12 個字母）
normal.explain: EXPLOITATION (n.)：利用軟硬體安全漏洞進行未授權操作的漏洞利用。例句：Automated attack engines scan the public internet for rapid vulnerability exploitation.（全自動化攻擊探針引擎日夜不休地在公網上進行大規模掃描，伺機發動閃電般的高危漏洞利用打擊。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：由於惡意攻擊導致系統正常運算功能或效能受損（I 開頭，10 個字母）
normal.explain: IMPAIRMENT (n.)：由於惡意攻擊導致系統正常運算功能或效能受損。例句：Denial of service incurs severe operational impairment to commercial trading engines.（大規模分散式阻斷服務攻擊，給跨國電子商務交易引擎帶來了極為慘重的營運效能受損與中斷。）

normal.desc: 填空題：O B F U S _ A T I O N (程式碼混淆防禦手段)
normal.explain: OBFUSCATION (n.)：程式碼混淆防禦手段。例句：Binary obfuscation hinders reverse engineering by proprietary intellectual property thieves.（對二進位指令進行深層混淆，能大幅增加不法之徒企圖逆向工程竊取企業專有智慧財產權的技術難度。）

normal.desc: 填空題：D E _ R E _ A T _ O N (淘汰廢除過時弱加密演算法)
normal.explain: DEPRECATION (n.)：淘汰廢除過時弱加密演算法。例句：Security compliance frameworks mandate the rapid deprecation of single DES protocols.（國際網路安全合規標準架構，明文強制要求各大金融機構以最快速度淘汰廢除脆弱的單重 DES 加密協定。）

normal.desc: 填空題：P R _ V E _ A _ C E (驗證組件合規之溯源檔案)
normal.explain: PROVENANCE (n.)：驗證組件合規之溯源檔案。例句：Verifying the provenance of downloaded container images prevents backdoored deployments.（在正式環境部署容器鏡像前嚴格核實其完整的來源溯源檔案，能防範惡意後門被不知不覺打包上線。）

normal.desc: 填空題：E X P L O I _ A T I O N (駭客發動惡意漏洞利用)
