normal.explain: EXPLOITATION (n.)：駭客發動惡意漏洞利用。例句：Immediate patch management neutralizes active zero day exploitation across infrastructure.（落實即時自動化的修補程式管理機制，能以最快速度消解全球黑客對底層基礎設施的高危零日漏洞利用。）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The base editor engineered a C to T transition without generating double stranded DNA breaks. What was engineered?
options: A. A complete reversal of the patient's biological chronological age back to childhood.
B. A precise single nucleotide conversion without inducing perilous chromosomal translocations.
C. The total dissolution of the entire chromosome into individual ribonucleotides.
D. The replacement of an entire organ system with synthetic electronic microprocessors.
normal.explain: 鹼基編輯器（Base editor）在完全不破壞染色體雙鏈骨架（無 DSB）的溫和前提下，精準實施了胞嘧啶到胸腺嘧啶的單核苷酸平滑置換。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Allogeneic off the shelf CAR T cells were edited to knock out TCR and HLA molecules. Why?
options: A. To make the therapeutic cells visible to the naked human eye without microscopes.
B. To permanently shut down all cellular metabolism within sixty seconds of injection.
C. To prevent both graft versus host disease and host mediated immune rejection in universal recipients.
D. To ensure the cells would only proliferate inside the original biological donor host.
normal.explain: 同種異體「現貨型」CAR-T 細胞敲除了 TCR 與 HLA 基因，旨在徹底消除移植物抗宿主病（GvHD）以及受者免疫系統引發的異體排斥。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Proteolysis targeting chimeras recruit E3 ubiquitin ligases to destroy previously undruggable oncoproteins. How?
options: A. By encasing malignant cancer cells inside microscopic calcium carbonate geological formations.
B. By freezing all intracellular water molecules into crystalline hexagonal ice structures.
C. By transforming dangerous oncoproteins into nutritious dietary vitamin supplements.
D. By inducing targeted intracellular ubiquitination that flags oncogenic proteins for proteasomal degradation.
normal.explain: 靶向蛋白降解嵌合體（PROTAC）透過招募細胞內的 E3 泛素連接酶，為傳統無成藥位點的頑固致癌蛋白打上死亡標籤，送入蛋白酶體徹底粉碎。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The patient developed cytokine release syndrome manifested by torrential systemic interleukin six spikes. What developed?
options: A. The complete cessation of all biological bacterial activity inside the gastrointestinal tract.
B. A miraculous spontaneous cure of all historical viral and bacterial infections.
C. A life threatening hyperinflammatory systemic cascade triggered by hyperactivated immune T cells.
D. A mild temporary cosmetic reddening of the skin requiring no medical intervention.
normal.explain: 患者爆發了嚴重的細胞因子釋放綜合徵（CRS），過度活化的 T 細胞引發了以白介素-6（IL-6）雪崩式暴衝為特徵的致命全身性發炎風暴。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Spatial transcriptomics mapped gene expression profiles onto intact tissue histological coordinates. What was mapped?
options: A. The mechanical sound vibrations of surgical scalpels during human clinical autopsy procedures.
B. The physical temperature gradient of paraffin wax embedding blocks inside pathology laboratories.
C. The financial cost accounting of individual microscope glass slide coverslips.
D. The precise spatial localization of RNA transcripts preserved within native tissue microenvironments.
normal.explain: 空間轉錄組學（Spatial transcriptomics）將基因表達訊號原位投影在完整的組織切片組織學座標上，精確繪製出細胞在原位微環境中的真實對話。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Telomere attrition was accelerated by oxidative stress and serial cellular replication cycles. What occurred?
options: A. The protective nucleoprotein caps at chromosome ends shortened, driving cells toward replicative senescence.
B. The cell nucleus expanded until it occupied one hundred percent of the total bodily volume.
C. The chromosome permanently mutated into inorganic iron oxide mineral crystalline lattices.
D. All cellular genetic material was spontaneously ejected into the extracellular interstitial fluid.
normal.explain: 端粒損耗（Telomere attrition）在氧化應激與細胞反覆分裂的雙重夾擊下顯著加速，導致染色體末端保護帽縮短，將細胞推向衰老終局。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The ethical committee deliberated on compassionate use access for an unapproved individualized antisense oligonucleotide. What was considered?
options: A. Selling unproven cosmetic treatments directly to healthy consumers via internet social media.
B. Mandating that all hospital patients surrender their physical homes to medical research foundations.
C. Granting immediate university medical degrees to junior undergraduate nursing students.
D. Providing an investigational experimental therapy to a terminally ill patient when no alternatives exist.
normal.explain: 倫理委員會在患者無藥可救的極端瀕危困境下，審慎批准了針對該個體獨特基因突變所量身定制之反義寡核苷酸（ASO）的「同情用藥（Compassionate use）」申請。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Liquid biopsies detected minimal residual disease by monitoring ultra low frequency circulating tumor DNA. What was monitored?
options: A. Trace amounts of cancer specific genetic fragments remaining in blood after surgical tumor resection.
B. The physical viscosity of red blood cells passing through capillary blood vessels.
C. The exact volume of sweat produced by cancer patients during high intensity athletic sprints.
D. The concentration of atmospheric air dissolved in venous circulatory blood samples.
normal.explain: 液體切片（Liquid biopsy）技術透過極其靈敏地捕捉外周血中微量存在的循環腫瘤 DNA，精準監測手術切除後潛伏的「微小殘留病灶（MRD）」。

normal.desc: 【異種移植】Genetically modified porcine organ xenotransplantation requires knocking out alpha gal to:
options: A. accelerate the natural growth rate of the donor pig tenfold.
B. prevent hyperacute immunological rejection mediated by pre existing human antibodies.
C. make the organ glow brightly under diagnostic ultraviolet diagnostic imaging.
D. reduce the physical weight of the donor heart by seventy five percent.
normal.explain: 在基因改造豬異種器官移植中，敲除 α-Gal 抗原基因至關重要，因其能徹底消除人類體內既有抗體引發的超急性毀滅性排斥反應。

normal.desc: 【基因驅動】Gene drive systems utilizing CRISPR override Mendelian inheritance laws by:
options: A. halving the mutation rate of all cellular genes to zero across eternity.
B. preventing organisms from undergoing cellular mitosis or protein synthesis.
C. ensuring a genetic modification is inherited by nearly one hundred percent of sexually reproducing progeny.
D. requiring all offspring to be genetically identical female clones exclusively.
normal.explain: 基因驅動系統（Gene drive）利用 CRISPR 偏向性基因修復機制打破孟德爾遺傳律，使工程修飾在有性繁殖中以近乎 100% 的幾率遺傳擴散。

normal.desc: 【合成基因組學】Minimal synthetic bacterial cells like JCVI syn3.0 were constructed primarily to:
options: A. manufacture biological weapons capable of surviving thermonuclear detonations.
B. prove that living organisms can survive without consuming water or chemical elements.
C. generate high voltage electrical current from ambient room temperature air.
D. identify the absolute minimal set of essential genes required to sustain autonomous cellular life.
normal.explain: 人造合成支原體細胞 JCVI-syn3.0 的人造合成，旨在探索並精確界定支撐一個獨立生命實體自主代謝存活所需的絕對極簡基因組底線。

normal.desc: 【單細胞生物學】Single cell RNA sequencing provides unprecedented resolution into tissues by:
options: A. measuring the physical friction between adjacent red blood cells inside capillaries.
B. recording acoustic vibrational sounds emitted during cellular protein translation.
C. quantifying transcriptomic expression profiles of individual cells rather than aggregate averages.
D. freezing entire organs in solid nitrogen blocks to preserve gross anatomical architecture.
normal.explain: 單細胞轉錄組定序（scRNA-seq）徹底打破組織批量測序的模糊平均值假象，以單個細胞的微觀極致維度揭示組織內部的異質性。

normal.desc: 【基因組隱私】Re identification risks in public anonymized genomic databases occur because:
options: A. all computer algorithms automatically broadcast personal passwords to social networks.
B. genetic information can be decoded by listening to ambient radio telecommunications.
C. human genomes are entirely identical across every individual on planet earth.
D. unique combinations of rare single nucleotide polymorphisms act as quasi biometric identifiers.
normal.explain: 公開去識別化基因資料庫面臨再識別漏洞（Re-identification），因為少數罕見單核苷酸多態性（SNPs）的獨特組合足以構成無可辯駁的生物指紋。

normal.desc: 【神經技術倫理】Neural interface decoding of linguistic thoughts in locked in patients raises dilemmas concerning:
options: A. cognitive privacy and the unconsented extraction of subconscious or unexpressed deliberations.
B. the mechanical rusting of metallic brain electrodes inside cerebral spinal fluid.
C. the sudden inability of computer processors to calculate simple basic arithmetic.
D. the legal prohibition of paralyzed individuals from authoring personal memoirs.
normal.explain: 閉鎖綜合症患者的腦機介面語言解碼技術，引發了深刻的神經倫理學困境：如何確保個體最深層的「認知隱私」不被未經授權強行讀取。

normal.desc: 【蛋白質設計】De novo protein design using deep structural models diverges from nature by:
options: A. restricting all protein engineering strictly to mutations of bovine serum albumin.
B. copying existing bacterial enzymes without altering a single atomic coordinate.
C. requiring all designed enzymes to be synthesized exclusively inside volcanic lava.
D. generating novel three dimensional folds and catalytic binding pockets from computational scratch.
normal.explain: 基於深度學習的從頭蛋白質設計（De novo design）徹底擺脫對自然界現有結構的仿製，直接從第一性原理運算出自然界未曾存在過的全新三維拓撲折疊。

normal.desc: 【生物資本主義】The biopiracy critique of intellectual property frameworks alleges that:
options: A. corporations patent indigenous medicinal knowledge and native germplasms without equitable benefit sharing.
B. traditional herbal healers are legally mandated to purchase multinational pharmaceutical factories.
C. all biological plant species must be physically surrendered to international patent clerks.
D. researchers are prohibited from using microscopes in developing sovereign countries.
normal.explain: 生物海盜（Biopiracy）批判指責跨國藥企在未建立公平惠益分享機制的前提下，強行掠奪並將原住民千百年世代相傳的藥用植物與本土種質資源申請專利。

normal.desc: 請唸出：異種器官移植引發之免疫超急性排斥
normal.explain: xenotransplantation rejection (phr.)：異種器官移植引發之免疫超急性排斥。例句：Multi gene editing in donor lines overcame severe hyperacute xenotransplantation rejection.（在供體器官品系中實施多基因聯合編輯，成功化解了致命的超急性異種移植免疫排斥反應。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：打破孟德爾定律之偏向基因驅動系統
normal.explain: mendelian inheritance drive (phr.)：打破孟德爾定律之偏向基因驅動系統。例句：Ecologists debated releasing mosquitoes carrying a CRISPR based mendelian inheritance drive.（生態學家激辯是否該向大自然釋放攜帶基於 CRISPR 偏向性基因驅動系統的基因改造蚊蟲。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：體細胞全能重編程中表觀遺傳標記抹除
normal.explain: epigenetic marks erasure (phr.)：體細胞全能重編程中表觀遺傳標記抹除。例句：Cellular reprogramming demands comprehensive epigenetic marks erasure across chromatin loci.（誘導成熟體細胞逆轉分化命運，必須徹底實現全染色質位點表觀遺傳修飾標記的深層抹除。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：增強病毒致死力之病原體功能獲得研究
normal.explain: pathogen gain of function (phr.)：增強病毒致死力之病原體功能獲得研究。例句：Bioethicists scrutinized the dual use hazards of pathogen gain of function experiments.（國際生命倫理學界高度審視並強烈警惕病原體功能獲得性增強實驗所潛藏的軍民兩用致命危害。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：基於第一性原理計算之從頭蛋白質設計
normal.explain: de novo protein design (phr.)：基於第一性原理計算之從頭蛋白質設計。例句：Deep learning models empowered de novo protein design for hyper stable therapeutic biologics.（前沿深度學習大模型賦予了科學家從頭蛋白質設計的強大能力，創造出超常熱穩定的新型生物藥物。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：免疫過度活化誘發之致命細胞因子風暴
normal.explain: cytokine release syndrome (phr.)：免疫過度活化誘發之致命細胞因子風暴。例句：Intensive care protocols were initiated upon early signs of cytokine release syndrome.（重症監護病房在患者初現全身性細胞因子釋放綜合徵端倪之際，第一時間啟動了抗炎急救處置預案。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：無藥可救之重症患者同情用藥人道審批
normal.explain: compassionate use protocol (phr.)：無藥可救之重症患者同情用藥人道審批。例句：The regulator authorized a compassionate use protocol for an unapproved individualized gene therapy.（藥品監督管理機構依法特批了一項同情用藥人道方案，讓瀕危罕見病患能破格試用尚未獲批的訂製基因療法。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：端粒縮短誘發之細胞不可逆複製衰老
normal.explain: replicative cellular senescence (phr.)：端粒縮短誘發之細胞不可逆複製衰老。例句：Telomere shortening triggers replicative cellular senescence via chronic DNA damage signaling.（端粒不可逆的進行性損耗縮短，透過觸發持續的 DNA 損傷警報訊號將細胞推入不可逆的複製衰老狀態。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：將動物器官移植入人體之異種器官移植醫學（X 開頭，19 個字母）
normal.explain: XENOTRANSPLANTATION (n.)：將動物器官移植入人體之異種器官移植醫學。例句：Xenotransplantation offers a promising technological solution to chronic human donor organ shortages.（異種器官移植技術的重大突破，為徹底化解長期以來困擾人類醫學的供體器官極度匱乏難題點亮了曙光。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：利用化學或物理方法將外源核酸導入真核細胞的轉染（T 開頭，12 個字母）
normal.explain: TRANSFECTION (n.)：利用化學或物理方法將外源核酸導入真核細胞的轉染。例句：Liposomal transfection reagents facilitate efficient delivery of plasmid vectors in vitro.（高性能微脂體轉染試劑，能在體外實驗中高效輔助外源質體載體穿透細胞膜並實現高水平轉染。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：細胞內為即將降解的標靶蛋白貼上泛素標籤的生化過程（U 開頭，14 個字母）
normal.explain: UBIQUITINATION (n.)：細胞內為即將降解的標靶蛋白貼上泛素標籤的生化過程。例句：Targeted ubiquitination cascades govern the degradation of short lived regulatory enzymes.（高度特異性的靶向泛素化級聯反應，嚴密掌控著體內各類短壽命關鍵調控酶分子的及時降解與清除。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：能分化為機體內幾乎所有胚層組織細胞的多能分化潛能（P 開頭，12 個字母）
normal.explain: PLURIPOTENCY (n.)：能分化為機體內幾乎所有胚層組織細胞的多能分化潛能。例句：Maintaining stem cell pluripotency requires precise cocktails of signaling inhibitors.（在體外維持幹細胞的多能未分化狀態，仰賴精確配比的多種細胞訊號通路阻斷劑雞尾酒配方。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：細胞永久停止分裂但仍保持代謝活性的生物學衰老（S 開頭，10 個字母）
normal.explain: SENESCENCE (n.)：細胞永久停止分裂但仍保持代謝活性的生物學衰老。例句：Cellular senescence secretes pro inflammatory cytokines that damage surrounding tissues.（處於衰老終局的細胞會持續分泌大量促發炎細胞因子，對周遭健康的微環境組織造成深層侵蝕破壞。）

normal.desc: 填空題：X E N O T R A N S _ L A N T A T I O N (動物跨物種人體器官移植)
normal.explain: XENOTRANSPLANTATION (n.)：動物跨物種人體器官移植。例句：Immune matching hurdles must be solved to realize clinical xenotransplantation.（唯有徹底攻克跨物種免疫排斥匹配的底層頑疾，臨床異種器官移植方能真正走向常規普及造福大眾。）

normal.desc: 填空題：U B I _ U I T _ N A _ I O N (標記異常蛋白之泛素化降解)
normal.explain: UBIQUITINATION (n.)：標記異常蛋白之泛素化降解。例句：Molecular glues orchestrate target protein ubiquitination to eliminate oncogenic factors.（小分子分子膠藥物能夠巧妙誘導目標致癌蛋白發生泛素化修飾，進而借助細胞自身垃圾桶將其降解。）

normal.desc: 填空題：A L _ O G _ N _ I C (同物種異體來源之通用型製品)
normal.explain: ALLOGENEIC (adj.)：同物種異體來源之通用型製品。例句：Universal allogeneic immune therapies promise off the shelf availability for patients.（通用型同種異體免疫細胞藥物，為廣大危重癌症患者帶來了即買即用、無須苦候數週的現貨可及性。）

normal.desc: 填空題：P L U R I P _ T E N C Y (幹細胞全能發育分化潛力)
normal.explain: PLURIPOTENCY (n.)：幹細胞全能發育分化潛力。例句：Transcription factors reset somatic identity and restore developmental pluripotency.（特定的核心轉錄因子組合能成功重置終末體細胞的身分密碼，並完整恢復其最初的發育多能性。）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The central bank activated its emergency standing repo facility to calm an intraday repo rate spike. Why?
options: A. To mandate that all commercial corporations cease electronic billing operations immediately.
B. To double the reserve requirement ratio for all foreign owned commercial banks.
C. To inject abundant overnight reserves and prevent money market interest rates from decoupling from the target range.
D. To confiscate all commercial bank cash drawers and deposit them inside the military treasury.
normal.explain: 央行緊急啟動常備回購機制（SRF），旨在向金融體系瞬時注入充沛的隔夜流動性，防止貨幣市場短期回購利率脫韁暴衝失控。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The yield curve experienced a violent bull steepener as market participants priced in aggressive rate cuts. What occurred?
options: A. All interest rates across every maturity rose synchronously to unprecedented double digit levels.
B. The national stock exchange halted equity trading permanently across all listed industrial shares.
C. The government decreed that all sovereign bonds were immediately convertible into physical farmland.
D. Short term bond yields plunged much faster than long term yields amid deepening recession forecasts.
normal.explain: 國債市場爆發劇烈的「牛市變陡（Bull steepener）」，市場瘋狂押注央行即將開啟激進降息，帶動短期國債利率雪崩式下跌，幅度遠超長端。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The currency peg shattered after speculators engaged in aggressive speculative attack via forward markets. What broke?
options: A. The fixed exchange rate was abandoned, resulting in catastrophic currency depreciation and foreign exchange exhaustion.
B. The physical glass entrance doors of the central bank building were broken by street protestors.
C. The national electrical grid collapsed due to extreme mechanical equipment transmission failure.
D. All domestic commercial bank accounts were forcibly converted into equity shares of public railways.
normal.explain: 在跨國宏觀對沖基金透過遠期合約發動的狂暴投機性攻擊下，外匯儲備耗盡，該國維持數十年的法定貨幣固定匯率體制宣告土崩瓦解。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The national debt crossed the psychological threshold of one hundred and twenty percent of GDP. What was crossed?
options: A. The percentage of national territory physically designated as public ecological wildlife preserves.
B. The statutory tax rate imposed on luxury consumer electronics imported from foreign manufacturers.
C. The proportion of commercial banking executives who hold postgraduate degrees in economics.
D. The ratio of accumulated gross public debt relative to annual nominal economic gross domestic product.
normal.explain: 國家未償公共債務總額佔名目國內生產毛額（GDP）的比例一舉突破 120% 的心理防線，主權債務長期可持續性亮起刺眼紅燈。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The central bank introduced tiered remuneration on excess reserves to mitigate negative rate penalties on banks. How?
options: A. By exempting a portion of commercial bank reserve deposits from negative interest charges.
B. By paying private bank shareholders fifty percent annual dividends directly from national taxes.
C. By confiscating customer deposits exceeding one million dollars to fund public defense budgets.
D. By requiring all commercial bank tellers to wear military uniforms during banking business hours.
normal.explain: 央行實施超額準備金分層計息利率機制（Tiered reserve system），對銀行特定額度內的準備金免徵負利率懲罰，以保護銀行中介功能。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The sovereign wealth fund liquidated foreign equities to fund domestic macroeconomic stabilization programs. What occurred?
options: A. The fund declared total bankruptcy and handed all corporate real estate assets to private lenders.
B. State owned overseas capital was repatriated and converted into local currency for emergency spending.
C. The sovereign fund purchased one hundred percent of all listed equities on foreign stock exchanges.
D. The foreign nation froze the sovereign fund assets and expelled all diplomatic ambassadors.
normal.explain: 主權財富基金拋售海外持有的外國股票資產，將巨額外匯利潤班師回朝並換匯為本幣，全力為國內宏觀緊急穩定紓困計畫注資。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The central bank engaged in foreign exchange swap lines with major global central banks to alleviate dollar shortages. Why?
options: A. To ensure international commercial banks had access to emergency dollar liquidity during market paralysis.
B. To permanently merge the currencies of participating sovereign nations into a single monetary unit.
C. To eliminate all customs duties and trade tariffs on agricultural commodities between nations.
D. To force all international airline passenger flights to settle ticket purchases in sovereign gold.
normal.explain: 央行與美聯儲等主要央行緊急啟動常態化貨幣雙邊互換協議（Swap lines），旨在向陷入流動性休克的國際銀行體系輸送救命的美元流動性。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The fiscal dominance regime forced the monetary authority to suppress interest rates despite high inflation. Why?
options: A. To ensure that domestic commodity exports remain the cheapest in international trade history.
B. To prevent high government borrowing costs from triggering sovereign debt insolvency and budget collapse.
C. To maximize the personal dividend yields paid to corporate real estate developers.
D. To comply with international treaties banning the use of interest rates in financial contracts.
normal.explain: 在「財政主導（Fiscal dominance）」的極端病態體制下，央行被迫屈從於財政部壓力，即便通膨肆虐亦不得不強行壓低利率以防主權債務崩潰。

normal.desc: 【三元悖論】The Mundell Fleming Impossible Trinity asserts that a nation cannot simultaneously maintain:
options: A. a positive income tax, a negative corporate tax, and zero sales excise duties on commodities.
B. a military army, a civilian police force, and an independent judicial supreme court.
C. an open capital account, a fixed exchange rate, and an autonomous domestic monetary policy.
D. a space program, an agricultural ministry, and a national maritime coast guard service.
normal.explain: 蒙代爾-弗萊明三元悖論（Impossible Trinity）指出：任何國家皆不可能同時兼顧資本自由流動、固定匯率制與獨立的貨幣政策。

normal.desc: 【央行前瞻指引】Time inconsistency in central bank monetary forward guidance describes the temptation to:
options: A. alter the mechanical speed of office elevators inside the central bank headquarters building.
B. announce interest rate changes in poetic rhyming couplets rather than standard prose.
C. conduct all monetary policy voting sessions exclusively during total solar eclipses.
D. renege on previously announced future policy commitments once private actors have acted on them.
normal.explain: 央行前瞻指引的時間不一致性（Time inconsistency）指：在民間市場主體依據央行指引作出決策後，央行往往會產生背棄先前承諾的機會主義誘惑。

normal.desc: 【總體流動性】The Shadow Banking system amplifies systemic financial fragility because it operates:
options: A. with high leverage and short term wholesale funding while lacking explicit public backstops.
B. strictly with physical copper coins stored inside underground reinforced concrete tunnels.
C. without any connection to digital electronic communications networks or fiber cables.
D. under the direct administrative command of municipal public elementary school teachers.
normal.explain: 影子銀行體系（Shadow banking）急劇放大了金融體系脆弱性，因其嚴重依賴高槓桿與脆弱的短期批發批售融資，卻完全缺乏央行的最後貸款人兜底。

normal.desc: 【量化寬鬆機制】The portfolio balance channel of quantitative easing operates when central banks:
options: A. confiscate private corporate bank accounts to purchase modern abstract art collections.
B. prohibit commercial banks from issuing loans to technology and software startups.
C. replace all physical banknotes with cryptographic tokens issued by municipal governments.
D. purchase long duration safe assets, compressing yields and forcing private capital into riskier investments.
normal.explain: 量化寬鬆的資產組合平衡管道（Portfolio balance channel）透過大舉收購長天期公債壓低無風險回報，逼迫民間避險資金轉向高風險資產。

normal.desc: 【國際貨幣體系】The Triffin Dilemma in international monetary architecture highlights the conflict between:
options: A. the national domestic policy needs of a reserve currency issuer and international global liquidity demands.
B. the physical dimensions of ocean container ships and the depth of international canal waterways.
C. the dietary preferences of central bank directors and the agricultural output of wheat farms.
D. the total number of commercial bank tellers and the national average life expectancy rate.
normal.explain: 特里芬難題（Triffin dilemma）深刻揭示了主權儲備貨幣的內在矛盾：發行國國內貨幣政策目標與滿足全球貿易流動性需求之間存在不可調和的結構衝突。

normal.desc: 【債務通縮理論】Irving Fisher's Debt Deflation theory demonstrates that widespread distress selling:
options: A. results in an immediate doubling of real gross domestic wages across all blue collar workers.
B. reduces the price level, paradoxically increasing the real burden of remaining nominal debts.
C. causes the physical weight of consumer manufactured goods to increase exponentially.
D. forces central banks to convert all digital records into ancient Babylonian clay tablets.
normal.explain: 歐文·費雪的債務通縮理論（Debt Deflation）證明：大蕭條中普遍的恐慌性拋售會引發物價螺旋通縮，反而使得債務人尚未清償的實質債務負擔不減反增。

normal.desc: 【主權債務重整】Collective Action Clauses in sovereign bond indentures are structured specifically to:
options: A. prevent holdout minority vulture funds from blocking a supermajority approved debt restructuring.
B. force developing nations to surrender their sovereign territorial borders to creditor nations.
C. mandate that all national museum artworks be auctioned to private corporate hedge funds.
D. prohibit international sovereign governments from issuing paper currency for twenty years.
normal.explain: 集體行動條款（CACs）是主權債券合約中的關鍵條款，旨在透過多數決機制，強行遏制極少數禿鷹基金惡意杯葛並阻撓多數通過的債務重組。

normal.desc: 【外匯微觀】Covered Interest Parity deviations in foreign exchange forward markets reflect:
options: A. unconditional federal guarantees that international exchange rates will never fluctuate.
B. persistent cross currency basis spreads resulting from regulatory bank balance sheet constraints.
C. the physical friction of paper banknotes passing through mechanical currency counters.
D. the complete absence of electronic computers across major Wall Street trading desks.
normal.explain: 拋補利率平價（CIP）在現實中的持續偏離，真實反映了各國央行跨境貨幣基差走闊，以及監管政策對商業銀行資產負債表擴張施加的硬性約束。

normal.desc: 請唸出：國際金融學不可能三角三元悖論
normal.explain: impossible trinity trilemma (phr.)：國際金融學不可能三角三元悖論。例句：Central bankers must navigate the tradeoffs dictated by the impossible trinity trilemma.（各大央行行長必須在不可能三角三元悖論所劃定的殘酷邊界內，在資本流動、匯率與利率間做艱難抉擇。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：央行貨幣政策前瞻指引時間不一致性
normal.explain: time inconsistency problem (phr.)：央行貨幣政策前瞻指引時間不一致性。例句：The time inconsistency problem undermines the effectiveness of long term monetary forward guidance.（政策時間不一致性頑疾，會從根本上侵蝕並摧毀央行長期貨幣政策前瞻性指引在市場中的引導威力。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：明斯基金融內生不穩定性龐氏假說
normal.explain: minsky financial instability (phr.)：明斯基金融內生不穩定性龐氏假說。例句：The sudden transition from hedge to speculative finance illustrates the Minsky financial instability thesis.（從健全避險融資向瘋狂投機融資的致命轉向，生動驗證了明斯基金融內生不穩定性假說的深刻洞見。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：恐慌性拋售誘發之債務通縮惡性螺旋
normal.explain: debt deflation spiral (phr.)：恐慌性拋售誘發之債務通縮惡性螺旋。例句：Falling asset prices precipitated an intractable Fisherian debt deflation spiral across sectors.（資產價格雪崩式暴跌，迅速在全產業鏈內部引爆了一場令人窒息的費雪式債務通縮惡性螺旋。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：依據產出與通膨缺口精確測算之泰勒規則
normal.explain: taylor rule prescription (phr.)：依據產出與通膨缺口精確測算之泰勒規則。例句：The benchmark policy rate diverged significantly from the theoretical Taylor rule prescription.（央行實際執行的基準政策利率，在相當長一段時間內與泰勒法則給予的理論政策建議利率發生了顯著背離。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：主權債券合約防範禿鷹基金集體行動條款
normal.explain: collective action clauses (phr.)：主權債券合約防範禿鷹基金集體行動條款。例句：Modern sovereign bonds incorporate collective action clauses to streamline debt restructuring processes.（現代主權債券發行合約普遍強制嵌入了集體行動條款，旨在徹底瓦解少數禿鷹基金對債務重組的惡意勒索。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：平抑隔夜利率跳升之常備回購融通窗口
normal.explain: standing repo facility (phr.)：平抑隔夜利率跳升之常備回購融通窗口。例句：The central bank established a standing repo facility to maintain firm control over money market rates.（央行果斷設立了常設常備回購融通窗口，以確保牢牢掌控短期貨幣市場利率不超出目標利率區間。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：財政赤字綁架央行獨立性之財政主導困境
normal.explain: fiscal dominance dilemma (phr.)：財政赤字綁架央行獨立性之財政主導困境。例句：The central bank was paralyzed by the fiscal dominance dilemma as public debt spiraled out of control.（在公共主權債務如脫韁野馬般瘋狂飆升的絕境下，央行徹底淪陷於動彈不得的財政主導困局之中。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：貨幣面額與鑄造成本之間的差額利潤即鑄幣稅（S 開頭，11 個字母）
normal.explain: SEIGNIORAGE (n.)：貨幣面額與鑄造成本之間的差額利潤即鑄幣稅。例句：Sovereign governments extract seigniorage through the monopoly issuance of fiat currency.（主權國家政府藉由對法定信用貨幣的排他性壟斷發行權，從中攫取了巨額的法定鑄幣稅收益。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：金融危機或市場恐慌從一個市場迅速波及他處的危機傳染（C 開頭，9 個字母）
normal.explain: CONTAGION (n.)：金融危機或市場恐慌從一個市場迅速波及他處的危機傳染。例句：The sudden sovereign default triggered cross border financial contagion across emerging markets.（突發的主權實質違約，以迅雷不及掩耳之勢在新興市場國家之間引發了跨境金融恐慌大傳染。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：透過財政或貨幣手段平抑經濟波動的宏觀經濟穩定化政策（S 開頭，13 個字母）
normal.explain: STABILIZATION (n.)：透過財政或貨幣手段平抑經濟波動的宏觀經濟穩定化政策。例句：Automatic fiscal stabilizers play a vital stabilization role during severe recessionary downturns.（具有自動平抑特性的財政自動穩定器，在深層經濟衰退低谷期發揮著不可或缺的宏觀平準穩定功能。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：央行在外匯干預後透過公開市場操作對沖本幣流動性的沖銷操作（S 開頭，13 個字母）
normal.explain: STERILIZATION (n.)：央行在外匯干預後透過公開市場操作對沖本幣流動性的沖銷操作。例句：The monetary authority conducted sterilization by issuing domestic absorption bills.（貨幣當局在拋售本幣平抑匯率後，立即發行定向央行票據對多餘的流動性實施了全額沖銷。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：政府或中央銀行為改變市場走向而進行的主動干預行動（I 開頭，12 個字母）
normal.explain: INTERVENTION (n.)：政府或中央銀行為改變市場走向而進行的主動干預行動。例句：Coordinated foreign exchange intervention by G7 nations stabilized the plunging exchange rate.（七大工業國集團（G7）實施的跨國聯合外匯市場協同干預，成功穩住了瀕臨崩盤的國際匯率走勢。）

normal.desc: 填空題：S E I G N _ O R A G E (壟斷發行貨幣之鑄幣稅收入)
normal.explain: SEIGNIORAGE (n.)：壟斷發行貨幣之鑄幣稅收入。例句：Excessive extraction of seigniorage through reckless money printing destroys fiat trust.（透過肆無忌憚的印鈔狂潮瘋狂搜刮鑄幣稅，終將徹底摧毀廣大公眾對法定信用貨幣的底層信賴。）

normal.desc: 填空題：S T A _ I L _ Z A _ I O N (平抑產出波動之宏觀穩定手段)
normal.explain: STABILIZATION (n.)：平抑產出波動之宏觀穩定手段。例句：Countercyclical macroeconomic stabilization policies cushion household disposable income.（果斷推行逆週期的總體經濟平準穩定化對策，能在暴風雨中有效守護千家萬戶的基本可支配所得底線。）

normal.desc: 填空題：E Q _ I L _ B R _ U M (勞動與商品市場之供需均衡)
normal.explain: EQUILIBRIUM (n.)：勞動與商品市場之供需均衡。例句：Monetary policy attempts to guide the economy back to its long term non inflationary equilibrium.（宏觀貨幣政策的終極使命，在於巧妙引導國民經濟平穩回歸到其長期的非加速通膨之潛在產出均衡點。）

normal.desc: 填空題：S T E R I L _ Z A T I O N (外匯干預後對沖流動性之沖銷)
normal.explain: STERILIZATION (n.)：外匯干預後對沖流動性之沖銷。例句：Incomplete sterilization of reserve accumulation fueled runaway domestic asset inflation.（對持續湧入的外匯儲備缺乏足額嚴密的流動性沖銷，直接引發了國內股市與地產等實體資產價格的狂飆。）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The principal agent problem flared when executive stock options incentivized excessive short term leverage. What flared?
options: A. The mechanical failure of the executive elevator system inside the corporate headquarters building.
B. A complete refusal of institutional commercial banks to accept corporate equity shares as collateral.
C. A spontaneous strike staged by the company's third party contracted legal accounting auditors.
D. A conflict of interest where managers prioritized their own bonuses over the long term health of shareholders.
normal.explain: 委託代理問題（Principal-agent problem）徹底引爆：職業經理人為在期權解鎖時套現自肥，不惜瘋狂推高企業槓桿，將全體股東的長遠利益置於萬劫不復之地。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Adverse selection severely distorted the private healthcare insurance market as healthy individuals opted out. What occurred?
options: A. The pool became disproportionately populated by high risk, sick individuals, driving premiums higher in a spiral.
B. The national medical authority ordered the immediate destruction of all synthetic pharmaceutical tablets.
C. Private hospitals offered free luxury penthouses to any patient undergoing routine diagnostic checkups.
D. The overall life expectancy of the domestic population increased by twenty five years within a month.
normal.explain: 逆向選擇（Adverse selection）嚴重扭曲了健康險市場：健康人紛紛退出，投保池中只剩下高風險的重症病患，導致保費呈惡性螺旋飆升直至市場崩解。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The auctioneer mitigated the winner's curse by providing certified third party seismic geological surveys. How?
options: A. By mandating that all oil exploration platforms be manufactured entirely from recycled consumer plastics.
B. By eliminating valuation uncertainty regarding the true common volume of the offshore oil reserve.
C. By promising to refund ninety percent of the winning bid if the drill failed to strike oil.
D. By physically escorting all participating corporate executives out of the national territorial waters.
normal.explain: 拍賣行出資提供由權威獨立第三方勘探的精密地質震測報告，徹底消除了各方對深海油田真實儲量的估值不確定性，成功化解了「贏家詛咒」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The psychological sunk cost fallacy prevented the prime minister from aborting the catastrophic infrastructure megaproject. Why?
options: A. Billions of taxpayer dollars had already been spent, blinding leadership to future compounding losses.
B. The engineering blueprints had been engraved onto physical sheets of pure indestructible titanium.
C. The international community threatened to impose sweeping naval blockades if the canal was canceled.
D. The construction workers threatened to convert the heavy machinery into physical modern art sculptures.
normal.explain: 心理學沉沒成本謬誤死死矇蔽了決策層的雙眼：因前期已砸入數百億公帑，政客們寧願任由未來的虧損像滾雪球般不斷翻倍，也絕無勇氣斷然止損喊停。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Hyperbolic discounting in intertemporal choice accounted for chronic societal underinvestment in flood defenses. Why?
options: A. International environmental treaties prohibited the construction of coastal concrete seawall barriers.
B. Voters and politicians heavily devalued future disaster mitigation in favor of immediate tax cuts.
C. Civil engineering firms lacked the mechanical equipment required to pour liquid concrete foundations.
D. The nation experienced sixty consecutive years without a single millimeter of atmospheric rainfall.
normal.explain: 跨期選擇中的極度雙曲貼現深刻解釋了防洪基建投資的長期短視：選民與政客瘋狂折價未來的洪災隱患，只為貪圖眼前的立即減稅小恩小惠。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The firm leveraged the decoy effect by displaying an overpriced premium product to make the mid tier option look cheap. What effect?
options: A. The corporate board authorized a ninety percent discount across all manufactured retail inventory.
B. The company hired Hollywood film actors to endorse their products on late night television broadcasts.
C. An asymmetrically dominated decoy alternative altered customer preferences toward the targeted choice.
D. The marketing division launched a public relations campaign alleging that competitors used toxic dyes.
normal.explain: 該企業精妙操弄非對稱誘餌效應（Decoy effect），刻意在陳列架上擺出一款價格虛高的天價旗艦款作為靶子，瞬間讓利潤豐厚的主力款在顧客眼中顯得物超所值。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The behavioral nudge increased organ donor registration by fifty percentage points overnight. How was it implemented?
options: A. By printing colorful cartoon characters on the reverse side of official sovereign driver licenses.
B. By transitioning the registration system from an explicit opt in to an automatic presumed consent opt out.
C. By paying cash stipends of fifty thousand dollars to every citizen who agreed to register as a donor.
D. By making it a federal criminal offense to refuse organ donation upon clinical declaration of death.
normal.explain: 這項神級行為「推力（Nudge）」在一夜之間將器官捐贈登記率猛推了整整五十個百分點：其唯一改動僅是將原先的「主動勾選加入」改為「默認推定同意（預設退出制）」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Signaling theory clarified why elite law firms require arduous eighty hour work weeks from junior associates. Why?
options: A. The senior partners were bound by medieval religious oaths requiring monastic sleep deprivation.
B. The municipal government imposed a luxury tax on any commercial law firm whose lights were extinguished.
C. The grueling work schedule operates as a costly screening mechanism to filter for extreme stamina.
D. The firms lacked sufficient electronic computers, forcing lawyers to handwrite contracts on parchment.
normal.explain: 訊號理論（Signaling theory）一語道破天機：頂級律所之所以對初級律師強制要求每週高達八十小時的魔鬼工時，本質上是將其作為篩選極致抗壓耐力的殘酷訊號篩檢工具。

normal.desc: 【演化博弈】In repeated Prisoner's Dilemma interactions, the Tit for Tat strategy excels because it is:
options: A. consistently predatory, betraying partners on every single round without exception.
B. completely randomized, deciding actions by measuring ambient seismic tectonic vibrations.
C. permanently inactive, withdrawing from all economic transactions for decades.
D. nice, retaliatory, forgiving, and clear, promoting cooperative equilibrium under reciprocity.
normal.explain: 在重複囚徒困境博弈中，「以牙還牙（Tit-for-Tat）」策略之所以橫掃群雄，因其兼具善良（不率先背叛）、報復、寬容與透明性四大優良品質。

normal.desc: 【機制設計】The Vickrey Clark Groves mechanism solves public goods allocation dilemmas by:
options: A. charging each participant the externality cost their presence imposes on other bidders.
B. confiscating one hundred percent of private property and redistributing it via lottery.
C. mandating that all public infrastructure be funded entirely through private donations.
D. prohibiting the use of currency or price mechanisms across all economic sectors.
normal.explain: VCG 機制（Vickrey-Clarke-Groves）透過對每位參與者精確徵收「其存在給他人造成的淨外部性代價」，激勵所有人如實呈報真實估值。

normal.desc: 【資訊不對稱】George Akerlof's Market for Lemons demonstrates that asymmetric information causes:
options: A. monopolistic cartels to voluntarily dissolve their operations and distribute cash.
B. adverse selection, driving high quality goods out of the market and precipitating market collapse.
C. an immediate explosion in consumer satisfaction across all commercial transactions.
D. a sudden decrease in the manufacturing cost of consumer electronic appliances.
normal.explain: 阿克洛夫的「檸檬市場（Market for Lemons）」理論證明：買賣雙方的資訊不對稱會引發「逆向選擇（Adverse selection）」，劣幣驅逐良幣直至市場崩盤。

normal.desc: 【群體迷思】Irving Janis's Groupthink phenomenon emerges in cohesive decision bodies characterized by:
options: A. an illusion of invulnerability, collective rationalization, and self censorship of dissenting opinions.
B. relentless, aggressive internal debate that paralyzes executive operational decision making.
C. mandatory anonymous voting overseen by external independent judicial ombudsmen.
D. a complete refusal of corporate leaders to communicate with one another during meetings.
normal.explain: 歐文·賈尼斯的「群體迷思（Groupthink）」揭示：在高度凝聚的高層決策圈中，盲目的無敵幻覺、群體合理化與對異見的集體自我審查會誘發災難性錯誤。

normal.desc: 【公共財悲歌】Elinor Ostrom's Nobel prize winning research on Common Pool Resources demonstrated that:
options: A. shared natural ecosystems inevitably collapse within twenty four hours of exploitation.
B. communities can self govern shared natural commons through nested, community crafted institutional rules.
C. all natural resources must be privatized or nationalized under central military command.
D. human beings are genetically incapable of cooperating without physical violent coercion.
normal.explain: 埃莉諾·歐斯壯（Elinor Ostrom）的諾貝爾獎研究粉碎了「公地悲劇」宿命論，證明在地社群能透過自我制定的多層次自主治理制度，永續守護公共資源池。

normal.desc: 【賽局極限】The Winner's Curse in common value auctions describes the tragic realization that:
options: A. the purchased item evaporated into thin air immediately following the conclusion of the auction.
B. all other bidders received a full refund of their personal net worth from the national treasury.
C. the winning bidder overpaid because their optimistic valuation exceeded the asset's true common worth.
D. the auctioneer surrendered the prize to an individual who placed the lowest financial bid.
normal.explain: 贏家詛咒（Winner's Curse）揭示了在共同價值拍賣中的殘酷鐵律：出價最高一舉得標的贏家往往淪為最大輸家，因其估值過於樂觀而支付了遠超資產真實價值的代價。

normal.desc: 【多臂老虎機】The Explore Exploit tradeoff in reinforcement learning and human decision theory balances:
options: A. abandoning all historical scientific knowledge every five minutes to invent new concepts.
B. gathering new information on uncertain alternatives versus harvesting rewards from known choices.
C. spending one hundred percent of daily computational budget on searching for lost keys.
D. refusing to consume any food unless it has been analyzed in a chemical mass spectrometer.
normal.explain: 探索與利用的權衡（Explore-Exploit Tradeoff）深刻刻畫了智慧實體在面對不確定未來時的永恆兩難：是該冒險探索新知，還是穩妥收割既有已知回報。

normal.desc: 【社會偏好】Fehr and Schmidt's model of Inequity Aversion mathematically captures:
options: A. the complete indifference humans display toward whether fellow citizens are starving or wealthy.
B. the mathematical impossibility of calculating gross domestic product across sovereign states.
C. disutility generated both from advantageous inequality (guilt) and disadvantageous inequality (envy).
D. an individual's absolute, unyielding desire to maximize their own consumption at any social cost.
normal.explain: 費爾與施密特的不平等厭惡模型（Inequity Aversion）精確量化了人類心靈的複雜社會偏好：人們不僅痛恨落後於人的「嫉妒」，同樣會因過度佔優而萌生「內疚」。

normal.desc: 請唸出：以牙還牙之博弈合作互惠平衡
normal.explain: tit for tat reciprocity (phr.)：以牙還牙之博弈合作互惠平衡。例句：Game theorists verified that tit for tat reciprocity stabilizes long term bilateral peace.（博弈論巨擘透過嚴密數學證明：以牙還牙的互惠反制法則，是在混亂博弈中確立長久雙邊和平合作的基石。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：逆向選擇誘發市場崩潰之死亡螺旋
normal.explain: adverse selection death spiral (phr.)：逆向選擇誘發市場崩潰之死亡螺旋。例句：Without universal mandates, private healthcare markets risk an adverse selection death spiral.（若缺乏普遍納保的制度性強制約束，商業健康險市場將極易滑入逆向選擇的萬劫不復死亡螺旋之中。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：共同價值拍賣中因過度樂觀之贏家詛咒
normal.explain: winner curse in common auctions (phr.)：共同價值拍賣中因過度樂觀之贏家詛咒。例句：Prudent bidders shade their valuations downward to avoid the winner curse in common auctions.（冷靜睿智的競標者往往會在拍賣中主動調降自己的最終報價，以防深陷共同價值拍賣中慘絕人寰的贏家詛咒。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：有限理性在複雜現實決策中之邊界
normal.explain: bounded rationality doctrine (phr.)：有限理性在複雜現實決策中之邊界。例句：The bounded rationality doctrine acknowledges that human cognitive throughput is inherently finite.（有限理性學說從根本上承認：人類大腦在面對大千世界時，其認知運算與資訊處理的吞吐容量生來就是極其有限的。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：短視近利即時滿足之雙曲貼現困局
normal.explain: hyperbolic discounting dilemma (phr.)：短視近利即時滿足之雙曲貼現困局。例句：Public policy struggles to overcome the hyperbolic discounting dilemma in climate change mitigation.（在推進全球氣候變遷治理的艱難進程中，各國公共政策無時無刻不在與人性深處短視近利的雙曲貼現困局死磕。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：職業經理人與全體股東之委託代理衝突
normal.explain: principal agent conflict (phr.)：職業經理人與全體股東之委託代理衝突。例句：Independent audit committees are established to mitigate the severe principal agent conflict.（上市公司專門成立由獨立董事組成的審計委員會，旨在化解職業高階主管與全體股東之間尖銳的委託代理利益衝突。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：對極端貧富不均與不公平之效用厭惡
normal.explain: inequity aversion utility (phr.)：對極端貧富不均與不公平之效用厭惡。例句：Experimental economics models include inequity aversion utility to explain generous ultimatum offers.（實驗經濟學模型精巧納入了不平等厭惡效用函數，從而科學解釋了最後通牒博弈中提議者為何總是傾向於慷慨分錢。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：默認推定同意之行為科學預設退出制
normal.explain: presumed consent opt out (phr.)：默認推定同意之行為科學預設退出制。例句：The healthcare authority enacted a presumed consent opt out policy to replenish the organ donor pool.（公共衛生主管部門大膽推行了「默認推定同意」的預設退出制度，在一夜之間奇蹟般充實了瀕危枯竭的器官捐贈庫存。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：交易各方所掌握之資訊極度不平等非對稱的（A 開頭，10 個字母）
normal.explain: ASYMMETRIC (adj.)：交易各方所掌握之資訊極度不平等非對稱的。例句：Asymmetric information creates profound market failures across used car sales lots.（極度的資訊不對稱，在二手車交易市場等廣泛領域引發了極其深刻的市場失靈與信賴危機。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：不求任何回報而主動為他人利益奉獻的利他主義（A 開頭，8 個字母）
normal.explain: ALTRUISM (n.)：不求任何回報而主動為他人利益奉獻的利他主義。例句：Evolutionary biologists model reciprocal altruism as a driver of societal cohesion.（演化生物學家將「互惠利他主義」建模為凝聚複雜人類社會、促進跨種族合作的底層演化驅動力。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：人際交往中投桃報李或以眼還眼的互惠原則（R 開頭，11 個字母）
normal.explain: RECIPROCITY (n.)：人際交往中投桃報李或以眼還眼的互惠原則。例句：Social networks function on informal norms of strong reciprocity and mutual assistance.（人類社會網絡的蓬勃運轉，高度仰賴強互惠原則以及鄰里間守望相助等非正式非成文的道德準則。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：經濟活動對毫無關聯的第三方所施加的外部性代價（E 開頭，11 個字母）
normal.explain: EXTERNALITY (n.)：經濟活動對毫無關聯的第三方所施加的外部性代價。例句：Carbon taxes are enacted to internalize the negative environmental externality of emissions.（各國開徵碳排稅的根本戰略意圖，正是為了將工業化石能源排放所帶來的負向環境外部性徹底內部化。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：在受限條件下追求利益極大化之理性能動性（R 開頭，11 個字母）
normal.explain: RATIONALITY (n.)：在受限條件下追求利益極大化之理性能動性。例句：Behavioral economics challenges the axiomatic foundation of hyper individual rationality.（行為經濟學的橫空出世，徹底動搖並重塑了古典經濟學長期奉為圭臬的極致個人完全理性公理基石。）

normal.desc: 填空題：A S Y M M _ T R I C (雙方掌握資訊懸殊非對稱)
normal.explain: ASYMMETRIC (adj.)：雙方掌握資訊懸殊非對稱。例句：Used vehicle markets suffer when seller knowledge is profoundly asymmetric.（當賣方對車況暗疾瞭如指掌而買方一無所知時，嚴重的資訊非對稱將讓交易徹底陷入死胡同。）

normal.desc: 填空題：R E _ I P _ O C _ T Y (人際互動投桃報李之互惠)
normal.explain: RECIPROCITY (n.)：人際互動投桃報李之互惠。例句：Long term diplomatic stability relies on steady diplomatic norms of bilateral reciprocity.（跨國雙邊外交關係的長期穩固如山，高度仰賴國與國之間始終如一、恪守不移的對等互惠外交準則。）

normal.desc: 填空題：P A _ E R _ A L _ S M (出於關懷而實施之制度家長作風)
normal.explain: PATERNALISM (n.)：出於關懷而實施之制度家長作風。例句：Critics decried mandatory sugar taxes as an overreach of governmental paternalism.（部分崇尚自由意志的批評人士痛斥：強徵含糖飲料稅，是政府權力手伸得過長的家長作風越界之舉。）

normal.desc: 填空題：E X T E R _ A L I T Y (製造業向社會轉嫁之外部性)
normal.explain: EXTERNALITY (n.)：製造業向社會轉嫁之外部性。例句：Noise pollution from urban airports represents a chronic uncompensated negative externality.（大都市核心機場日夜不休的起降噪音污染，是長期強加給周邊數十萬居民且未給予分毫補償的負外部性。）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The submarine launched ballistic missile executed an encrypted burst transmission from the abyss. What occurred?
options: A. A highly secure, microsecond radio burst was transmitted without compromising the vessel's acoustic stealth.
B. The submarine physically breached the surface and raised a massive physical signal flag to communicate.
C. The vessel discharged its entire payload of high explosive torpedoes into the open international ocean.
D. The submarine crew permanently disabled the vessel's nuclear propulsion reactor to conserve fresh water.
normal.explain: 該艘戰略彈道飛彈核潛艦從深海發射了一記高度加密的微秒級閃頻信號（Burst transmission），在完全不破壞自身極致水下聲學隱形的前提下完成了戰略密鑰交接。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The non state proxy force conducted a swarming attack utilizing low cost commercial drone munitions. What was achieved?
options: A. The immediate surrender of five international aircraft carrier strike battle groups without firing a shot.
B. Asymmetrical saturation of advanced, multi million dollar air defense radars through mass drone attrition.
C. The complete physical destruction of the planet's entire semiconductor manufacturing capacity.
D. A formal declaration that the rebel group was henceforth recognized as a sovereign nuclear state.
normal.explain: 該非國家代理人武裝透過鋪天蓋地的低成本商用無人機狼群飽和打擊（Swarming attack），成功用白菜價的自爆機徹底耗盡了敵軍價值連城的防空攔截彈藥儲備。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The strategic bomber wing demonstrated continuous airborne alert during escalating geopolitical crises. Why?
options: A. To consume excess aviation fuel supplies before the expiration of the annual municipal fiscal budget.
B. To search the upper atmosphere for evidence of extraterrestrial biological biological organisms.
C. To ensure an airborne nuclear leg that could not be wiped out by surprise preemptive strikes on airfields.
D. To practice aerial acrobatic stunt maneuvers for an upcoming international commercial aviation airshow.
normal.explain: 戰略轟炸機聯隊在危機升級時全天候執行「空中戒備巡航（Airborne alert）」，確保即便本土地面機場遭敵突襲抹平，核三位一體的空基打擊矛頭依舊在萬米高空呼嘯待命。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The national defense strategy shifted from forward defense to deep strategic depth across border terrain. Why?
options: A. To convert all border mountain ranges into public national recreational snow skiing resorts.
B. To absorb the adversary's initial blitzkrieg offensive and trade space for time until mobilization completes.
C. To abandon the national capital city permanently and establish an offshore oceanic floating republic.
D. Because the national treasury could no longer afford to purchase petroleum fuel for armored tanks.
normal.explain: 國防戰略大刀闊斧從「前沿禦敵」轉向「縱深防禦」，旨在利用廣袤縱深主動吸收侵略者的第一波閃電突擊衝量，以空間換取寶貴時間以完成舉國總動員。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The space domain command monitored counterspace anti satellite weapons testing in low earth orbit. What was tracked?
options: A. Manned space shuttles delivering diplomatic negotiators to an orbiting space station conference.
B. Astronomical space telescopes observing the birth of distant galaxies in the deep universe.
C. Direct ascent kinetic interceptors capable of obliterating vital reconnaissance and GPS satellites.
D. High powered lasers designed to project commercial billboard advertisements onto the moon's surface.
normal.explain: 太空作戰司令部全天候緊盯低軌道反衛星試驗（ASAT），嚴密追蹤具備動能直衝打擊能力、足以在一瞬間癱瘓全軍 GPS 導航與間諜偵察衛星的致命太空殺手。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The legal attache invoked sovereign immunity to shield state owned maritime assets from judicial arrest. What was shielded?
options: A. Private luxury yachts belonging to fugitive real estate billionaires convicted of financial embezzlement.
B. Commercial cargo vessels caught smuggling counterfeit luxury consumer fashion handbags.
C. Foreign fishing trawlers operating illegally inside designated marine nature preserves.
D. Naval auxiliary and state vessels from being seized by foreign commercial civil courts over debt disputes.
normal.explain: 隨軍法律顧問鄭重援引「主權豁免權（Sovereign immunity）」，成功在法理上粉碎了外國商業海事法院企圖因民事債務糾紛而扣押本國軍用輔助艦艇的企圖。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The comprehensive test ban treaty monitoring system detected an anomalous low yield seismic event. What was detected?
options: A. The controlled demolition of an obsolete reinforced concrete highway bridge structure.
B. A massive rockfall occurring in an uninhabited, isolated mountain national park region.
C. A potential subterranean nuclear explosion triggering high sensitivity acoustic and radionuclide sensors.
D. A natural tectonic earthquake occurring along a well documented oceanic fault line zone.
normal.explain: 全面禁止核試驗條約（CTBT）全球監控網捕獲到一組異常低當量微震訊號，高靈敏放射性核種探針隨即在空氣中捕獲到了伴隨釋放出的微量氙同位素氣體。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The treaty required reciprocal on site inspections of warhead dismantlement facilities under strict protocols. How?
options: A. Participating nations submitted unverified, voluntary declarations via international postal mail.
B. The inspection process was conducted by watching unedited satellite television entertainment broadcasts.
C. All dismantling facilities were required to be constructed inside transparent glass domes.
D. International verification teams personally oversaw the irreversible physical neutralization of warheads.
normal.explain: 該裁軍條約明文要求實施嚴格對等的「現場核查（On-site inspection）」，國際核查專家親臨絕密廠房，親眼監督並確認核彈頭被不可逆地徹底切割銷毀。

normal.desc: 【大戰略理論】In grand strategy, the concept of offshore balancing dictates that an insular hegemon should:
options: A. rely on regional allies to contain potential Eurasian hegemons, intervening with force only when local balances collapse.
B. conquer and permanently occupy every single square mile of the Eurasian continental landmass.
C. dismantle its entire navy and air force to focus exclusively on domestic organic agriculture.
D. distribute high technology military weapons free of charge to any foreign sovereign nation.
normal.explain: 離岸平衡戰略（Offshore balancing）主張：遠離歐亞大陸的海權大國應優先扶植在地盟友去牽制潛在歐亞霸主，唯有在均勢徹底破裂時方親自出兵。

normal.desc: 【核戰略危機】Thomas Schelling's threat that leaves something to chance demonstrates that in brinkmanship:
options: A. ambassadors must be replaced by randomized lottery selection among civilian teenagers.
B. credibility is generated by relinquishing complete control, introducing autonomous escalation risks neither side can stop.
C. leaders must publish certified handwritten letters confirming they will never use military force.
D. military alliances should be dissolved immediately upon the commencement of diplomatic discussions.
normal.explain: 湯瑪斯·謝林提出的「讓機率起作用的威脅（Threat that leaves something to chance）」證明：邊緣政策之所以具備威懾力，正在於主動引入連自身都無法完全掌控的失控升級風險。

normal.desc: 【地緣經濟學】The Geoeconomic Weaponization of global supply networks operates through:
options: A. the immediate worldwide prohibition of electronic digital computing equipment.
B. forcing all international business travelers to walk across continental land bridges on foot.
C. weaponized central hubs where control over choke points yields coercive extraterritorial power.
D. mandatory physical seizure of all foreign cargo ships by coastal civilian fishermen.
normal.explain: 全球供應鏈網絡的地緣經濟武器化（Geoeconomics）運作機制表明：對關鍵咽喉節點（如半導體光刻機、特種氣體）的絕對控制，能轉化為無可匹敵的跨境強制威懾力。

normal.desc: 【國際體系】An Anarchic Hegemony transition, as modeled by Organski's Power Transition Theory, occurs when:
options: A. the world's oceans dry up, converting international sea routes into desert sand valleys.
B. a dissatisfied rising challenger approaches power parity with the dominant status quo power, maximizing war risk.
C. all world nations unilaterally destroy their national currency reserves simultaneously.
D. the United Nations General Assembly votes to abolish all sovereign armed forces globally.
normal.explain: 奧甘斯基的權力轉移理論（Power Transition Theory）深刻指出：當對現有國際秩序深感不滿的新興挑戰者，在綜合國力上逼近既有體系主導霸權國時，爆發霸權大戰的風險達到歷史極值。

normal.desc: 【非對稱衝突】Anti Access Area Denial (A2/AD) capabilities deployed by coastal powers function to:
options: A. mandate that all foreign commercial container ships paint their hulls in bright yellow enamel.
B. ban the construction of lighthouses and coastal optical navigation aids across territorial waters.
C. prevent an adversary from occupying an operational theatre or contest their freedom of movement within it.
D. permanently close all commercial fish markets along national sovereign coastlines.
normal.explain: 反介入與區域拒止體系（A2/AD）透過密集部署遠端反艦彈道飛彈與防空網，旨在重挫敵對遠洋艦隊進入特定作戰海域的能力，或將其行動自由狠狠壓縮在防禦圈外。

normal.desc: 【情報特權】The Five Eyes intelligence sharing alliance distinguishes itself globally by:
options: A. requiring all participating intelligence officers to wear formal tuxedo attire during interrogations.
B. prohibiting the use of computers, requiring all surveillance reports to be delivered by carrier pigeons.
C. conducting public television livestream broadcasts of classified national security meetings.
D. unprecedented, highly automated multi spectral signals intelligence sharing among five Anglophone democracies.
normal.explain: 五眼聯盟（Five Eyes）在國際情報史上空前絕後：美英澳加紐五個英語系民主體制之間建立了高度自動化、深度共享的全頻譜訊號情報（SIGINT）即時互通網路。

normal.desc: 【核子威懾】Counterforce versus Countervalue nuclear targeting strategies diverge in that:
options: A. counterforce is authorized only during total peace, while countervalue is declared after war concludes.
B. counterforce targets agricultural wheat farms, while countervalue bombs offshore coral reef ecosystems.
C. counterforce targets an adversary's military infrastructure and missile silos, while countervalue targets cities and population.
D. counterforce relies exclusively on conventional artillery, while countervalue employs biological pathogens.
normal.explain: 反軍力（Counterforce）與反價值（Countervalue）打擊策略呈現本質鴻溝：前者專注於外科手術般精確摧毀敵軍飛彈發射井與指揮中樞，後者則以抹平敵方大都市與人口核心為報復目標。

normal.desc: 【外交豁免】Diplomatic pouch inviolability under international treaty strictly precludes host authorities from:
options: A. charging postage fees for delivering printed holiday greeting postcards between embassies.
B. requiring diplomatic couriers to present valid sovereign passports when clearing border customs.
C. inspecting the mechanical air conditioning filters inside foreign embassy administration suites.
D. opening, detaining, scanning, or inspecting official sealed diplomatic correspondence and cargo shipments.
normal.explain: 《維也納公約》賦予外交郵袋（Diplomatic pouch）神聖不可侵犯的最高特權：駐在國任何執法人員在任何情況下，皆被嚴格禁止開拆、扣留、透視或檢查經封印的外交郵包。

normal.desc: 請唸出：離岸平衡之大國制衡戰略構想
normal.explain: offshore balancing grand strategy (phr.)：離岸平衡之大國制衡戰略構想。例句：Scholars advocate an offshore balancing grand strategy to preserve military assets and avoid entanglements.（頂尖地緣戰略學者極力建言採納離岸平衡大戰略，藉由扶植在地均勢以避免本國捲入曠日持久的歐亞泥淖。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：將對抗推向核毀滅邊緣之險棋升級
normal.explain: nuclear brinkmanship escalation (phr.)：將對抗推向核毀滅邊緣之險棋升級。例句：The standoff worsened as reckless rhetoric accelerated nuclear brinkmanship escalation.（隨著前線互嗆言辭日趨狂妄激化，這場地緣對峙正以令人窒息的速度向核邊緣政策的失控深淵狂飆升級。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：拒止強敵介入之反介入區域拒止體系
normal.explain: anti access area denial (phr.)：拒止強敵介入之反介入區域拒止體系。例句：Coastal missile regiments erected a dense anti access area denial envelope across the maritime approaches.（沿海重型飛彈旅在海峽關鍵航道上，築起了一道水下、海面與防空立體交叉的嚴密反介入區域拒止鐵幕。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：守成霸主與新興挑戰者之權力轉移律
normal.explain: power transition theory dynamics (phr.)：守成霸主與新興挑戰者之權力轉移律。例句：Analyzing historical conflicts validates the core tenets of power transition theory dynamics.（縱覽數百年世界帝國興衰史，無情印證了權力轉移理論所揭示的新興力量逼近霸主時必然爆發的劇烈陣痛。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：五眼聯盟全天候跨國情報深度互通
normal.explain: five eyes intelligence sharing (phr.)：五眼聯盟全天候跨國情報深度互通。例句：Operational coordination was streamlined via the automated Five Eyes intelligence sharing pipeline.（各軍兵種作戰指令的精準協同，得益於五眼聯盟後台那套高度自動化、即時互通的深層情報共用管道。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：公海航行自由無害通過之海洋自由論
normal.explain: mare liberum oceanic doctrine (phr.)：公海航行自由無害通過之海洋自由論。例句：International naval coalitions defend the timeless mare liberum oceanic doctrine across international straits.（多國海軍聯合編隊巡弋於重要國際海峽，用現代堅船利炮堅定捍衛著歷史悠久的「海洋自由論」法理基石。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：外交郵袋免受任何開拆搜查之神聖不可侵犯
normal.explain: diplomatic pouch inviolability (phr.)：外交郵袋免受任何開拆搜查之神聖不可侵犯。例句：Customs authorities respected diplomatic pouch inviolability despite suspicions of illicit espionage materials.（儘管邊境海關明知包裹內極可能夾帶敏感間諜器材，但基於外交郵袋絕對不可侵犯的國際法鐵律仍予以免檢放行。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：長航程自主潛航無人深海探測系統
normal.explain: unmanned autonomous underwater (phr.)：長航程自主潛航無人深海探測系統。例句：Deep sea patrols increasingly deploy unmanned autonomous underwater vehicles for bathymetric reconnaissance.（各大遠洋海軍在執行極端深海巡邏時，正日益全面依賴大續航力長航程的自主無人潛航器實施海底深層勘探。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：外交使節、使館館舍或外交公文享有的不可侵犯性（I 開頭，13 個字母）
normal.explain: INVIOLABILITY (n.)：外交使節、使館館舍或外交公文享有的不可侵犯性。例句：The physical inviolability of diplomatic premises is an absolute cornerstone of statecraft.（外交使領館館舍在物理與法理上的絕對不可侵犯性，是數百年現代國際外交關係最核心的基石。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：在國際武裝衝突或戰爭狀態中處於交戰狀態的交戰國（B 開頭，11 個字母）
normal.explain: BELLIGERENT (n.)：在國際武裝衝突或戰爭狀態中處於交戰狀態的交戰國。例句：International humanitarian law imposes strict battlefield obligations on any active belligerent.（國際人道法對身處血腥戰火之中的任何合法正式交戰國，皆施加了保護平民與戰俘的嚴苛戰場義務。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：交戰雙方經談判達成暫時停止敵對軍事行動的停戰協定（A 開頭，9 個字母）
normal.explain: ARMISTICE (n.)：交戰雙方經談判達成暫時停止敵對軍事行動的停戰協定。例句：An official armistice halted active fighting along the demarcated military cease fire line.（一份由交戰各方歷經艱難博弈所共同簽署的正式停戰協定，終於讓軍事分界線兩側的漫天砲火歸於沉寂。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：戰場上殘害人體肢體或毀壞文化遺跡的殘損毀壞罪行（M 開頭，10 個字母）
normal.explain: MUTILATION (n.)：戰場上殘害人體肢體或毀壞文化遺跡的殘損毀壞罪行。例句：The Geneva Conventions strictly prohibit the torture, humiliation, or physical mutilation of captives.（日內瓦公約以最嚴厲的法律措辭，明文嚴禁對任何在押戰俘實施任何形式的酷刑摧殘、人格羞辱或肢體殘損。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：一國在遭受對方違法侵害後採取的同等對稱報復手段（R 開頭，8 個字母）
normal.explain: REPRISAL (n.)：一國在遭受對方違法侵害後採取的同等對稱報復手段。例句：International law permits non violent economic reprisal only when an internationally wrongful act occurs.（國際法嚴格規定：唯有在遭受他國明確違背國際義務的侵害後，受害國方有權採取對等的非武裝經濟反制報復。）

normal.desc: 填空題：I N V I O L _ B I L I T Y (使領館享有的絕對不可侵犯權)
normal.explain: INVIOLABILITY (n.)：使領館享有的絕對不可侵犯權。例句：Host government security forces may not breach the legal inviolability of the embassy.（駐在國各類武裝警察與安全部隊，在任何緊急藉口下皆絕對無權強闖並踐踏大使館的法定不可侵犯權。）

normal.desc: 填空題：A R _ I _ T _ C E (暫停敵對開火之停戰協定)
normal.explain: ARMISTICE (n.)：暫停敵對開火之停戰協定。例句：Celebratory crowds filled the streets as wireless broadcasts announced the formal armistice.（當無線電廣播正式向全世界公佈簽署停戰協定的捷報時，欣喜若狂的人群瞬間湧滿了各國的大街小巷。）

normal.desc: 填空題：E X T R _ T E R _ I T O _ I A L (跨越國界實施之長臂域外管轄)
normal.explain: EXTRATERRITORIAL (adj.)：跨越國界實施之長臂域外管轄。例句：Companies complained about the disruptive extraterritorial reach of foreign commercial courts.（眾多跨國商會紛紛抗議，強烈不滿外國商業法庭利用長臂管轄將手伸向境外企業正常經營的域外干涉。）

normal.desc: 填空題：M U T I L _ T I O N (人道法嚴懲之戰俘殘損虐待)
normal.explain: MUTILATION (n.)：人道法嚴懲之戰俘殘損虐待。例句：War crime investigators uncovered documented evidence of deliberate civilian mutilation.（海牙戰犯調查組在戰火重災區，挖掘出侵略軍蓄意殘害並肢解無辜平民的無可辯駁鐵證。）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The high court issued an injunction halting oil exploration along the pristine coastal reef shelf. Why?
options: A. The fishing trawler fleet went on strike, blocking the commercial harbor entrance channels.
B. The exploratory vessel was flying an unauthorized naval battle flag from the eighteenth century.
C. The exploratory seismic airgun blasting posed severe, irreversible threats to marine mammals and biodiversity.
D. The oil conglomerate refused to pay luxury corporate entertainment taxes to the municipal mayor.
normal.explain: 最高法院簽發了緊急禁制令，當庭叫停了在純淨珊瑚礁陸棚上的一切石油勘探，嚴詞痛斥震耳欲聾的高壓震測空氣槍作業將給深海鯨豚與海洋生物多樣性帶來不可逆的毀滅性殘害。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The climate attribution study demonstrated with ninety nine percent certainty that the deadly heatwave was human induced. How?
options: A. By interviewing five hundred senior citizens regarding their personal recollections of childhood summer weather.
B. By measuring the physical temperature of molten volcanic magma inside active geological craters.
C. By analyzing handwritten meteorological logbooks kept by seventeenth century sailing ship captains.
D. By running counterfactual climate models simulating an atmosphere devoid of anthropogenic greenhouse gas emissions.
normal.explain: 極端氣候事件歸因科學研究（Attribution study）透過大型超級電腦運算完全剔除人為碳排的反事實氣候模擬模型，以 99% 的驚人統計置信度鐵證如山地判定：這場百年一遇的奪命熱浪純係人禍所致。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The legal challenge alleged that the government violated the public trust doctrine by granting unbridled fracking permits. What was alleged?
options: A. A catastrophic breach of sovereign custodial duty to protect common water tables from hazardous hydrocarbon contamination.
B. That government officials accepted bribes denominated in physical gold bullion bars from petroleum lobbyists.
C. That the regulatory agency used outdated typewriter machines to issue commercial drilling licenses.
D. That the natural gas extraction process caused minor cosmetic paint chipping on neighboring barn fences.
normal.explain: 氣候訴訟公益律師團在訴狀中嚴詞控訴：政府向頁岩氣水力壓裂肆無忌憚大開綠燈，嚴重背棄了守護全體國民共用地下水脈不受致命化學烴類劇毒污染的「公共信託憲政受託人天職」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The carbon accounting audit revealed massive double counting of forest conservation offsets across sovereign registries. What occurred?
options: A. The forestry department accidentally printed twice as many paper certificate diplomas for park rangers.
B. The satellite sensor counted individual tree branches instead of measuring total tree trunk biomass.
C. The carbon registry lost its digital database records following an electrical power surge in the office.
D. Both the host nation and the purchasing multinational corporation claimed the identical metric ton of reduced emissions.
normal.explain: 嚴格的碳會計獨立審計揭露了一樁驚天醜聞：主權東道國與跨國採購巨頭竟在各自的減排清單中同時重複計算了同一公噸森林碳匯，造成嚴重的「雙重計算（Double counting）」作弊。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The environmental ombudsman investigated the chemical conglomerate under the polluter pays principle. What was pursued?
options: A. Holding the enterprise legally and financially liable for the full remediation and environmental damages caused.
B. Awarding the chemical company a multi million dollar taxpayer subsidy to upgrade its office furniture.
C. Forcing the corporate chief executive officer to spend thirty days cultivating a domestic organic vegetable patch.
D. Banning the commercial sale of chemistry laboratory glass test tubes across the entire sovereign nation.
normal.explain: 國家環境特派專員公署依據「污染者付費原則（Polluter Pays Principle）」雷霆立案，誓要窮盡法律手段追討到底，勒令該跨國化工巨頭全額承擔高達數億美元的地下水土壤全面修復治理費用。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The climate risk stress testing of the sovereign wealth portfolio mandated aggressive transition scenario modeling. What was tested?
options: A. The durability of electronic server computers when subjected to high humidity environments.
B. The economic solvency of state assets under rapid policy shifts toward net zero, carbon pricing, and renewable dominance.
C. The physical ability of corporate executives to run twenty miles during simulated meteorological typhoons.
D. The market valuation of historical sovereign gold coins during periods of political peacetime stability.
normal.explain: 主權基金氣候風險壓力測試強制引入激進的「綠色轉型情境建模」，全方位推演在極端嚴厲的碳定價、新能源顛覆性崛起等政策劇震下，旗下數千億美元主權投資組合的底層償債抗風險能力。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The biodiversity loss threshold triggered a cascade of local trophic collapses throughout the inland freshwater basin. What triggered?
options: A. The extinction of keystone apex predator species led to uncontrolled prey proliferation and ecosystem degradation.
B. The freshwater lake water level dropped by two centimeters during a routine summer heatwave.
C. Fishermen caught twenty percent fewer carp fish than in the previous record breaking fishing season.
D. The municipal water filtration facility temporarily replaced its sand filters with charcoal pellets.
normal.explain: 生物多樣性喪失越過關鍵紅線，引發了整個內陸淡水流域慘絕人寰的「營養級連鎖崩潰（Trophic cascade）」：頂級關鍵捕食者的絕跡，導致次級生物惡性瘋長，整座湖泊生態在一夕間走向腐殖質死亡。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The environmental compliance monitors detected clandestine flaring of methane gas at remote shale extraction pads. What was caught?
options: A. The accidental ignition of ambient atmospheric air due to mechanical sparks from metal machinery.
B. Illegal burning of potent greenhouse hydrocarbons to evade statutory fugitive emissions penalties.
C. The unauthorized roasting of agricultural maize ears by junior field petroleum engineering technicians.
D. The use of industrial gas burners to illuminate drilling work sites during midnight operations.
normal.explain: 環境執法無人機紅外巡航，在偏遠頁岩氣鑽井平台抓了個現形：採油廠商為規避鉅額逃逸排放罰款，竟在深夜暗中秘密點火燃燒海量高純度強效溫室氣體甲烷（Clandestine flaring）。

normal.desc: 【環境法理】The Public Trust Doctrine in environmental constitutionalism establishes that:
options: A. the sovereign government must auction all national parks to multinational extractive mining conglomerates.
B. citizens are legally prohibited from gazing upon the open ocean without purchasing an entry permit.
C. certain natural resources like navigable waters and shorelines are held in trust by the state for the public.
D. private real estate tycoons possess the unreviewable right to drain and pave over public wetlands.
normal.explain: 公共信託理論（Public Trust Doctrine）是環境憲政主義的靈魂：江河、海岸線與大氣等公共自然資源係由國家代全體人民與後代子孫神聖信託保管，任何權貴皆不得私相授受。

normal.desc: 【地球系統科學】Tipping elements in the Earth system (such as the Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation) are characterized by:
options: A. a slow, perfectly linear and predictable decline that automatically reverses itself every century.
B. their total independence from atmospheric temperatures and greenhouse gas concentrations.
C. their occurrence exclusively inside simulated computer video games without real world manifestation.
D. nonlinear thresholds where modest incremental warming triggers catastrophic, irreversible systemic shifts.
normal.explain: 大西洋經向翻轉環流（AMOC）等「地球系統臨界元素（Tipping elements）」具備致命的非線性閾值特徵：微小的邊際增溫，便足以觸發全球氣候系統向不可逆的毀滅性新狀態坍塌。

normal.desc: 【國際環境法】The Precautionary Principle, articulated in the Rio Declaration, mandates that:
options: A. where there are threats of serious or irreversible damage, lack of full scientific certainty shall not excuse postponing cost effective measures.
B. governments must wait until one hundred percent of ecosystems collapse before adopting environmental statutes.
C. scientific research into climate change must be defunded and prohibited by international treaty.
D. all industrial manufacturers are granted permanent immunity from pollution prosecution.
normal.explain: 《里約宣言》確立的「預防原則（Precautionary Principle）」立下鋼鐵法理：面對嚴重或不可逆轉的環境毀滅威脅，絕不能以「當前科學研究尚存部分不確定性」為由，而推遲採取刻不容緩的防範行動。

normal.desc: 【自然人權化】The Rights of Nature legal movement, pioneered by constitutional reforms in nations like Ecuador, recognizes that:
options: A. corporations may legally sue wild animals in court for causing agricultural damage to crops.
B. natural forests must pay municipal property taxes to local government authorities.
C. rivers are legally required to flow in straight, artificial concrete drainage canals exclusively.
D. ecosystems and natural features possess independent legal personhood and inherent rights to exist, regenerate, and evolve.
normal.explain: 「自然權利運動（Rights of Nature）」發起了翻天覆地的法哲學革命：山川河流與原始生態不再是人類任意支配的無生命「物」，而是具備獨立法律主體資格、享有生存與自我再生權利的「法律法人」。

normal.desc: 【生態滅絕罪】The proposed international crime of Ecocide seeks to amend the Rome Statute to criminalize:
options: A. unlawful or wanton acts committed with knowledge that there is a substantial likelihood of severe, widespread, or long term damage to the environment.
B. planting non native ornamental rose bushes inside private residential garden flowerpots.
C. the failure of municipal recycling trucks to collect cardboard boxes on national public holidays.
D. harvesting agricultural wheat during rainstorms without wearing rubberized rain boots.
normal.explain: 將「生態滅絕罪（Ecocide）」寫入國際刑事法院《羅馬規約》的運動旨在確立：明知會引發嚴重、廣泛或長期的災難性環境毀滅，仍肆意妄為實施的跨國生態屠戮行徑，應被列為與反人類罪並列的國際重罪。

normal.desc: 【碳捕集地質學】Supercritical Carbon Dioxide Mineralization in peridotite formations converts captured emissions into:
options: A. synthetic plastic polymer sheets used to construct residential building roof structures.
B. inert, permanent solid carbonate rock minerals via spontaneous exothermic geochemical reactions.
C. flammable volatile hydrocarbon liquids that must be extracted immediately using chemical pumps.
D. radioactive metallic isotopes that glow brightly inside subterranean underground caverns.
normal.explain: 超臨界二氧化碳蛇紋石化礦化技術（Mineralization）堪稱地質鍊金術：將高壓捕集的碳氣注入地下橄欖岩斷層，在自發的地球化學放熱反應中，數年內便能將氣體徹底固化為與世長存的惰性碳酸鹽岩石。

normal.desc: 【氣候正義賠償】The Loss and Damage fund operationalized at international climate summits exists specifically to:
options: A. provide financial compensation and technical assistance to vulnerable developing nations suffering irreversible climate disasters.
B. fund the construction of luxury five star beach resorts for international diplomatic delegations.
C. subsidize multinational oil exploration conglomerates operating deep sea offshore drilling rigs.
D. purchase commercial television advertising time to broadcast animated weather cartoons globally.
normal.explain: 國際氣候峰會正式落地的「損失與損害基金（Loss and Damage Fund）」，專為那些自身排放極微、卻首當其衝遭遇極端氣候海嘯毀滅性重創的脆弱島國與發展中國家提供無償人道賠償與修復注資。

normal.desc: 【生態滅絕哲學】The Anthropocene epoch in Earth system science and ecological philosophy designates:
options: A. the geological era that will commence only after the sun permanently ceases emitting solar light.
B. the geological interval wherein human collective activity has become the dominant driver of planetary environmental change.
C. the historical era preceding the invention of stone tools and the discovery of controlled fire.
D. a mythological period described in ancient classical poetry where gods walked among mortals.
normal.explain: 「人類世（Anthropocene）」宣告了一個沉重的人類歷史新紀元：人類物種的群體活動，已經徹底取代大自然的自然節律，成為撼動與主宰整個地球地質與生物圈演化的最決定性驅動力量。

normal.desc: 請唸出：公共信託理論守護大自然共用公域
normal.explain: public trust doctrine protection (phr.)：公共信託理論守護大自然共用公域。例句：Jurists rely on public trust doctrine protection to safeguard navigable waterways for future generations.（卓越的環境法學家高舉公共信託理論大旗，誓死捍衛通航水域與天然海岸線不受權貴私相授受與世代侵害。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：非線性劇震崩潰之地球系統臨界元素
normal.explain: earth system tipping elements (phr.)：非線性劇震崩潰之地球系統臨界元素。例句：Climatologists monitor earth system tipping elements to identify early warnings of abrupt biospheric collapse.（全球頂尖氣候學家日夜緊盯各大地球系統臨界元素，竭盡所能捕捉生物圈面臨突發性雪崩崩潰的前兆預警。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：面臨不可逆毀滅時預防原則之斷然適用
normal.explain: precautionary principle application (phr.)：面臨不可逆毀滅時預防原則之斷然適用。例句：Regulators halted the synthetic chemical rollout under strict precautionary principle application.（面對新型合成化工產品可能帶來的深遠遺傳毒性隱患，主管當局果斷依據預防原則下達了立即全面叫停的行政命令。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：賦予山川河流獨立法人資格之自然權利
normal.explain: rights of nature recognition (phr.)：賦予山川河流獨立法人資格之自然權利。例句：The municipal river was granted legal personhood under expanding rights of nature recognition.（在這場轟轟烈烈的「自然權利運動」中，這條歷經滄桑的母親河被國家正式授予了神聖不可侵犯的獨立法律法人人格。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：將大肆屠戮自然生態入刑之生態滅絕罪
normal.explain: international crime of ecocide (phr.)：將大肆屠戮自然生態入刑之生態滅絕罪。例句：Campaigners lobby the international criminal court to codify the international crime of ecocide.（跨國法律倡議聯盟全面奔走遊說，力促海牙國際刑事法院正式將反自然大肆屠戮的「生態滅絕罪」編纂入刑。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：將捕集碳氣永久轉化為地下岩石之礦化技術
normal.explain: carbon dioxide mineralization (phr.)：將捕集碳氣永久轉化為地下岩石之礦化技術。例句：Pilot facilities demonstrate that carbon dioxide mineralization safely binds greenhouse gas into solid stone.（先導地質示範基地以無可辯駁的實測數據證明：二氧化碳地質礦化技術能將溫室氣體安全鎖死在萬年堅石之中。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：污染製造者全額賠償生態修復之法理原則
normal.explain: polluter pays legal principle (phr.)：污染製造者全額賠償生態修復之法理原則。例句：The environmental protection agency enforced the polluter pays legal principle against the chemical polluter.（環境保護署以雷霆手段援引「污染者付費」法定原則，對這家惡意排毒的跨國化工集團發起了無上限的天價追償訴訟。）

normal.desc: 請唸出：關鍵物種滅絕誘發之整個營養級連鎖崩潰
normal.explain: trophic cascade ecological collapse (phr.)：關鍵物種滅絕誘發之整個營養級連鎖崩潰。例句：The loss of top wolves initiated a devastating trophic cascade ecological collapse in the national park.（頂級灰狼種群的慘遭捕殺殆盡，在國家公園深處引爆了一場難以收拾的整個營養級生態系統連鎖崩潰浩劫。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：嚴重、廣泛或長期毀滅自然生態系統的生態滅絕罪行（E 開頭，7 個字母）
normal.explain: ECOCIDE (n.)：嚴重、廣泛或長期毀滅自然生態系統的生態滅絕罪行。例句：Legal scholars drafted formal statutory language to establish the international crime of ecocide.（跨國刑法權威學者聯手起草了嚴密的法條文本，旨在國際法庭正式確立追究跨國生態滅絕罪的刑事法網。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：透過大規模人工手段干預地球氣候系統的地球工程技術（G 開頭，14 個字母）
normal.explain: GEOENGINEERING (n.)：透過大規模人工手段干預地球氣候系統的地球工程技術。例句：Solar geoengineering via stratospheric aerosol injection provokes immense geopolitical peril.（透過平流層氣溶膠注入實施太陽輻射遮蔽的地球工程狂想，背後暗藏著難以估量的巨大地緣政治政治風險。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：工業、交通與能源體系徹底消除化石燃料碳排放的脫碳化（D 開頭，15 個字母）
normal.explain: DECARBONIZATION (n.)：工業、交通與能源體系徹底消除化石燃料碳排放的脫碳化。例句：The heavy manufacturing sector faces unprecedented capital expenses during rapid decarbonization.（傳統重型鋼鐵與水泥製造業，在經歷這場百年不遇的急速深度脫碳轉型時面臨著天文數字般的資本開支。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：使遭到人為破壞的退化自然生境恢復原始生機的生態復育（R 開頭，11 個字母）
normal.explain: RESTORATION (n.)：使遭到人為破壞的退化自然生境恢復原始生機的生態復育。例句：Community led mangrove restoration shields low lying coastal deltas from destructive typhoons.（由在地沿海社群主導的紅樹林生態復育壯舉，為低窪三角洲築起了抵禦超級颱風海嘯的最強活體長城。）

normal.desc: 請拼出：海綿城市地表介質允許雨水自如向下滲透的物理滲透率（P 開頭，12 個字母）
normal.explain: PERMEABILITY (n.)：海綿城市地表介質允許雨水自如向下滲透的物理滲透率。例句：Urban planners increased soil permeability to reduce rainwater runoff into sewer networks.（現代海綿城市規劃師大舉提高地表鋪裝的土壤透水滲透率，從根源上斬斷了雨水暴力湧入市政下水道的洪峰。）

normal.desc: 填空題：E C O _ I D E (重創自然圈之滅絕生態重罪)
normal.explain: ECOCIDE (n.)：重創自然圈之滅絕生態重罪。例句：The environmental coalition campaigned to make industrial ecocide an extraditable international crime.（泛太平洋環保聯盟發起全球公投聯署，誓要將製造工業生態滅絕的跨國罪魁禍首列為可引渡的國際重刑要犯。）

normal.desc: 填空題：D E C _ R B O _ I Z A _ I O N (產業鏈向零碳大轉型之脫碳)
normal.explain: DECARBONIZATION (n.)：產業鏈向零碳大轉型之脫碳。例句：Green hydrogen provides a transformative chemical vector for deep industrial decarbonization.（清潔綠氫的橫空出世，為化學重工業與遠洋航運等極難減排領域實現深層脫碳提供了顛覆性的變革支點。）

normal.desc: 填空題：A C I _ I F _ C A _ I O N (海水酸化侵蝕海洋甲殼生物)
normal.explain: ACIDIFICATION (n.)：海水酸化侵蝕海洋甲殼生物。例句：Marine ecosystems undergo profound stress as anthropogenic emissions drive relentless acidification.（隨著人為溫室氣體排放無休止地推高海水酸化，整個極地到熱帶的海洋微觀生態正經受著前所未有的劇烈煎熬。）

normal.desc: 填空題：R E S T O _ A T I O N (受損自然生境之生態復育)
normal.explain: RESTORATION (n.)：受損自然生境之生態復育。例句：The river restoration project dismantled obsolete dams to revive salmon migration runs.（這項雄心勃勃的河流生態復育旗艦工程大刀闊斧拆除了多座廢棄水壩，讓暌違百年的野生鮭魚洄游盛景重現人間。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: I would be hard pressed to call that a resounding success.
options: A. 我毫不猶豫地認定那是空前成功。
B. 我必須用力按下成功按鈕。
C. 我確認那是徹底失敗，毫無任何成果。
D. 我很難把那稱為大獲成功。
boss.explain: hard pressed to 表示很難；對大獲成功有保留，不等於宣告全盤失敗。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The argument trades on an ambiguity that disappears as soon as the terms are defined.
options: A. 論點利用了歧義，而用語一旦定義清楚，歧義就消失。
B. 論點因精確定義而獲得更強證據。
C. 用語定義會讓歧義永遠無法解決。
D. 論點只涉及商品買賣，與語言無關。
boss.explain: trade on 是利用某事獲利或取得優勢；此處被利用的是未定義用語造成的歧義。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: To say the outcome was foreseeable is not to say that any particular participant foresaw it, still less that they intended it.
options: A. 結果不可預見，因此沒有人需要解釋。
B. 結果可預見，不代表特定參與者真的預見，更不代表刻意造成。
C. 結果可預見就證明所有人刻意促成。
D. 所有參與者都已承認預見並計畫結果。
boss.explain: 依序區分可預見性、實際預見與意圖；still less 進一步排除更強推論。

boss.desc: 【文法】Such ___ the complexity of the negotiations that even the participants struggled to explain the outcome.
options: A. were
B. have been
C. being
D. was
boss.explain: 此倒裝結構為 Such was＋單數名詞片語＋that...；主詞 complexity 為單數。

boss.desc: 【語意】The report is exhaustive without being exhausting. What contrast is intended?
options: A. It is comprehensive yet does not tire the reader.
B. It is incomplete yet difficult to finish.
C. It is deliberately repetitive and confusing.
D. It is brief because it omits every important detail.
boss.explain: exhaustive 是詳盡，exhausting 是令人疲累；兩者同源但意思不同。

boss.desc: 【細微立場】The critic writes: The proposal is not so much wrong as insufficiently alive to the problem it purports to solve. What is the main objection?
options: A. The critic accepts its understanding of the problem without reservation.
B. It inadequately recognises the problem’s complexity despite claiming to address it.
C. Every factual statement in it is demonstrably false.
D. It offers no claim to address any problem.
boss.explain: not so much A as B 把批評焦點轉向 B；alive to 指充分意識到，purports to 保留對宣稱的距離。

boss.desc: 請唸出：以微弱稱讚暗示貶抑
boss.explain: damning with faint praise (phr.)：以微弱稱讚暗示貶抑。例句：By calling the novel merely competent, the reviewer was damning with faint praise.（評論者只說小說寫得還算稱職，藉微弱的讚美暗示貶抑。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：可預見性本身不能證明意圖
boss.ans: FORESEEABILITY DOES NOT IN ITSELF ESTABLISH INTENT
boss.speak: foreseeability does not in itself establish intent
boss.explain: Foreseeability does not in itself establish intent (phr.)：可預見性本身不能證明意圖。
boss.vocabId: R8:FORESEEABILITY DOES NOT IN ITSELF ESTABLISH INTENT

boss.desc: 填空題：C I R C U M S _ E C T I O N (採取行動前審慎考慮各種情況)
boss.explain: CIRCUMSPECTION (n.)：採取行動前審慎考慮各種情況。例句：The sensitivity of the negotiations called for circumspection.（談判十分敏感，需要審慎行事。）

boss.desc: 填空題：S P _ C _ O _ S (表面看似合理但實際有誤的)
boss.explain: SPECIOUS (adj.)：表面看似合理但實際有誤的。例句：The comparison is attractive but ultimately specious.（這項比較很吸引人，但終究只是似是而非。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The hospitality was impeccable, if a little studied.
options: A. 招待無可挑剔，但略顯刻意安排。
B. 招待很自然，卻有明顯服務失誤。
C. 招待尚未開始，正在研究中。
D. 招待因沒有事前準備而完全失敗。
boss.explain: studied 此處是刻意、經過精心安排，不是正在讀書；if 補充保留。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: Their refusal to take sides is being read as a position in its own right.
options: A. 他們拒絕讓任何人閱讀聲明。
B. 他們拒絕選邊本身正被解讀為一種立場。
C. 他們已明白宣布支持其中一方。
D. 外界完全不對他們的中立作任何解讀。
boss.explain: in its own right 指本身即構成；being read as 是被詮釋為。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The invitation to be heard carries little weight if the terms of recognition have already been settled by those doing the listening.
options: A. 傾聽者尚未決定任何程序，所以不能邀請人發言。
B. 只有被邀請者才能決定全部認可標準。
C. 若傾聽者早已決定哪些聲音才算數，邀請發言的意義就有限。
D. 只要安排發言時間，就必然保證平等影響力。
boss.explain: 條件句質疑預設認可框架對發言意義的限制；不把發言機會等同實質平等。

boss.desc: 【文法】___ that the deadline had already passed, the organisers would have revised the invitation.
options: A. Had it been made clear
B. Had made it clear
C. Were it make clear
D. Has it been making clear
boss.explain: 過去反事實被動倒裝為 Had it been made clear，相當於 If it had been made clear。

boss.desc: 【論證】The curator’s claim to speak for the community sits uneasily with the absence of community involvement. What is being questioned?
options: A. The physical location of the exhibition space.
B. The legitimacy of the claimed representative role.
C. The fact that any community exists in the area.
D. The curator’s ability to speak the local language.
boss.explain: sits uneasily with 表示代表性主張與欠缺參與之間存在矛盾，焦點是正當性。

boss.desc: 【語意】The proposal’s defenders invoke tradition less as a source of guidance than as a means of foreclosing discussion. What is the criticism?
options: A. The defenders are offering historical evidence open to unrestricted debate.
B. The proposal has been criticised solely because it is new.
C. Tradition is being used to prevent scrutiny rather than to inform deliberation.
D. Tradition has ceased to play any part in the defence of the proposal.
boss.explain: less A than B 說明傳統被用來關閉討論，而非提供可檢驗的指引。

boss.desc: 請唸出：只做表面修飾的做法
boss.explain: an exercise in window dressing (phr.)：只做表面修飾的做法。例句：The review became an exercise in window dressing.（這次檢討成了只做表面修飾的工作。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：她得體地接受了卻仍隱藏保留
boss.ans: HER GRACIOUS ACCEPTANCE CONCEALED A LINGERING RESERVATION
boss.speak: her gracious acceptance concealed a lingering reservation
boss.explain: Her gracious acceptance concealed a lingering reservation (phr.)：她得體地接受了卻仍隱藏保留。
boss.vocabId: R8:HER GRACIOUS ACCEPTANCE CONCEALED A LINGERING RESERVATION

boss.desc: 填空題：P A T E R _ A L I S M (自認為他人好而限制其自主的做法)
boss.explain: PATERNALISM (n.)：自認為他人好而限制其自主的做法。例句：The reform seeks to replace paternalism with informed choice.（這項改革希望以知情選擇取代家長式干預。）

boss.desc: 填空題：D I _ S _ M _ L E (隱藏真實感受或意圖而故作姿態)
boss.explain: DISSEMBLE (v.)：隱藏真實感受或意圖而故作姿態。例句：She chose not to dissemble her disappointment.（她選擇不掩飾自己的失望。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The assurance is carefully worded to imply more than it actually commits the company to.
options: A. 公司公開撤回了原先的全部承諾。
B. 保證刻意讓人聯想到比公司實際承諾更多的內容。
C. 公司已明確承諾所有可能聯想到的事項。
D. 措辭完全沒有暗示，只列出可執行條款。
boss.explain: imply 與 commit to 的落差是重點；暗示不是可直接等同的承諾。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The phrase does rhetorical work that the supporting evidence has yet to earn.
options: A. 說話者只在討論修辭工作的薪資。
B. 這個說法因文法錯誤而無法理解。
C. 這個說法營造的說服效果超過目前證據足以支持的程度。
D. 證據已充分支持措辭中的每個暗示。
boss.explain: has yet to earn 暗示證據尚未取得相應支持力；重點是修辭超前。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The difficulty is not that the distinction cannot be drawn, but that drawing it this way quietly settles the very dispute it purports merely to describe.
options: A. 這個區分在任何情況下都完全無法表達。
B. 劃界方式已由雙方公開同意且毫無爭議。
C. 說話者只是要求把描述寫得更短。
D. 問題不是無法區分，而是這樣劃界已暗中替它聲稱只是描述的爭議下了判斷。
boss.explain: 區分描述性姿態與劃界所帶入的實質判斷；不是否認所有區分都可能。

boss.desc: 【文法】___ the information be found to have been misleading, the assurance would lose much of its force.
options: A. Did
B. Should
C. Had
D. Were
boss.explain: Should＋主詞＋原形動詞 be 構成正式假設條件倒裝；Had/Were/Did 無法接 be found 形成此結構。

boss.desc: 【語意】The defence rests on a distinction that is formally neat but practically porous. What is being suggested?
options: A. The practical boundary is firmer than the formal definition.
