boss.speak: To call the clothes unpretentious is not quite to absolve their wearer of the desire to be seen as unpretentious.
options: A. 說話者認為樸素衣服不可能真的穿得舒適。
B. 衣著不矯飾，不等於穿戴者沒有想被看成不矯飾。
C. 衣著一旦樸素，就排除任何自我呈現意圖。
D. 說話者已證明穿戴者想假扮另一個人。
boss.explain: 衣著風格與想被如何看待的動機分層，不自動全否定或指控。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The supposed departure from convention has acquired conventions of its own, complete with people who can tell you when you are doing it incorrectly.
options: A. 所有參與者已一致廢除對穿著的評論。
B. 說話者認為只有正式制服才可能有規範。
C. 所謂打破慣例本身已有規矩，還有人評判做得對不對。
D. 只要反慣例，就永遠不會形成任何共同規範。
boss.explain: 反慣例風格也可制度化為新規範，帶有自反諷刺。

boss.desc: 【字彙】A sartorial choice is a choice concerning ___.
options: A. clothes or manner of dress
B. the order of speeches
C. the arrangement of musical notes
D. the ownership of a building
boss.explain: sartorial與服裝、穿著方式有關，不一定只限高級訂製。

boss.desc: 【語意】The essay calls authenticity a look that can be purchased, while declining to say that everything purchased is inauthentic. What distinction matters?
options: A. Clothing produced in one colour versus clothing produced in several colours.
B. A marketable appearance of authenticity versus the actual history or experience it appears to signify.
C. Purchased objects versus objects that can never have an owner.
D. A categorical rejection of commerce versus an endorsement of every commercial claim.
boss.explain: 可購買的是某種真實感外觀，不由此推所有購買物都不真實。

boss.desc: 【語意】The phrase calculated carelessness describes a style that invites us to overlook the calculation required to appear careless. What is the central tension?
options: A. The calculation concerns only the price printed on the label.
B. The phrase establishes that the wearer forgot the occasion.
C. The appearance conceals the deliberateness that produces it.
D. Carelessness makes any deliberate stylistic choice impossible.
boss.explain: calculated與carelessness刻意矛盾，說的是精心營造的隨意感。

boss.desc: 請唸出：表面上似未經刻意安排的外觀
boss.explain: an ostensibly uncontrived appearance (phr.)：表面上似未經刻意安排的外觀。例句：The costume produces an ostensibly uncontrived appearance.（戲服營造似未刻意安排的外觀。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：打破慣例也可能形成自己的慣例
boss.ans: A DEPARTURE FROM CONVENTION CAN DEVELOP CONVENTIONS OF ITS OWN
boss.speak: a departure from convention can develop conventions of its own
boss.explain: A departure from convention can develop conventions of its own (phr.)：打破慣例也可能形成自己的慣例。
boss.vocabId: R8:A DEPARTURE FROM CONVENTION CAN DEVELOP CONVENTIONS OF ITS OWN

boss.desc: 請拼出：為給人某種印象而故作的姿態或行為（A 開頭，11 個字母）
boss.explain: AFFECTATION (n.)：為給人某種印象而故作的姿態或行為。例句：The narrator mistakes a habit for an affectation.（敘述者把習慣誤認成故作姿態。）

boss.desc: 填空題：I N _ M I _ A _ L E (獨特得難以被成功模仿的)
boss.explain: INIMITABLE (adj.)：獨特得難以被成功模仿的。例句：She wore the old coat with inimitable confidence.（她以難以模仿的自信穿著舊外套。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: Naming the area a gateway tells you where the speaker imagines the important journey begins.
options: A. 行程的重要性可直接由地圖上入口數量推算。
B. 稱該區為門戶，透露說話者認為重要行程從何開始。
C. 門戶這個名稱足以確定當地最早興建的道路。
D. 該區只有一個入口，所以說話者不能採用其他名稱。
boss.explain: 比喻gateway透露敘述者設定的旅程視角，沒有提供道路歷史。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: We can accept the coordinates without accepting the story their arrangement has been made to tell.
options: A. 要質疑敘事，首先必須證明每個座標都有錯。
B. 座標既能被安排，實地位置就完全無法查證。
C. 可以接受座標，同時不接受其安排所構成的敘事。
D. 只要接受座標，就應同時接受由它們構成的敘事。
boss.explain: without accepting保留事實資料與組織敘事分層判斷的可能性。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The map offers a view from nowhere, provided we agree not to ask who chose the viewpoint.
options: A. 地圖未採任何視角，所以不必詢問製圖者。
B. 只要知道製圖者的名字，就能證明座標皆錯。
C. 地圖無法辨認出任何地點，因此也沒有觀看方向。
D. 只要不追問誰選視角，它就彷彿提供了無立場的觀看。
boss.explain: provided帶反諷條件：不問視角的選擇，才維持看似無立場的效果。

boss.desc: 【論述】Defending a schematic’s equal spacing, the designer says, “Its not being to scale is a convention, not a defect.” Which reply accepts that defence without treating the convention as proof of universal usefulness?
options: A. A misleading use of the diagram establishes that the convention itself is defective.
B. The convention may be legitimate while still misleading users estimating walking time.
C. If the convention is legitimate, discrepancies in walking distance cease to matter.
D. The diagram becomes universally useful once its spacing matches the walking distances.
boss.explain: 可承認非比例慣例正當，同時保留特定用途不適合的判斷；其餘把慣例正當、實用性或缺陷作過強推論。

boss.desc: 【推論】Two routes remain equally prominent on an old map, although one has since become inaccessible. The curator retains both in a historical display. Which judgement best respects the stated purpose?
options: A. Retaining both routes implies that the curator disputes the closure.
B. The historical purpose makes the relative prominence of the routes irrelevant to interpretation.
C. The unchanged emphasis can document an earlier arrangement rather than guide current travel.
D. The map should be judged solely by how efficiently it directs present-day visitors.
boss.explain: 歷史展示可保留昔日格局，不等於現時導航指引或否認封閉；呈現方式仍可供解讀。

boss.desc: 【推論】A diagram removes local names to make its symbols usable across languages. The accompanying essay notes that the names also carry local history. What is the most balanced reading of the choice?
options: A. It preserves local history in a form that no longer requires translation.
B. It shows that local names had prevented residents from understanding the diagram.
C. It makes historical interpretation possible by separating names from places.
D. It gains portability by giving up a particular kind of situated meaning.
boss.explain: 跨語言通用性與在地歷史意義的取捨由題內明示，不能把便於通用當保留一切。

boss.desc: 請唸出單字：指涉依賴說話者所處語境的
boss.explain: deictic (adj.)：指涉依賴說話者所處語境的。例句：In the instruction, here is a deictic expression whose reference changes with the speaker’s position.（在這項指示中，here是指涉會隨說話者位置改變的語境指示表達。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：座標準確，不等於敘述因此具有權威。
boss.ans: ACCURATE COORDINATES DO NOT CONFER NARRATIVE AUTHORITY
boss.speak: accurate coordinates do not confer narrative authority
boss.explain: Accurate coordinates do not confer narrative authority (phr.)：座標準確，不等於敘述因此具有權威。。
boss.vocabId: R8:ACCURATE COORDINATES DO NOT CONFER NARRATIVE AUTHORITY

boss.desc: 請拼出：與空間占有、控制或領域歸屬有關的行為或觀念（T 開頭，14 個字母）
boss.explain: TERRITORIALITY (n.)：與空間占有、控制或領域歸屬有關的行為或觀念。例句：The study examines territoriality in spaces where formal boundaries are absent.（研究探討在沒有正式界線的空間中，與領域占有及控制有關的行為。）

boss.desc: 填空題：R E P R _ S E N _ A T I _ N A L (與如何描繪或呈現事物有關的)
boss.explain: REPRESENTATIONAL (adj.)：與如何描繪或呈現事物有關的。例句：The dispute concerns a representational choice rather than an error in the coordinates.（爭議涉及如何呈現的選擇，而非座標錯誤。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The principle of proportionality requires that administrative burdens not be excessive.
options: A. 比例原則僅適用於跨國條約之履行與爭端解決程序。
B. 所有行政負擔均被法律推定為絕對合理且毋庸審查。
C. 比例原則要求行政處分所施加之負擔不得顯失均衡。
D. 行政機關得為達成單一目的而不惜造成任何過當負擔。
boss.explain: proportionality 比例原則，burdens not be excessive 負擔不得過當。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The delegation of legislative authority must be bounded by an intelligible principle.
options: A. 立法機關有權將制定刑罰之全權無限期委由行政部門行使。
B. 授權原則之模糊性被證明有利於行政機關維持政策連貫。
C. 司法審查禁止立法部門向專責機構進行任何形式之授權。
D. 立法權之授權必須受制於清晰可辨識之法定授權原則。
boss.explain: delegation bounded by intelligible principle 授權必須有明確指引原則。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: Judicial deference to bureaucratic expertise must not become an abdication of review.
options: A. 司法對官僚體系專業之尊重，絕不能異化為司法審查職責之放棄。
B. 法官在面對行政專業時應全面停止對事實認定之司法覆核。
C. 尊重官僚專業在實務上必然導致行政訴訟制度之全面廢弛。
D. 司法審查之職能主要在於取代行政專家進行技術性政策制定。
boss.explain: deference must not become abdication 尊重專業絕不可演變為放棄審查。

boss.desc: 【語意】The treatise criticises legal formalism for mistaking axiomatic coherence for empirical justice. What is the core critique?
options: A. Axioms should be replaced by informal customs.
B. Legal systems should abandon coherence altogether.
C. Internal consistency does not guarantee real-world justice.
D. Formalism pays too much attention to empirical facts.
boss.explain: 批評法律形式主義誤將公理邏輯的一致性等同於實體正義。

boss.desc: 【語用】The scholar observed that the statute’s deliberate vagueness was not an oversight, but the political price of legislative passage. Why was the text vague?
options: A. Because the draftsmen lacked legal expertise.
B. To prevent judges from exercising discretion.
C. In order to force an immediate constitutional amendment.
D. To secure political agreement for its passage.
boss.explain: 刻意模糊並非疏失，而是促成法案通過所付出的政治妥協代價。

boss.desc: 【認識論】The historian cautions against treating institutional evolution as an inexorable march toward rational bureaucracy. What view is being challenged?
options: A. The assumption that history moves inevitably toward rationality.
B. The claim that modern institutions are less efficient than archaic ones.
C. The idea that written constitutions restrict governmental action.
D. The belief that institutional reform requires public participation.
boss.explain: 駁斥制度演進乃必然邁向理性官僚體系的目的論史觀。

boss.desc: 請唸出單字：對公約或法規條款的官方減免讓步
boss.explain: derogation (n.)：對公約或法規條款的官方減免讓步。例句：Emergency powers permit temporary derogation from certain obligations.（緊急權力允許在特定情境下暫時減免履行部分法規義務。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：程序保障維繫公民自由。
boss.explain: Procedural safeguards preserve civil liberty (phr.)：程序保障維繫公民自由。。

boss.desc: 請拼出：抵觸違背成文法律或條約義務（C 開頭，10 個字母）
boss.explain: CONTRAVENE (v.)：抵觸違背成文法律或條約義務。例句：The new licensing requirement contravened municipal law.（這項新的營業執照要求抵觸了該市的自治法規。）

boss.desc: 填空題：I N _ E _ N _ T Y (對未來潛在損害或損失之官方保障補償)
boss.explain: INDEMNITY (n.)：對未來潛在損害或損失之官方保障補償。例句：The government offered financial indemnity to contracted shipping firms.（政府向受合約約束的航運公司提供了財務損害補償保證。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The claim that all knowledge is relative is itself a universal truth claim.
options: A. 相對主義宣稱已被邏輯學家證明徹底擺脫了自我指涉難題。
B. 普遍真理之存在完全排除了在任何特定情境下的相對性。
C. 知識相對性之主張禁止任何學者提出具有普適性的哲學命題。
D. 所有知識皆屬相對之宣稱，其自身便構成一項普遍真理主張。
boss.explain: self-referential inconsistency 相對主義在自我指涉上的邏輯困境。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: Solipsism posits that only one’s own mind is sure to exist, rendering external reality doubtful.
options: A. 唯我論主張唯有自身的心靈確鑿存在，從而使外在世界存疑。
B. 唯我論以堅實的經驗證據確立了他人心靈與物質世界的客觀性。
C. 外在實在之確定性在唯我論體系中被視為不言自明的公理基礎。
D. 唯我論學者致力於透過跨學科合作證明集體意識的真實存在。
boss.explain: solipsism 唯我論：only one’s own mind sure to exist，external reality doubtful。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The hermeneutic circle illustrates that understanding the whole requires grasping its constituent parts.
options: A. 整體與局部在文本理解中彼此獨立，毫無任何動態互動之辯證關係。
B. 詮釋學循環說明了理解整體仰賴掌握局部，而掌握局部又需理解整體。
C. 局部之解讀在任何文本詮釋過程中皆能完全脫離整體背景而獨立完成。
D. 詮釋學循環被當代符號學界證明為一種致命且無法自拔的邏輯錯誤。
boss.explain: hermeneutic circle 詮釋學循環：understanding whole requires grasping parts。

boss.desc: 【哲學】The critique of essentialism rejects the idea that concepts possess immutable, timeless essences. What is being denied?
options: A. That words can be translated between languages.
B. That historical definitions change over time.
C. That grammatical syntax is necessary for meaning.
D. That concepts have fixed and unalterable cores.
boss.explain: 反本質主義（anti-essentialism）否定概念具有永恆不變的本質（immutable essences）。

boss.desc: 【語意】The semantic distinction between sense (Sinn) and reference (Bedeutung) resolves the paradox of identity statements. What problem does it address?
options: A. How statements like Venus is the Morning Star can be informative.
B. Why geometric shapes have identical perimeter measurements.
C. Whether animal communication possesses recursive grammar.
D. Why historical documents contain contradictory dates.
boss.explain: 意義與指涉（sense & reference）之別，化解了「金星是晨星」為何具備資訊含量的難題。

boss.desc: 【認識論】Sellars criticizes the Myth of the Given, demonstrating that immediate sensory experience cannot serve as an unconceptualized epistemic foundation. What is rejected?
options: A. The view that language is learned through social interaction.
B. The belief that raw sensation provides a concept-free foundation for knowledge.
C. The claim that humans possess sensory organs.
D. The idea that scientific theories require verification.
boss.explain: 批判「所與的神話」（Myth of the Given）：否定未經概念化的純粹感官直接構成知識基礎。

boss.desc: 請唸出單字：在論辯中刻意模糊或偷換語義之雙關謬誤
boss.explain: equivocation (n.)：在論辯中刻意模糊或偷換語義之雙關謬誤。例句：The politician’s defense relied upon an obvious equivocation.（該政客的辯解仰賴於一處顯而易見的語義偷換。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：確定性本質上常屬心理情感而非純粹邏輯狀態。
boss.ans: CERTAINTY IS AN EMOTIONAL RATHER THAN LOGICAL STATE
boss.speak: certainty is an emotional rather than logical state
boss.explain: Certainty is an emotional rather than logical state (phr.)：確定性本質上常屬心理情感而非純粹邏輯狀態。。
boss.vocabId: R8:CERTAINTY IS AN EMOTIONAL RATHER THAN LOGICAL STATE

boss.desc: 請拼出：提供額外證據以證實支持某項主張（C 開頭，11 個字母）
boss.explain: CORROBORATE (v.)：提供額外證據以證實支持某項主張。例句：Multiple witnesses came forward to corroborate the defendant’s story.（多位證人主動出面提供證據以證實被告的說法。）

boss.desc: 填空題：S Y _ L _ G _ S M (由大前提、小前提與結論組成的三段論)
boss.explain: SYLLOGISM (n.)：由大前提、小前提與結論組成的三段論。例句：The classic syllogism deduces mortality from the nature of humanity.（經典的三段論從人類本質演繹推導出生命的必有一死。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: Détente represented a deliberate lowering of geopolitical tensions between superpowers.
options: A. 低潮緩和時期代表了超級大國之間地緣政治緊張的有意識降低。
B. 低潮緩和代表兩大陣營決定在一夕之間廢止所有常備軍力。
C. 地緣緊張在緩和協議簽署後演變成了全面性的核子大戰。
D. 該時期的外交政策主要致力於徹底摧毀對手國家的金融體系。
boss.explain: détente 國際局勢緩和，deliberate lowering of tensions。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The balance of power is inherently dynamic, shifting with demographic and industrial tides.
options: A. 人口規模之萎縮是促使一個國家在地緣均勢中崛起的決定性因素。
B. 均勢結構本質上深具動態性，隨人口與工業實力的消長而轉變。
C. 均勢結構一旦透過條約確立，便能永久固定各國的力量對比。
D. 工業生產力的巨幅增長被證明完全不會對地緣政治格局產生衝擊。
boss.explain: inherently dynamic 本質動態，shifting with industrial tides 隨實力消長。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The hegemon underwrites international public goods to legitimize its geopolitical preeminence.
options: A. 國際公共財在霸權衰落時期依然能由周邊弱小國家獨立無損供給。
B. 地緣主導地位之合法性完全取決於霸權國軍事基地的數量多寡。
C. 霸權國透過承擔國際公共財的供給，藉此確立其地緣主導地位的合法性。
D. 霸權國提供公共財之目的在於促使所有同盟國家陷入財政依賴。
boss.explain: underwrites international public goods 承擔公共財，legitimize preeminence 確立主導正當性。

boss.desc: 【條約】A state claims jus cogens status for the prohibition of maritime piracy, arguing it overrides conflicting bilateral agreements. What is the effect?
options: A. It preempts and nullifies contradictory treaty clauses.
B. It allows states to ignore the jurisdiction of maritime courts.
C. It restricts the prohibition exclusively to coastal waters.
D. It requires all pirate vessels to be registered as merchant ships.
boss.explain: jus cogens（絕對法/強行法）位階最高，優先廢止牴觸條款。

boss.desc: 【推論】The protocol permits hot pursuit of maritime raiders into international waters, but forbids entry into foreign territorial seas without consent. Where is pursuit restricted?
options: A. Throughout the high seas during adverse meteorological conditions.
B. Inside the sovereign territorial waters of another state.
C. Across international waters outside coastal jurisdiction.
D. Within the home state’s own designated contiguous zone.
boss.explain: 明文禁止未經同意進入 foreign territorial seas。

boss.desc: 【認識論】The historian cautions against backward projection, mistaking modern concepts of Westphalian sovereignty for medieval feudal allegiances. What is the error?
options: A. Assuming that ancient empires had written constitutions.
B. Denying that medieval monarchs ever engaged in armed combat.
C. Imposing modern sovereign categories onto feudal arrangements.
D. Refusing to consult original medieval parchment manuscripts.
boss.explain: 反對將威斯特伐利亞主權概念回溯投射於中世紀封建附庸體系。

boss.desc: 請唸出單字：依據條約將在逃嫌犯引渡交還外國的程序
boss.explain: extradition (n.)：依據條約將在逃嫌犯引渡交還外國的程序。例句：The two nations signed a formal bilateral extradition treaty.（兩國簽署了一份正式的雙邊刑事引渡條約。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：維持霸權地位既需強制實力亦需各方認同。
boss.ans: HEGEMONY REQUIRES BOTH COERCION AND CONSENT
boss.speak: hegemony requires both coercion and consent
boss.explain: Hegemony requires both coercion and consent (phr.)：維持霸權地位既需強制實力亦需各方認同。。
boss.vocabId: R8:HEGEMONY REQUIRES BOTH COERCION AND CONSENT

boss.desc: 請拼出：在國際或區域格局中享有決定性主導地位之霸權（H 開頭，8 個字母）
boss.explain: HEGEMONY (n.)：在國際或區域格局中享有決定性主導地位之霸權。例句：The defeat ended the empire’s maritime hegemony in the ocean.（那場戰敗終結了該帝國在大洋上的海上霸權地位。）

boss.desc: 填空題：B E _ L _ C _ S E (好戰且動輒訴諸武力威脅或衝突的)
boss.explain: BELLICOSE (adj.)：好戰且動輒訴諸武力威脅或衝突的。例句：The general’s bellicose rhetoric escalated border tensions.（將軍好戰的言論迅速升級了兩國邊境的緊張局勢。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: Asymmetric information between lenders and borrowers leads to adverse selection.
options: A. 逆向選擇現象在借貸雙方資訊完全透明的情境下依然必然發生。
B. 放款人與借款人之間的資訊不對稱在金融市場中引發逆向選擇。
C. 資訊不對稱被證實有利於金融機構挑選出信用最為卓越的客戶。
D. 金融市場之高效運作仰賴於徹底向公眾隱瞞所有借貸風險數據。
boss.explain: asymmetric information 資訊不對稱，leads to adverse selection 導致逆向選擇。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: Sovereign wealth funds deploy patient capital, absorbing macroeconomic volatility across decades.
options: A. 耐性資本之配置導致主權基金在國際金融市場中喪失了所有話語權。
B. 總體經濟的劇烈波動促使各國主權基金立即變現其所有海外股權。
C. 主權財富基金配置耐性資本，在數十年的跨度中吸收總體經濟的波動。
D. 主權基金之投資策略主要專注於高槓桿日內高頻投機套利交易。
boss.explain: patient capital 耐性資本，absorbing volatility across decades 吸收跨期波動。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The financial accelerator mechanism amplifies microeconomic shocks into macro contractions.
options: A. 金融加速器能自發吸收並完全化解所有來自微觀企業層面的破產危機。
B. 微觀衝擊在健全的信貸市場中被證實永遠不可能演變為宏觀經濟波動。
C. 該機制主要探討高科技新創企業如何透過股權融資實現指數型成長。
D. 金融加速器機制將個體微觀層面的衝擊，放大擴散為總體層面的景氣收縮。
boss.explain: financial accelerator mechanism 金融加速器放大微觀衝擊。

boss.desc: 【宏觀】Ricardian equivalence suggests that debt-financed fiscal deficits do not stimulate aggregate consumption, as forward-looking citizens anticipate future tax liabilities. Why is consumption flat?
options: A. Tax rates are permanently abolished by the constitution.
B. Households save anticipating future tax burdens.
C. Citizens spend all borrowing immediately on consumer luxuries.
D. Commercial banks refuse to honor government treasury notes.
boss.explain: 李嘉圖等價：前瞻家庭預期未來稅務負擔增加，將減稅儲蓄而非消費。

boss.desc: 【推論】The regulatory framework imposes countercyclical capital buffers, requiring banks to accumulate equity during booms to absorb shocks during downturns. When is capital built?
options: A. When central banks lower the benchmark policy rate to zero.
B. Only when a commercial bank records quarterly operating losses.
C. During periods of robust economic expansion.
D. Exclusively after a financial crisis has already commenced.
boss.explain: countercyclical buffers 反景氣循環緩衝：在繁榮期（booms）累積資本。

boss.desc: 【認識論】The philosopher warns against treating mathematical economic models as normative blueprints, mistaking formal equilibrium for social welfare. What conflation is targeted?
options: A. Denying that arithmetic is applicable to corporate bookkeeping.
B. Assuming that supply and demand curves can never intersect in theory.
C. Claiming that all economic activity is entirely irrational and random.
D. Equating elegant mathematical equations with genuine human well-being.
boss.explain: 批判將數學模型內部的一致均衡，等同於人類社會的真實福祉。

boss.desc: 請唸出單字：涉及總體經濟體系各變數巨觀運作的
boss.explain: macroeconomic (adj.)：涉及總體經濟體系各變數巨觀運作的。例句：Macroeconomic stability is an essential prerequisite for foreign investment.（總體經濟的穩定是吸引外國資本投資不可或缺的前提。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：債務通縮將進一步加深經濟衰退。
boss.explain: Debt deflation deepens economic contraction (phr.)：債務通縮將進一步加深經濟衰退。。

boss.desc: 請拼出：擁有足夠資本與資產得以清償所有債務的（S 開頭，7 個字母）
boss.explain: SOLVENT (adj.)：擁有足夠資本與資產得以清償所有債務的。例句：Strict stress tests proved that the regional bank remained solvent.（嚴格的壓力測試證實該區域銀行依然具備完全的償債能力。）

boss.desc: 填空題：C R E _ I T _ O R _ H Y (具備良好信用紀錄與償債能力而值得放款的)
boss.explain: CREDITWORTHY (adj.)：具備良好信用紀錄與償債能力而值得放款的。例句：Commercial lenders compete fiercely to attract creditworthy corporate borrowers.（商業銀行展開激烈競爭以吸引具備優質信用資格的企業借款人。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: Only when peer review is emancipated from commercial incentives can empirical integrity be preserved. What guarantees integrity?
options: A. Liberating scholarly review from monetary and commercial bias.
B. Increasing financial royalties awarded to journal referees.
C. Consolidating academic publishing under corporate cartels.
D. Accelerating publication turnaround by eliminating external review.
boss.explain: Only when... can... 倒裝表明只有擺脫商業利益才能維護實證嚴謹性。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: Seldom has an intellectual paradigm shifted with such breathtaking velocity and finality. What characterizes the paradigm shift?
options: A. The unanimous resistance mounted by international scholars.
B. Its unprecedented speed and irreversible conclusiveness.
C. Its protracted sluggishness across multiple academic generations.
D. Its minimal and negligible influence on scientific methodology.
boss.explain: Seldom has... shifted 倒裝讚嘆該典範轉移的速度之快與決定性。

boss.desc: 【語用】Scarcely conceivable was it that an empire spanning continents could disintegrate within a generation. What is emphasized?
options: A. The profound implausibility and shock of rapid imperial collapse.
B. The historical inevitability of territorial overextension.
C. The meticulous planning behind the imperial succession.
D. The enduring resilience of continental administrative bodies.
boss.explain: Scarcely conceivable was it that... 倒裝結構強化其不可思議與震撼感。

boss.desc: 【倒裝】Little did the epistemologists divine that quantum mechanics would dismantle classical deterministic causality. What was unforeseen?
options: A. The predictive certainty of mechanical models at atomic scales.
B. The revolutionary overthrow of classical causality by quantum theory.
C. The total vindication of Newtonian determinism across microphysics.
D. The irrelevance of philosophical inquiry to subatomic physics.
boss.explain: Little did... divine 倒裝表示認識論學者完全未料及古典因果律的顛覆。

boss.desc: 請唸出：在法律中毫無蹤跡（否定倒裝）
boss.explain: nowhere within the law (phr.)：在法律中毫無蹤跡（否定倒裝）。例句：Nowhere within the jurisprudence can one discern a justification for arbitrary detention.（在整體法理體系中，人們絕無可能找到任何支持任意拘留的合法依據。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：彼等完全未曾預料知曉
boss.explain: little did they know (phr.)：彼等完全未曾預料知曉。例句：Little did the chroniclers comprehend that archaic dogma was rapidly obsolete.（編年史家完全未曾預料到，古老的教條正以驚人的速度被歷史淘汰。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：正式放棄某項法律權利特權之聲明文件（W 開頭，6 個字母）
boss.explain: WAIVER (n.)：正式放棄某項法律權利特權之聲明文件。例句：The sovereign signed an explicit waiver of maritime jurisdictional immunity.（該國正式簽署了一份明確放棄海事管轄豁免權的法律文件。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：大膽無畏的魄力或過人的膽識（A 開頭，8 個字母）
boss.explain: AUDACITY (n.)：大膽無畏的魄力或過人的膽識。例句：His theoretical paper possessed the audacity to challenge Einsteinian orthodoxy.（他的理論論文擁有過人的膽識，敢於向愛因斯坦的物理正統提出挑戰。）

boss.desc: 填空題：F A L _ I B I _ I S M (承認知識暫定性與可錯性的認知態度)
boss.explain: FALLIBILISM (n.)：承認知識暫定性與可錯性的認知態度。例句：Epistemic fallibilism prevents researchers from succumbing to intellectual arrogance.（認識論的可謬論心態，能防止研究人員陷入理性的自負與傲慢。）

boss.desc: 填空題：P E R _ M P _ O R Y (專斷而具約束力的命令)
boss.explain: PEREMPTORY (adj.)：專斷而具約束力的命令。例句：The tribunal issued a peremptory injunction against habitat deforestation.（審判庭發布了一道具備強制約束力的禁令，禁止對原始棲地進行採伐。）

boss.desc: 填空題：C O R _ O B O _ A T E (提供佐證確證事實)
boss.explain: CORROBORATE (v.)：提供佐證確證事實。例句：Satellite telemetry was deployed to corroborate surface temperature anomalies.（多光譜衛星遙測技術被廣泛部署，以確證地表所發生的異常溫度躍升。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The ethics board insisted that genetic editing experiments on viable embryos be suspended indefinitely. What was demanded?
options: A. The immediate destruction of all synthetic laboratory reagents.
B. An immediate and unconditional moratorium on the research.
C. Accelerated human clinical trials across metropolitan hospitals.
D. The commercial licensing of gene therapies to private cartels.
boss.explain: insist that + 原形虛擬式 be suspended，要求無限期暫停實驗。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: Truth be told the administration rhetoric was a thin veneer masking structural insolvency. What is revealed?
options: A. Structural solvency was verified by independent foreign auditors.
B. The administration had no interest in political communication.
C. The official narrative concealed severe underlying financial collapse.
D. The administration possessed vast undisclosed fiscal surpluses.
boss.explain: Truth be told 為古雅虛擬評註語，揭露官方說詞不過是掩飾實質破產的薄弱糖衣。

boss.desc: 【原形虛擬】The statute requires that every algorithmic telemetry pipeline ___ audited for systemic algorithmic bias.
options: A. being rigorously
B. be rigorously
C. is rigorously
D. was rigorously
boss.explain: statute requires that 從句使用原形動詞虛擬式 be rigorously audited。

boss.desc: 【條件】Were the planetary biosphere to suffer sudden climatic tipping points, centuries of civilization ___ imperiled.
options: A. is
B. had been
C. would be
D. will be
boss.explain: Were... to suffer 虛擬條件句，主要子句使用 would be imperiled。

boss.desc: 請唸出：明確約束任何受託人均不得
boss.explain: dictates that no trustee (phr.)：明確約束任何受託人均不得。例句：The statutory framework mandates that fiduciary custodians exercise scrupulous prudence.（法定體制嚴正要求，所有信託財產管理人均必須履行極致審慎的注意義務。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：若關鍵臨界點遭到突破
boss.explain: were tipping points surpassed (phr.)：若關鍵臨界點遭到突破。例句：Were ecological tipping points surpassed the planetary climate would be irreparably altered.（一旦生態環境臨界點被突破，整個地球的氣候系統便將面臨不可逆的永久巨變。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：法規文獻或理論體系中的空白缺失斷層（L 開頭，6 個字母）
boss.explain: LACUNA (n.)：法規文獻或理論體系中的空白缺失斷層。例句：A critical lacuna in the statutory text left judges without sentencing guidelines.（法定條文文本中存在的一處重大空白缺漏，使法官在量刑時缺乏明確的裁量基準。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：公開質疑攻擊動機誠信或效力（I 開頭，6 個字母）
boss.explain: IMPUGN (v.)：公開質疑攻擊動機誠信或效力。例句：The defense attorney attempted to impugn the reliability of the eyewitness.（辯方律師試圖透過交叉詰問，質疑並削弱控方關鍵目擊證人證詞的客觀可信度。）

boss.desc: 填空題：L _ _ T (以防唯恐特定風險發生)
boss.explain: LEST (conj.)：以防唯恐特定風險發生。例句：Emergency reserves were stockpiled lest subsea supply corridors be severed.（後備基地囤積了充足的緊急戰略物資，以免海底物流動脈遭到戰火切斷。）

boss.desc: 填空題：F I D _ C I _ R Y (受託誠信與忠實義務)
boss.explain: FIDUCIARY (adj.)：受託誠信與忠實義務。例句：Asset managers violated fiduciary duties by trading against client portfolios.（該資產管理機構透過與客戶投資組合進行對沖內幕交易，嚴重違反了受託人忠實義務。）

boss.desc: 填空題：R E P _ T R _ A T E (歸還被掠奪之國家文化財產)
boss.explain: REPATRIATE (v.)：歸還被掠奪之國家文化財產。例句：Treaties compelled imperial powers to repatriate sacred ritual bronzes.（和平條約迫使昔日的帝國主義列強，將掠奪自殖民地的神聖祭祀青銅禮器歸還原屬國。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: I will play devil advocate for a moment to interrogate the resilience of your fiscal model. What is the role?
options: A. Prosecuting the author for criminal financial fraud.
B. Rejecting economic methodology altogether.
C. Adopting a deliberately contrarian stance to test the model validity.
D. Endorsing the model wholeheartedly without reservations.
boss.explain: play devil advocate 刻意站在對立面反詰以測試模型穩健度。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The loss of territorial sovereignty was a bitter pill to swallow for the republic. How did they experience it?
options: A. As a glorious and triumphant achievement of independence.
B. As an indifferent administrative adjustment.
C. As a temporary economic windfall.
D. As a deeply humiliating painful yet unavoidable reality.
boss.explain: a bitter pill to swallow 痛苦而不得不嚥下的苦果。

boss.desc: 【哲學】The moral philosopher acted as devil ___ to test the coherence of the committee ethical consensus.
options: A. adversary
B. counselor
C. advocate
D. prosecutor
boss.explain: devil advocate 指「故意唱反調以檢驗論點嚴謹性的人」。

boss.desc: 【語義】The sudden currency devaluation was a bitter ___ to swallow for the middle class.
options: A. tablet
B. dose
C. potion
D. pill
boss.explain: a bitter pill to swallow 指「不得不接受的痛苦現實或屈辱」。

boss.desc: 請唸出：故意扮演唱反調反詰的質疑者
boss.explain: play devil advocate (phr.)：故意扮演唱反調反詰的質疑者。例句：Let me play devil advocate to test the structural coherence of your thesis.（容我暫時扮演唱反調的反詰質疑者，來極限檢驗你的理論論文是否具備內在自洽性。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：不得不屈辱承受的苦果現實
boss.explain: a bitter pill to swallow (phr.)：不得不屈辱承受的苦果現實。例句：Accepting international fiscal oversight was a bitter pill to swallow for the cabinet.（被迫全盤接受國際貨幣基金組織的嚴苛財政託管監察，對內閣而言是一顆極難嚥下的苦果。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：缺乏穩固支撐隨時可能崩潰搖搖欲墜的（P 開頭，10 個字母）
boss.explain: PRECARIOUS (adj.)：缺乏穩固支撐隨時可能崩潰搖搖欲墜的。例句：The post war coalition maintained a precarious parliamentary majority.（戰後由多黨倉促拼湊而成的執政聯合陣線，在國會中僅勉強維持著搖搖欲墜的微弱多數。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：無意間意外偶獲重大寶貴發現之機緣（S 開頭，11 個字母）
boss.explain: SERENDIPITY (n.)：無意間意外偶獲重大寶貴發現之機緣。例句：The isolation of antibiotic compounds was a historic triumph of scientific serendipity.（廣譜抗生素青黴素化合物的成功提取與提純，是人類現代科學探索史上最偉大的機緣巧合。）

boss.desc: 填空題：C _ A _ M (貧富或階級之間深不見底的鴻溝)
boss.explain: CHASM (n.)：貧富或階級之間深不見底的鴻溝。例句：A growing economic chasm separated coastal metropolitan elites from agrarian provinces.（一條深不見底且日益擴大的貧富與發展鴻溝，將沿海繁榮都市精英與內陸農業行省無情割裂。）

boss.desc: 填空題：I N T _ A C T _ B L E (牽涉多方利益頑抗難解的宿怨矛盾)
boss.explain: INTRACTABLE (adj.)：牽涉多方利益頑抗難解的宿怨矛盾。例句：Deep seated sectarian rivalries presented an intractable hurdle to national unification.（根深蒂固且歷經數百年的宗派歷史血仇，為整個國家的和平統一進程構築了一道難以踰越的頑固障礙。）

boss.desc: 填空題：P A _ A D _ G M (重塑科學界思考邏輯的劃時代理論架構)
boss.explain: PARADIGM (n.)：重塑科學界思考邏輯的劃時代理論架構。例句：The Copernican heliocentric paradigm dismantled millennia of Ptolemaic celestial mechanics.（哥白尼劃時代的太陽中心說理論典範，以無可辯駁的幾何觀測數據徹底推翻了統治西方千年的托勒密地心體系。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The treaty stipulates that sovereign boundary disputes be submitted to international arbitration. What is mandated?
options: A. Mandatory referral to binding international arbitration bodies.
B. Unilateral military occupation of contested frontier territories.
C. The permanent postponement of all bilateral cartographic surveys.
D. The private commercial sale of disputed mineral resources.
boss.explain: stipulate that + 原形虛擬式 be submitted，明文約定邊界爭端交付國際仲裁。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: Not until the archive declassified the treaty minutes was the secret territorial concession exposed. When was it exposed?
options: A. Before the war had reached its decisive turning point.
B. Only after the official diplomatic minutes were officially made public.
C. Prior to the formal signing ceremony in the foreign capital.
D. Immediately after the first border skirmish between allied patrols.
boss.explain: Not until... was... 倒裝說明唯有解密條約會議記錄後，秘密割地內幕方大白於天下。

boss.desc: 【哲學】Hans-Georg Gadamer described understanding as a fusion of horizons between interpreter and historical text. What is fused?
options: A. The temporal, cultural, and conceptual frameworks of past and present.
B. The financial assets of competing corporate litigants during arbitration.
C. The physical pages of ancient manuscripts during archival restoration.
D. The conflicting chemical compositions of archaeological parchment scrolls.
boss.explain: 加達默爾的詮釋學核心概念「視域融合（fusion of horizons）」指詮釋者與歷史文本所處時代視野的交融。

boss.desc: 【虛擬】It is imperative that the international tribunal ___ sovereign jurisdictional objections expeditiously.
options: A. would adjudicate
B. adjudicate
C. adjudicates
D. adjudicated
boss.explain: imperative that + 原形虛擬式 adjudicate。

boss.desc: 請唸出：享有跨國之普遍管轄權
boss.explain: universal jurisdiction over (phr.)：享有跨國之普遍管轄權。例句：National tribunals exercise universal jurisdiction over perpetrators of piracy and genocide.（國內普通法院依法對公海海盜與種族滅絕罪行的實施者，享有不受地域限制的普遍管轄權。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：遵循先例司法準則要求
boss.explain: stare decisis mandates (phr.)：遵循先例司法準則要求。例句：The rule of stare decisis mandates that common law courts honor established precedent.（遵循先例的普通法最高規則，嚴格要求下級法院必須尊重並採納上級法院的既有判例。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：主張按憲法制定時客觀原意進行解釋的原旨主義（O 開頭，11 個字母）
boss.explain: ORIGINALISM (n.)：主張按憲法制定時客觀原意進行解釋的原旨主義。例句：Originalism insists that the constitution should not be rewritten through judicial activism.（憲法原旨主義堅持認為，法官不應透過司法的過度能動主義去任意重構根本大法的初始含義。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：因國家面臨緊急狀態而暫時減損減免人權條款（D 開頭，10 個字母）
boss.explain: DEROGATION (n.)：因國家面臨緊急狀態而暫時減損減免人權條款。例句：The human rights covenant specifies that non derogation clauses apply even during total war.（國際人權公約明確規定，即便在國家爆發全面戰爭的極端狀態下，核心條款依然適用不容減損準則。）

boss.desc: 填空題：E X C _ L P A _ O R Y (排除被告涉案嫌疑之客觀證據)
boss.explain: EXCULPATORY (adj.)：排除被告涉案嫌疑之客觀證據。例句：Suppressing exculpatory DNA evidence violated the defendant constitutional right to fair trial.（隱匿並扣壓能夠證明被告完全清白的關鍵DNA鑑識證據，嚴重侵犯了憲法賦予公民的公正審判權。）

boss.desc: 填空題：A D J _ D I _ A T E (以法庭裁決方式化解跨國爭端)
boss.explain: ADJUDICATE (v.)：以法庭裁決方式化解跨國爭端。例句：The Hague tribunal was formally petitioned to adjudicate the cross border aquifer allocation.（海牙國際常設仲裁法院正式收到訴狀，受託以司法裁決程序全面化解跨國深層地下水資源分配的爭議。）

boss.desc: 填空題：H E _ N _ U S (嚴重違反人道文明底線的殘暴行徑)
boss.explain: HEINOUS (adj.)：嚴重違反人道文明底線的殘暴行徑。例句：Heinous atrocities committed against innocent civilians are subject to universal extraterritorial jurisdiction.（針對手無寸鐵的無辜平民所犯下的滅絕人性之滔天罪行，受到國際社會不受國界限制的普遍管轄權嚴懲。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: Constitutional AI automates model supervision by enforcing explicit self critique principles without human raters. How?
options: A. All conversational queries are routed to civil municipal court judges.
B. The language model critiques and revises its own outputs according to a written constitution.
C. Thousands of human annotators manually rate billions of text completions.
D. The algorithm deletes its own operating system upon detecting any error.
boss.explain: 憲法式 AI（Constitutional AI）依據預設的一套清晰原則，讓大模型進行自主監督、批評與迭代修正。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: Reinforcement learning agents navigating sparse rewards leverage curiosity driven intrinsic motivation. Why?
options: A. To shut down computing infrastructure when target coordinates are reached.
B. To restrict autonomous software agents to predefined linear tracks.
C. To encourage exploration of novel environments when external feedback is absent.
D. To prevent the autonomous agent from taking any physical or virtual action.
boss.explain: 內在好奇心驅動機制（Intrinsic motivation）使強化學習智能體在面臨稀疏獎勵時，仍能主動探索未知環境。

boss.desc: 【量子計算】Quantum supremacy denotes the threshold where a programmable quantum device:
options: A. proves that classical physics was an administrative legislative fabrication.
B. solves an intractable mathematical benchmark beyond the reach of any classical supercomputer.
C. replaces all human workforce across planetary transportation sectors.
D. generates infinitely renewable electrical current from vacuum space.
boss.explain: 量子霸權（Quantum supremacy）指可編程量子計算機在特定複雜計算基準上，展現出任何古典超級計算機皆無法企及的算力突破。

boss.desc: 【幾何深度學習】Graph neural networks are uniquely capable of modeling non Euclidean data by:
options: A. converting all input files into single dimensional chronological audio tracks.
B. prohibiting the use of relational topology in mathematical calculations.
C. propagating neural messages across interconnected nodes and relational edges.
D. restricting all mathematical vectors strictly to two dimensional grid arrays.
boss.explain: 圖神經網絡（GNN）藉由在節點與邊之間傳遞聚合訊息，極其擅長建模分子結構與社群網絡等非歐幾里得拓撲數據。

boss.desc: 請唸出：可編程量子計算霸權臨界點
boss.explain: quantum computational supremacy (phr.)：可編程量子計算霸權臨界點。例句：Achieving quantum computational supremacy marked an irreversible watershed in computational complexity theory.（可編程量子計算霸權的成功達成，在計算複雜性理論史上標誌著一個不可逆轉的重大分水嶺。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：差分隱私數學保證機制
boss.explain: differential privacy guarantees (phr.)：差分隱私數學保證機制。例句：Differential privacy guarantees mathematically preclude the reconstruction of sensitive personal telemetry.（嚴格的差分隱私數學證明機制，從根本上杜絕了任何人企圖反向重構敏感個人隱私特徵的可能性。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：量子計算相較古典超級電腦之壓倒性算力優勢（S 開頭，9 個字母）
boss.explain: SUPREMACY (n.)：量子計算相較古典超級電腦之壓倒性算力優勢。例句：Quantum supremacy benchmarks demonstrated calculations completing in minutes rather than millennia.（量子霸權基準測試有力證明，原本古典超級電腦需耗費數千年之久的運算在數分鐘內即可告竣。）

boss.desc: 填空題：A D V _ R S A _ I A L (零和博弈訓練機制)
boss.explain: ADVERSARIAL (adj.)：零和博弈訓練機制。例句：Adversarial validation ensured that test distributions mirrored real world deployments.（對抗式驗證技術，確保了離線實驗測試集的特徵分佈與真實生產環境的複雜數據高度一致。）

boss.desc: 填空題：R O _ T _ N G (專家網絡動態調度分配)
boss.explain: ROUTING (n.)：專家網絡動態調度分配。例句：Conditional token routing prevents computational bottlenecks across distributed machine nodes.（條件式詞元動態調度路由機制，徹底消除了分散式計算集群跨節點運算時可能出現的通訊瓶頸。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The yield curve inverted as institutional investors flocked into long duration sovereign paper on recession fears. What occurred?
options: A. All sovereign bond markets ceased electronic trading operations globally.
B. The central bank eliminated its benchmark lending rate entirely.
C. Long term bond yields dipped below short term borrowing rates, signaling economic contraction risks.
D. Short term borrowing rates dropped to negative one hundred percent across financial markets.
boss.explain: 由於避險買盤大舉湧入長天期公債，公債殖利率曲線出現罕見倒掛，長期利率低於短期利率，強烈預示著總體經濟衰退風險。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: Market makers widened bid ask spreads exponentially during the flash crash to manage inventory volatility. Why?
options: A. To reward retail investors with instantaneous high yield speculative profit margins.
B. To conform to strict municipal price ceilings on electronic financial communications.
C. To shut down all central clearing counterparties across national derivative exchanges.
D. To shield themselves from execution risk amid sudden extreme price fluctuations and illiquidity.
boss.explain: 在閃崩（Flash crash）期間，做市商急劇拉開買賣價差（Bid-ask spread），以在極端價格波動與流動性枯竭中控制自身庫存風險。

boss.desc: 【量化金融】The Black Scholes Merton partial differential equation models option pricing by assuming:
options: A. that interest rates fluctuate by fifty percentage points every calendar second.
B. that financial markets close permanently after any volatility event.
C. arbitrage free continuous hedging with geometric Brownian motion of the underlying asset.
D. that asset prices will never fluctuate across corporate trading history.
boss.explain: 布萊克-休斯-默頓模型（BSM）透過無套利動態避險與資產價格幾何布朗運動假設，為金融期權合約建立嚴密定價方程。

boss.desc: 【跨國併購】A reverse triangular merger is frequently executed because it enables:
options: A. the complete annihilation of all target intellectual property and commercial brands.
B. the automatic assumption of all buyer debts by foreign municipal governments.
C. an immediate liquidation of all target commercial bank deposits.
D. the target company to survive as a wholly owned subsidiary while preserving key operational contracts.
boss.explain: 反向三角併購（Reverse triangular merger）極受青睞，因其能使目標公司作為全資子公司存續，從而完好保留各類關鍵商業特許與合約。

boss.desc: 請唸出：金融二級市場微觀結構定價機制
boss.explain: market microstructure dynamics (phr.)：金融二級市場微觀結構定價機制。例句：High frequency trading algorithms exploit market microstructure dynamics to extract tiny spreads.（高頻量化演算法深度挖掘訂單簿中的二級市場微觀結構機制，從中榨取稍縱即逝的微小價差。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：反向三角全資子公司併購架構
boss.explain: reverse triangular merger structure (phr.)：反向三角全資子公司併購架構。例句：Legal counsel advised executing a reverse triangular merger structure to preserve operational licenses.（首席法務顧問極力建議採用反向三角併購架構，以完整保留標的公司既有的特許執照與關鍵合約。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：價值依附於基礎資產或利率指標的衍生金融商品（D 開頭，10 個字母）
boss.explain: DERIVATIVE (n.)：價值依附於基礎資產或利率指標的衍生金融商品。例句：Financial institutions trade exotic derivative contracts to hedge complex interest rate exposures.（跨國大型金融機構熱絡交易各類複雜奇異衍生性商品合約，以對沖複雜的利率與匯率波動風險。）

boss.desc: 填空題：I N S _ L V _ N C Y (無力清償債務之破產境地)
boss.explain: INSOLVENCY (n.)：無力清償債務之破產境地。例句：Unhedged foreign currency borrowings drove the overseas real estate group into insolvency.（未進行任何匯率對沖的外幣巨額借貸，最終將該跨國地產巨頭推向了債務全面無力清償的破產深淵。）

boss.desc: 填空題：C R _ M D _ W N (破產程序中的司法強制壓制重整)
boss.explain: CRAMDOWN (n.)：破產程序中的司法強制壓制重整。例句：The debtor company successfully pursued a cramdown to eliminate unpayable junior obligations.（債務人企業藉由破產法院的司法強制壓制裁決，一舉合法抹銷了原本根本無力償還的次級股權義務。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: Fuzzing frameworks discovered thirty memory corruption vulnerabilities in the network stack. What did they do?
options: A. Manually inspected every single printed page of software documentation with magnifying lenses.
B. Polished the physical fiber optic cable connectors with industrial cleaning solvents.
C. Replaced all silicon memory chips with legacy magnetic core memory hardware arrays.
D. Injected vast volumes of malformed, pseudo random inputs to monitor for unhandled application crashes.
boss.explain: 模糊測試框架（Fuzzing）透過向網路協定堆疊灌入海量的畸形偽隨機數據，高效誘發並捕獲到了三十處嚴重的記憶體崩潰漏洞。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The kill chain analysis determined the intrusion began via a watering hole compromise on a vendor portal. Where?
options: A. Attackers infected a trusted niche website frequented by employees of the ultimate target organization.
B. Attackers contaminated the municipal water supply pipe leading into the corporate cafeteria building.
C. Attackers deposited malicious physical USB thumb drives inside the company parking garage.
D. Attackers broadcast high frequency ultrasonic noise across commercial television networks.
boss.explain: 網路殺傷鏈分析（Kill chain）證實，本次重大入侵始於「水坑攻擊」，駭客預先黑入了目標企業員工高頻造訪的第三方合作夥伴入口。

boss.desc: 【認證協定】In Kerberos authentication protocol, the Ticket Granting Service provides clients with:
options: A. paper receipts that must be physically signed by national postmasters.
B. free commercial vouchers redeemable for computer peripheral hardware.
C. unconditional access to foreign sovereign intelligence telecommunications.
D. temporary session tickets that allow access to network services without transmitting raw passwords.
boss.explain: Kerberos 認證協定中，票證授予服務（TGS）向客戶端頒發短期臨時會話票證，避免在網路中明文傳輸登入密碼。

boss.desc: 【國安地緣】Stuxnet represented a watershed in international cyber warfare primarily because it:
options: A. sabotaged physical industrial programmable logic controllers via stealthy firmware corruption.
B. stole consumer credit card numbers from commercial department store chains.
C. temporarily disrupted public email communications in municipal utility offices.
D. defaced commercial website homepages with animated pixel art graphics.
boss.explain: 震網病毒（Stuxnet）是網路戰的劃時代分水嶺，它首次利用多個零日漏洞，在真實物理世界中摧毀了高安全級別的工業濃縮離心機。

boss.desc: 請唸出：無須解密即可直接運算之同態加密技術
boss.explain: homomorphic encryption computation (phr.)：無須解密即可直接運算之同態加密技術。例句：Cloud providers leverage homomorphic encryption computation to analyze sensitive genomic records.（領先的雲端運算巨頭開始廣泛部署同態加密計算技術，在不解密明文的條件下深度分析高度敏感的人類基因組資料。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：透過晶片微弱功耗波動破解密鑰之差分分析
boss.explain: differential power analysis attack (phr.)：透過晶片微弱功耗波動破解密鑰之差分分析。例句：Cryptographic chips incorporate noise generators to thwart differential power analysis attack attempts.（高安全級別加密晶片內建了高頻隨機硬體雜訊生成器，以徹底挫敗各類試圖透過監測微小功耗波動的差分分析竊密企圖。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：數據或軟體組件從源頭至終點可被驗證的溯源軌跡（P 開頭，10 個字母）
boss.explain: PROVENANCE (n.)：數據或軟體組件從源頭至終點可被驗證的溯源軌跡。例句：Software bill of materials documents the provenance of all third party code libraries.（軟體物料清單（SBOM）詳盡記載並完整還原了系統中所引入的每一套第三方代碼庫的清晰溯源軌跡。）

boss.desc: 填空題：C R Y P _ A N A _ Y S I S (破譯密文之密碼學分析)
boss.explain: CRYPTANALYSIS (n.)：破譯密文之密碼學分析。例句：Academic cryptanalysis revealed mathematical weaknesses in the legacy encryption standard.（學術界前沿的密碼學逆向分析，成功揭示了某套歷史悠久的早期商業加密標準中所暗藏的深刻數學缺陷。）

boss.desc: 填空題：I M P _ I R _ E N T (惡意注入導致之功能受損)
boss.explain: IMPAIRMENT (n.)：惡意注入導致之功能受損。例句：Memory corruption causes severe functional impairment in real time navigation software.（底層記憶體越界寫入所引發的嚴重數據污染，將導致即時導航定位軟體的關鍵功能遭受毀滅性癱瘓受損。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The human challenge trial deliberately exposed immunized volunteers to virulent pathogens. Why?
options: A. To rapidly establish vaccine efficacy and correlates of protection during an escalating pandemic crisis.
B. To punish convicted criminals through mandatory exposure to fatal infectious illnesses.
C. To determine if human beings can survive indefinitely without drinking fresh water.
D. To demonstrate that viral pathogens are non existent optical illusions inside microscopes.
boss.explain: 在流行病失控的危急關頭，人體挑戰試驗（Human challenge trial）審慎讓已接種疫苗的健康志願者主動接觸活病毒，以光速驗證保護效力。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The synthetic biology consortium synthesized an artificial chromosome containing exclusively refactored codons. What was synthesized?
options: A. A synthetic polymer designed to replace all fluid water inside the human circulatory system.
B. A chemically assembled chromosome eliminating redundant codons to open up orthogonal translation pathways.
C. A mechanical gold filament engineered to mechanically hold cellular organelles in fixed alignment.
D. A printed paper textbook containing the complete nucleotide sequence of the human genome.
boss.explain: 合成生物學聯合團隊成功化學合成了全重構密碼子人造染色體，清空了多餘的遺傳密碼子，為人工編碼非天然胺基酸鋪平了坦途。

boss.desc: 【表觀遺傳重編程】Yamanaka factors induce somatic cell reprogramming back to pluripotency by:
options: A. reactivating embryonic gene expression networks and erasing differentiated epigenetic marks.
B. forcing mature adult cells to undergo immediate apoptotic biological suicide.
C. converting biological animal tissues directly into synthetic crystalline minerals.
D. permanently altering the universal genetic code of all nuclear chromosomes.
boss.explain: 山中因子（Oct4, Sox2, Klf4, c-Myc）透過重塑染色質可及性與重啟胚胎基因表達網絡，強行抹除成熟細胞的終末分化表觀印記。

boss.desc: 【生化防禦】Gain of function pathogen research provokes international safety controversy because:
options: A. it converts standard biological laboratory glassware into explosive chemical devices.
B. enhancing the lethality or airborne transmissibility of potential pandemic pathogens risks accidental lab escapes.
C. it completely eliminates all biological viruses from the face of the earth.
D. it forces pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities to use manual copper stirrers.
boss.explain: 功能獲得性病原體研究（Gain-of-Function）備受爭議，因其人為改造並放大潛在流行病原體的空氣傳播力與致命毒力，伴隨著災難性實驗室洩漏風險。

boss.desc: 請唸出：微觀單細胞轉錄組異質性高解析定序
boss.explain: single cell transcriptomics (phr.)：微觀單細胞轉錄組異質性高解析定序。例句：Single cell transcriptomics revealed rare drug resistant subclonal populations in solid tumors.（高靈敏單細胞轉錄組定序技術，精準揪出了實體惡性腫瘤中潛伏的罕見耐藥性亞克隆微小細胞群。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：手術或化療後體內殘留之微小惡性病灶
boss.explain: minimal residual disease (phr.)：手術或化療後體內殘留之微小惡性病灶。例句：Serial liquid biopsy assays monitor minimal residual disease to predict cancer relapse months early.（常態化液體切片監測追蹤微小殘留病灶，往往能比傳統影像學提前數月精確預警癌症的復發。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：源自同種但遺傳背景不同之個體的同種異體的（A 開頭，10 個字母）
boss.explain: ALLOGENEIC (adj.)：源自同種但遺傳背景不同之個體的同種異體的。例句：Allogeneic cell products can be mass manufactured from healthy universal donor cohorts.（同種異體細胞治療產品能夠從健康萬能供體佇列中進行規模化工業生產，顯著壓低了昂貴的醫療成本。）

boss.desc: 填空題：T R A N _ F E C _ I O N (基因工程外源核酸轉染)
boss.explain: TRANSFECTION (n.)：基因工程外源核酸轉染。例句：Electroporation ensures high transfection efficiency in hard to edit lymphocytes.（運用高壓電穿孔物理技術，能確保在極難導入外源基因的原代淋巴細胞中實現極高的核酸轉染效率。）

boss.desc: 填空題：S E N _ S C _ N C E (端粒縮短導致之細胞衰老狀態)
boss.explain: SENESCENCE (n.)：端粒縮短導致之細胞衰老狀態。例句：Clearance of senescent cells from aging tissues reverses markers of senescence.（利用靶向清除藥物清除老化組織內部堆積的衰老細胞，能顯著逆轉多項機體衰老退化的生化指標。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The macroprudential authority tightened countercyclical capital buffers during the housing boom. Why?
options: A. To provide free zero down payment mortgages to all university undergraduate students.
B. To force commercial banks to accumulate equity reserves during expansions to absorb future losses.
C. To completely outlaw the private ownership of residential real estate property by citizens.
D. To lower building construction safety standards to accelerate commercial urban development.
boss.explain: 宏觀審慎監管部門在房市烈火烹油之際果斷提高「逆週期資本緩衝（CCyB）」，強制銀行在經濟繁榮時築高安全儲備，防範未來衰退衝擊。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The output gap narrowed as manufacturing capacity utilization reached eighty five percent. What narrowed?
options: A. The wage differential between junior manufacturing apprentices and senior assembly engineers.
B. The time required for cargo container vessels to cross transatlantic shipping routes.
C. The difference between the economy's actual production output and its estimated potential maximum output.
D. The physical distance separating high speed rail cargo transport lines from maritime seaports.
boss.explain: 隨著工業產能利用率攀升至 85%，實體經濟的「產出缺口（Output gap）」快速收斂閉合，意味著經濟正加速逼近產能滿載的通膨引爆點。

boss.desc: 【金融危機理論】Hyman Minsky's Financial Instability Hypothesis posits that prolonged periods of stability:
options: A. guarantee that stock market equity valuations will appreciate by fifty percent annually.
B. inevitably induce complacency, speculative borrowing, and fragile Ponzi financing regimes.
C. permanently eradicate all business cycle recessions and employment layoffs from society.
D. cause physical gold to evaporate spontaneously into ambient atmospheric oxygen.
boss.explain: 海曼·明斯基的金融不穩定假說（Minsky's Hypothesis）揭示：長期的經濟繁榮與穩定本身，必然會催生過度投機與龐氏融資，最終走向明斯基時刻。

boss.desc: 【泰勒法則】The Taylor Rule recommends the appropriate nominal policy interest rate based on:
options: A. the total number of days of sunshine recorded in the national capital city across the fiscal year.
B. the electoral poll margins separating the leading political parties prior to voting day.
C. the equilibrium real rate, the deviation of inflation from target, and the economic output gap.
D. the average price of physical copper plumbing pipes in international construction markets.
boss.explain: 泰勒法則（Taylor Rule）為基準政策利率提供了嚴謹的數學公式，其核心依據是中性實質利率、通膨偏離目標的差距以及實體經濟的產出缺口。

boss.desc: 請唸出：量化寬鬆壓低殖利率之資產組合平衡管道
boss.explain: portfolio balance channel (phr.)：量化寬鬆壓低殖利率之資產組合平衡管道。例句：Through the portfolio balance channel, asset purchases lower term premia on long term securities.（透過資產組合平衡管道，央行大規模購入長天期債券成功壓低了長期資產的期限溢價。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：平抑金融狂熱之宏觀審慎逆週期資本緩衝
boss.explain: countercyclical capital buffer (phr.)：平抑金融狂熱之宏觀審慎逆週期資本緩衝。例句：Regulators raised the countercyclical capital buffer to curb speculative real estate lending bubbles.（金融審慎監管當局大舉拔高逆週期資本緩衝要求，全力遏制熱錢湧入房地產領域催生投機性信貸泡沫。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：市場供需雙方力量達到平衡且價格穩定的經濟均衡狀態（E 開頭，11 個字母）
boss.explain: EQUILIBRIUM (n.)：市場供需雙方力量達到平衡且價格穩定的經濟均衡狀態。例句：General equilibrium models simulate how multi sector shocks reverberate through prices.（一般均衡宏觀經濟模型，能夠精確仿真各產業部門遭受外部衝擊時如何在全市場價格體系中傳導尋求均衡。）

boss.desc: 填空題：C O N _ A G _ O N (跨市場恐慌性金融傳染)
boss.explain: CONTAGION (n.)：跨市場恐慌性金融傳染。例句：Regulatory firewalls were constructed to insulate core domestic banking from contagion.（金融監管機構火速修築堅不可摧的制度防火牆，全力隔離境外金融海嘯向本土核心銀行體系的恐慌傳染。）

boss.desc: 填空題：I N T E _ V E N _ I O N (央行直接入市之監管干預)
boss.explain: INTERVENTION (n.)：央行直接入市之監管干預。例句：The central bank executed an unannounced verbal and physical intervention in currency markets.（央行在毫無預警的情況下突施冷箭，在外匯現貨與衍生品市場上實施了口頭與真金白銀的強硬干預。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: Moral hazard manifested after the sovereign bailout, prompting the commercial bank to resume reckless lending. Why?
options: A. The bank directors were sentenced to life imprisonment under emergency sovereign military tribunals.
B. The commercial bank surrendered its entire retail loan portfolio to foreign non profit charities.
C. Insulation from the negative consequences of risk induced the institution to take even larger gambles.
D. The central bank permanently confiscated the bank's operating charter and commercial banking license.
boss.explain: 在獲取政府兜底救助注資後，道德風險（Moral hazard）迅速死灰復燃：商業銀行因被免除了冒險失敗的毀滅性後果，隨即變本加厲地重啟高風險投機信貸。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: Groupthink during the national security council deliberations silenced all dissenting intelligence warnings. What silenced?
options: A. The military high command disabled all telephone and telecommunication lines leading into the bunker.
B. Foreign intelligence officers physically incapacitated the civilian diplomatic advisers.
C. The committee members were legally forbidden from speaking aloud inside the conference chamber.
D. Pressures for uniformity and conformity suppressed critical scrutiny, culminating in strategic catastrophe.
boss.explain: 國安高層會議內部瀰漫的「群體迷思」與盲從高壓，無情撲滅了所有敢於提出質疑的反面情報預警，最終釀成了慘絕人寰的重大戰略慘敗。

boss.desc: 【訊號理論】Michael Spence's job market signaling model asserts that higher education degrees function as:
options: A. a recreational luxury purchased exclusively to enjoy physical university campus architecture.
B. an administrative certificate guaranteeing that a worker will never make mistakes on the job.
C. a costly, hard to fake signal of innate worker productivity rather than pure human capital enhancement.
D. a government mandate designed to keep young adults out of the active labor workforce.
boss.explain: 邁克爾·斯賓塞的「訊號理論（Signaling）」指出：高學歷文憑的核心價值往往在於其作為一個昂貴且難以偽造的「先天能力訊號」，向雇主釋放可靠證明。

boss.desc: 【神經經濟學】Neuroeconomic fMRI imaging reveals that perceiving severe social unfairness triggers:
options: A. intense feelings of euphoric joy and spontaneous uncontrollable laughter in subjects.
B. an immediate cessation of all autonomic cardiac activity in experimental participants.
C. a spontaneous twenty percent surge in mathematical cognitive arithmetic capability.
D. hyperactivation in the anterior insula, an anatomical brain region intimately tied to physical disgust.
boss.explain: 神經經濟學（Neuroeconomics）的功能性磁振造影揭示：當大腦遭遇極端不公待遇時，掌管肉體劇烈「噁心反感」的前腦島會劇烈活化，證明公平感根植於生物本能。

boss.desc: 請唸出：獲得政府注資救助後引發之道德風險
boss.explain: moral hazard after bailout (phr.)：獲得政府注資救助後引發之道德風險。例句：Regulators imposed strict capital caps to curtail reckless moral hazard after bailout operations.（金融監管機構火速祭出嚴苛的資本限制紅線，旨在徹底遏止金融巨頭在獲得政府救助後死灰復燃的道德風險。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：在探索新知與收割已知間之戰略權衡
boss.explain: explore exploit tradeoff (phr.)：在探索新知與收割已知間之戰略權衡。例句：Autonomous reinforcement agents navigate the explore exploit tradeoff through epsilon greedy algorithms.（自主深度強化學習智能體，廣泛藉由 ε-貪婪演算法在浩瀚未知中精確權衡探索新領域與利用已知經驗的平衡點。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：政府或機構出於善意而限制個人自由的家長式作風（P 開頭，11 個字母）
boss.explain: PATERNALISM (n.)：政府或機構出於善意而限制個人自由的家長式作風。例句：Libertarian paternalism seeks to guide decisions through nudges without coercion.（自由意志家長制力圖透過隨風潛入夜的行為推力引導公眾做出良善選擇，全程恪守零強制的最高底線。）

boss.desc: 填空題：A L _ R U _ S M (超越純利己之心之利他行為)
boss.explain: ALTRUISM (n.)：超越純利己之心之利他行為。例句：Pure psychological altruism challenges dogmatic models of universal human greed.（純粹的心理利他主義精神，無情掌摑了那些將「天下熙熙皆為利來」奉為絕對真理的教條主義自私模型。）

boss.desc: 填空題：R A T _ O N A _ I T Y (人類在極度壓力下之有限理性)
boss.explain: RATIONALITY (n.)：人類在極度壓力下之有限理性。例句：Emotional cognitive overload collapses the fragile architecture of bounded rationality.（極端生死關頭引發的情感衝擊與認知超載，會在一瞬間將人類本就脆弱無比的有限理性結構轟得粉碎。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The autonomous unmanned underwater vehicle mapped submarine canyons along the continental shelf. What was mapped?
options: A. Ancient submerged archaeological marble ruins from prehistoric mythological civilizations.
B. Underwater oil pipeline valves to be manually turned off by deep sea commercial scuba divers.
C. The migration routes of rare bioluminescent jellyfish across transoceanic shipping lanes.
D. Acoustic topography and bathymetric waypoints to facilitate covert strategic submarine navigation.
boss.explain: 大航程自主水下無人潛航器（UUV）精密測繪了大陸棚深邃的海底峽谷拓撲結構，為戰略核潛艦未來在水下無聲隱秘穿梭繪製出了救命的聲學海圖路徑。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The intelligence dossier identified a coordinated state sponsored influence operation targeting domestic elections. What was found?
options: A. Algorithmic amplification of divisive societal narratives, deepfakes, and illicit funding of fringe groups.
B. A physical burglary of the central electoral commission office to steal wooden ballot voting boxes.
C. A total shutdown of the nationwide electrical power grid for thirty consecutive calendar days.
D. An official proclamation decreeing that all future elections would be decided by foot races.
boss.explain: 解密情報檔案詳盡揭露了一場由敵國國家級情報機構在暗中操盤的精密「影響力行動」：透過演算法巨量放大社會仇恨對立、投餵深偽影片並秘密金援極端社群撕裂大選。

boss.desc: 【國際法理】The doctrine of Universal Jurisdiction empowers domestic national courts to prosecute:
options: A. minor parking violations committed by tourists in foreign sovereign capital cities.
B. intellectual property copyright disputes between independent software game developers.
C. the failure of foreign commercial restaurants to observe traditional etiquette protocols.
D. heinous international crimes like genocide and torture, regardless of where they occurred or the perpetrator's nationality.
boss.explain: 普遍管轄權原則（Universal Jurisdiction）賦予各國內國法院崇高的司法權限：無論種族滅絕或酷刑暴行發生在何方、無論施暴者國籍為何，各國法院皆有權對其提起公訴。

boss.desc: 【海洋秩序】The principle of mare liberum, championed by Hugo Grotius, established the foundational norm that:
options: A. the high seas are international territory open to free navigation, trade, and innocent passage for all sovereign nations.
B. oceanic waters beyond three miles must be converted into solid concrete aircraft runways.
C. only nations possessing nuclear powered submarines have the right to fish in international waters.
D. maritime territorial sovereignty extends infinitely across the entirety of planet earth's oceans.
boss.explain: 胡戈·格老秀斯在其巨著中奠定的「海洋自由論（Mare Liberum）」法理，確立了公海屬於全人類共同公域、對所有國家的和平航行、貿易往來完全平等的現代海洋國際法基石。

boss.desc: 請唸出：針對滅絕人道罪行之普遍管轄權公訴
boss.explain: universal jurisdiction prosecution (phr.)：針對滅絕人道罪行之普遍管轄權公訴。例句：Human rights tribunals invoked universal jurisdiction prosecution against fugitive war criminals.（國際人權特別法庭大膽援引普遍管轄權原則，在全球範圍內對那些雙手沾滿鮮血的在逃戰犯發起跨國紅色通緝。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：外科手術般摧毀敵方發射井之反軍力打擊
boss.explain: counterforce military targeting (phr.)：外科手術般摧毀敵方發射井之反軍力打擊。例句：Strategic planners debated shifting from countervalue retaliation to high precision counterforce military targeting.（最高戰略參謀部激烈辯論，是否應當將核武預案由無差別屠戮大城市的反價值報復轉向精準點穴的反軍力打擊。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：一國法律或權力延伸至其本國法定領土之外的域外的（E 開頭，16 個字母）
boss.explain: EXTRATERRITORIAL (adj.)：一國法律或權力延伸至其本國法定領土之外的域外的。例句：Multinational enterprises must navigate aggressive extraterritorial enforcement of trade sanctions.（各大跨國巨頭企業在經營中，必須如履薄冰地面對某大國對貿易制裁法案極具侵略性的長臂管轄與域外執法。）

boss.desc: 填空題：B E L _ I G E _ E N T (處於交戰狀態之武裝交戰方)
boss.explain: BELLIGERENT (n.)：處於交戰狀態之武裝交戰方。例句：Both sovereign belligerent entities agreed to an unannounced forty eight hour ceasefire.（兩個身陷血海深仇的正式交戰國主體，出人意料地共同達成了一項為期四十八小時的臨時停火默契。）

boss.desc: 填空題：R E _ R I _ A L (遭受挑釁後實施之對等報復)
boss.explain: REPRISAL (n.)：遭受挑釁後實施之對等報復。例句：The government launched targeted economic reprisal against the illegal import ban.（針對鄰國毫無依據、單方面發動的非法進口禁令，本國政府果斷祭出了刀刀見血的對等經濟反制報復。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: Ocean fertilization experiments injecting soluble iron sulfate were halted by international maritime conventions. Why?
options: A. The international convention decreed that iron could only be used to manufacture physical railway tracks.
B. The geoengineering intervention risked triggering toxic algal blooms, severe hypoxia, and irreversible ecological disruption.
C. The iron sulfate chemical reacted with sea water, turning the international ocean completely bright red.
D. The cargo vessel transporting the mineral was physically hijacked by modern day maritime pirates.
boss.explain: 向公海傾倒硫酸亞鐵實施海洋施肥的地球工程狂想被國際海洋公約緊急叫停：該項粗暴干預極易引發大面積赤潮爆發、底層水體嚴重缺氧以及海洋生態系統的災難性連鎖崩潰。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The indigenous tribal council exercised their statutory right to Free, Prior, and Informed Consent over the lithium mine. What was exercised?
options: A. The requirement that all mining engineers learn to speak the indigenous tribal language fluently.
B. A demand that all extracted raw lithium minerals be utilized exclusively to manufacture consumer sports cars.
C. The legal power to veto or negotiate terms for resource extraction projects occurring on customary ancestral lands.
D. The right to purchase ten percent of the mining equipment at subsidized discounted retail wholesale prices.
boss.explain: 原住民部落長老會議依法強勢行使了其神聖的「自由、事先與知情同意權（FPIC）」，對外資跨國礦業巨頭企圖在其世世代代相傳的祖傳聖地強行開採鋰礦的蠻橫企圖一票否決。

boss.desc: 【跨代正義】Intergenerational equity in sustainable jurisprudence dictates that the present generation:
options: A. must demolish all historical architectural structures every thirty calendar years.
B. holds the earth in common trust and must pass it on in a condition no less healthy than it was received.
C. is legally mandated to consume one hundred percent of non renewable natural resources immediately.
D. should impose all ecological restoration debts entirely upon citizens who have not yet been born.
boss.explain: 跨代正義（Intergenerational Equity）為永續法理學立下世代契約：當代人類僅是地球的受託管理者，負有絕對的道義與法律義務，確保將一個不亞於先輩所交付的健康純淨地球傳遞給後代子孫。

boss.desc: 【環境主權】The Trail Smelter arbitral precedent established the foundational transboundary harm principle of sic utere tuo, meaning:
options: A. sovereign nations are legally authorized to dump toxic nuclear waste into foreign international rivers.
B. developing countries must surrender fifty percent of their annual agricultural grain harvest to neighboring states.
C. no sovereign state has the right to use or permit the use of its territory in such a manner as to cause serious environmental injury to neighboring territory.
D. a nation may physically invade neighboring sovereign lands to extract potable drinking water reserves.
boss.explain: 歷史性的特雷爾冶煉廠仲裁先例（Trail Smelter）奠定了國際環境法的基石原則「善用自身財物，勿損他人權益」：任何主權國家皆無權放任其境內的工業污染，對鄰國領土造成實質跨界損害。

boss.desc: 請唸出：當代人對後代子孫之跨代正義法理公理
boss.explain: intergenerational equity doctrine (phr.)：當代人對後代子孫之跨代正義法理公理。例句：The landmark verdict enshrined the intergenerational equity doctrine within basic human rights law.（這場名垂青史的世紀判決，將守護未出世後代子孫福祉的「跨代正義」法理，正式寫入了當代基本人權憲章法典。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：原住民對祖傳土地開發之知情同意否決權
boss.explain: free prior and informed consent (phr.)：原住民對祖傳土地開發之知情同意否決權。例句：Mining developers must secure free prior and informed consent before altering customary indigenous forests.（任何外來跨國採礦資本在踏入原住民世代棲息的原始森林半步之前，必須依法獲得其完整、自由且知情的同意授權。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：海洋吸收過量二氧化碳導致表層海水酸度上升的海洋酸化（A 開頭，13 個字母）
boss.explain: ACIDIFICATION (n.)：海洋吸收過量二氧化碳導致表層海水酸度上升的海洋酸化。例句：Coral reef bleaching is accelerated by rising temperatures and catastrophic ocean acidification.（熱帶珊瑚礁的大面積白化與死亡，正深受海水溫度狂飆與災難性海洋酸化的雙重致命夾擊。）

boss.desc: 填空題：G E O E _ G I N E _ R I N G (人工重塑大氣之地球工程)
boss.explain: GEOENGINEERING (n.)：人工重塑大氣之地球工程。例句：Unilateral deployment of climate geoengineering could spark severe regional agricultural droughts.（任何大國單方面擅自部署氣候地球工程大招，極可能在鄰近板塊引爆毀滅性的區域性農業大乾旱浩劫。）

boss.desc: 填空題：P E R M _ A B I _ I T Y (海綿城市鋪裝之透水率)
boss.explain: PERMEABILITY (n.)：海綿城市鋪裝之透水率。例句：Bioswales and green roofs maximize surface permeability to prevent urban flash floods.（遍布街角的生態植草溝與綠色屋頂，將大都市地表的雨水滲透率拉到了極致，從容化解都市短時強降雨內澇。）
